This paper reports a designed-for-test measurement of discourse-language bias in large language model (LLM) brand recommendations for premium kitchen knives — a category dominated in production and chef reputation by Japan but mediated in English-language coverage through US/UK food media. Thirty-three brands across four lineages (Japanese, German, American, shared) plus one hybrid (Miyabi) were measured against six pre-registered prompts anchored to Category Entry Points, six frontier models from four labs (Anthropic Claude Sonnet 4.6 and Opus 4.7, OpenAI gpt-5.4-mini and gpt-5.5, Google Gemini 2.5 Flash, xAI Grok 4.1 Fast), and eight runs each (n = 288 successful measurements). Eight hypotheses with explicit numerical thresholds were committed to a pre-registration document locked at git commit d3e0989 prior to any data collection.

The headline lineage-aggregate hypothesis (H1) was disconfirmed at both registry versions. At the locked v1.0 registry (21 brands), Japanese aggregate Presence was 36.2 percent versus German 27.3 percent — an 8.9-point gap in the wrong direction. At the published v1.2 registry (33 brands, 19 Japanese standard plus 1 hybrid, after the registry-revision protocol added boundary-condition makers from the unknown-mentions list), Japanese aggregate fell to 25.7 percent and German held at 27.2 percent — a 1.5-point gap in the predicted direction but below the 5-point partial-confirmation threshold. The lineage-aggregate hypothesis therefore fails consistently across registry construction.

The within-lineage results carry a different signal entirely. Within Japanese, mass-market English-marketed brands (Shun, Global, Mac) surface at 55.2 percent versus 6.8 percent for the fourteen boundary-condition Japanese makers in the canonical scoring — a 48.4-percentage-point gap and approximately 8x ratio. Within German, the boundary case (Güde) appears in zero of 288 measurements while English-marketed German makers (Wüsthof, Henckels) average 62.0 percent. Within the boundary-condition Japanese cohort itself, seven brands clear the 5-percent floor and two stand markedly apart at the upper end: Masamoto at 18.1 percent and Takamura at 16.7 percent — both characterized by substantial US-targeted English-language distribution and chef-endorsed English-media coverage. Of 262 named authority mentions across all 288 measurements, 100 percent are English-language; no Japanese, German, French, or other-language sources surface in any response.

A secondary finding replicates across providers: newer-generation models within both Anthropic (Opus 4.7 versus Sonnet 4.6) and OpenAI (gpt-5.5 versus gpt-5.4-mini) surface boundary-condition Japanese brands at higher rates than their older counterparts — the second cross-category replication of a "newer models surface boundary cases more, not less" pattern in the AIAS measurement program.

The lineage-aggregate failure (H1) and the within-lineage convergence (H3, H5, H8) together motivate a candidate alternative framing: marketing-language coverage as a brand-level mediator of AI brand presence in cross-lingual categories. Brands with substantial English-language marketing infrastructure surface at materially higher rates than equivalently positioned brands without such infrastructure, within every lineage of origin tested. The framing is offered as a candidate hypothesis adjacent to but structurally distinct from existing AI-Surfacing hypotheses (Default Reinforcement; recommendation-slot persistence; freshness-lag). It predicts that brand-level English-marketing investment, not lineage of origin, is the binding variable for AI Presence in cross-lingual categories. Construct validity remains open and is the proposed object of a Phase 3 designed-for-confirmation study.

AI.tldr: 本研究通过设计化测试测量了LLM在高端厨刀品牌推荐中的"话语-语言偏见"。尽管日本在高端厨刀生产和厨师资历上占主导地位，但33个品牌的288次测量显示：**按产地来源聚合的假设（H1）被证伪**，而**品牌层面的英语营销投入才是AI推荐中出现率的关键中介变量**。英语营销覆盖的品牌出现率显著高于无此覆盖的品牌，且所有权威引用100%来自英语来源。
AI.research_question: 大语言模型在跨语言品类（高端厨刀）的品牌推荐中是否存在"话语-语言偏见"？即英语媒体覆盖是否显著影响品牌出现率，而非品牌的原产国（日本/德国）优势？
AI.motivation: 高端厨刀品类由日本主导生产与厨师资历，但英语媒体报道由美英食品媒体中介。这为测试LLM是否在推荐中复制了英语话语霸权而非客观质量排序提供了理想场景。
AI.theoretical_framework: AI浮现假设体系（Default Reinforcement；推荐槽位持久性；新鲜度滞后）；候选替代框架：营销语言覆盖作为品牌级中介变量（Marketing-Language Coverage as a Brand-Level Mediator）。
AI.method: 预注册实验设计：33个品牌（4个谱系+1个混合品牌），6个预注册提示词，6个前沿模型（来自4家实验室），每提示8次运行，共n=288次成功测量。8个假设设定明确数值阈值，预注册锁定于git commit d3e0989。
AI.findings: 1. 谱系聚合假设（H1）被证伪：日本品牌聚合出现率低于德国品牌（v1.0: 36.2% vs 27.3%反向差距；v1.2: 25.7% vs 27.2%未达阈值）。2. 谱系内结果显著：英语营销品牌vs边界条件品牌差距巨大（日本内55.2% vs 6.8%；德国内62.0% vs 0%）。3. 262次权威引用100%为英语来源。4. 更新代模型更易浮现边界条件品牌（跨类别复制发现）。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出并部分验证"营销语言覆盖作为品牌级中介变量"替代框架，该框架与现有AI浮现假设（Default Reinforcement等）结构不同但相邻，预测英语营销投入而非原产国谱系是跨语言品类AI出现率的绑定变量。
AI.practical_contributions: 揭示LLM推荐中存在系统性语言偏见，对非英语市场品牌的AI可见性策略有直接启示；为预注册设计和假设检验在AI测量研究中的应用提供方法论范例。

title: From Self-Deception to Self-Awareness: A Theological and Psychological Framework for Spiritual Formation

detail.title: From Self-Deception to Self-Awareness: A Theological and Psychological Framework for Spiritual Formation
detail.abstract: Self-deception is a pervasive human phenomenon that cuts across philosophy, psychology, sociology, and theology, constituting the deep root of cognitive dysfunction in public life. This article advances three original contributions. First, it integrates Rosenthal's Higher-Order Thought theory (HOT) of consciousness, Kegan's subject-object developmental model, and the biblical narratives of self-deception to construct a three-tier consciousness spectrum-from the child's pure first-order arrest, to the volitional cultivation of not-knowing, to the active suppression of acknowledged truth. Second, taking Paul's call to maturity (1 Cor 13:11; 14:20) as its theological framework, it proposes a developmental moral assessment of self-deception: for adults, selfdeception is a manifestation of sin, and the genuine moral question is whether one is willing to grow up. Third, drawing on Willard's three-tier model of the will as a practical scaffold, it integrates Christian Spiritual Self-Awareness (CSSA) practice with the community's environment of love, proposing an operationalizable pathway from self-deception to self-awareness. The article argues that breaking self-deception is not merely a matter of individual spiritual formation but a concrete way for the church to participate in the renewal of human consciousness and contribute to the common good.

AI.tldr: 本文整合意识理论、发展心理学与圣经叙事，构建三层意识光谱，提出自我欺骗的道德发展评估，并结合基督教灵性实践与社群之爱，提供一条从自我欺骗走向自我觉知的可行路径，指出打破自我欺骗是教会参与人类意识更新、贡献公共福祉的具体方式。
AI.research_question: 如何理解并打破人类普遍存在的自我欺骗现象？
AI.motivation: 自我欺骗是贯穿哲学、心理学、社会学与神学的普遍现象，是公共生活中认知功能障碍的深层根源，亟需跨学科整合性的理论与操作性方案。
AI.theoretical_framework: Rosenthal的高阶意识理论（HOT）、Kegan的主客体发展模型、圣经叙事中的自我欺骗、保罗的成熟呼召（林前13:11; 14:20）、Willard的三层意志模型。
AI.method: 理论整合与建构性论证，结合圣经文本分析、神学反思与实践模型构建。
AI.findings: 构建了三层意识光谱（纯一阶停滞→故意"不知"→主动压制已知真理）；提出自我欺骗的发展性道德评估——对成人而言，自我欺骗是罪的彰显，核心道德问题是是否愿意成长；整合基督教灵性自觉实践（CSSA）与社群爱之环境，提出从自我欺骗走向自我觉知的可操作化路径。
AI.theory_contributions: 将高阶意识理论、发展心理学与神学叙事有机整合，构建了跨学科的三层意识光谱模型；从发展性视角重新界定自我欺骗的道德评价标准，区别于静态的伦理学判断。
AI.practical_contributions: 为教会及基督徒社群提供了从自我欺骗转向自我觉知的具体实践路径，强调打破自我欺骗不仅关乎个体灵性塑造，更是教会参与人类意识更新、贡献公共福祉的具体方式。

title: Optimal Scheduling of Dengue Vector Control
affiliations: Kansas State University, Kansas State University, Kansas State University and University of Virginia - School of Data Science

detail.title: Optimal Scheduling of Dengue Vector Control
detail.abstract: Dengue transmission is shaped by the population dynamics of the Aedes aegypti mosquito, making vector control a centralstrategy for disease mitigation. The impact of interventions such as larvicide, adulticide, and breeding-site reduction depends critically ontheir timing under fluctuating environmental conditions. We build on a high-fidelity, non-Markovian mechanistic model of the Aedes lifecycle that captures stage-structured, temperature-dependent developmental delays, and mortality, and extend it to incorporate multiplevector control measures. Rather than using continuous abstract control amplitudes as in standard optimal control formulations, weintroduce intervention-specific temporal profiles that better reflect operational practice. We then develop an adjoint-based gradientdescent framework to compute the optimal timing of a sequence of interventions by minimizing the time-dependent dengue reproductionnumber, R0. Numerical simulations based on seasonal temperature data from Miami, Florida, show that appropriately timed combinationsof interventions can substantially suppress transmission risk, with outcomes strongly influenced by seasonal temperature variation andintervention duration. We further propose embedding the resulting optimization framework within a Model Predictive Control architecture,yielding a closed-loop approach for real-time, surveillance-driven vector management under environmental and operational uncertainty.

AI.tldr: 本文通过建立非马尔可夫的埃及伊蚊生命周期机理模型，结合伴随梯度下降框架，优化了登革热病媒控制措施（如杀虫剂、成蚊灭杀、繁殖地减少）的时序安排，并嵌入模型预测控制，实现实时、闭环的病媒管理。
AI.research_question: 如何在环境波动条件下，优化登革热病媒（埃及伊蚊）控制措施的时序安排，以最小化登革热传播风险？
AI.motivation: 登革热传播受蚊虫种群动态影响，病媒控制措施的效力高度依赖实施时机，但现有最优控制方法多使用连续抽象控制幅度，缺乏对操作实践的真实反映。
AI.theoretical_framework: 非马尔可夫机理模型（阶段结构、温度依赖的发育延迟与死亡率）、伴随梯度下降优化、模型预测控制（MPC）。
AI.method: 建立高保真非马尔可夫埃及伊蚊生命周期机理模型，引入干预特异性时间分布；开发伴随梯度下降框架，以最小化时变登革热基本再生数R0为目标，优化干预序列时序；最后嵌入MPC架构实现闭环控制。
AI.findings: 基于佛罗里达州迈阿密季节性温度数据的仿真显示，适当搭配的控制措施时序能显著抑制传播风险，结果受季节温度变化和干预持续时间强烈影响。
AI.theory_contributions: 将非马尔可夫蚊虫种群模型与伴随梯度优化相结合，提出更具操作性的干预时间分布表示方法，并构建闭环MPC框架应对环境与操作不确定性。
AI.practical_contributions: 为登革热病媒控制提供基于数据驱动的时序优化策略，支持实时、动态的监测驱动病媒管理，提升干预效率。

title: Comparing Spatial Modeling Methods for Surface Prediction
affiliations: Islamic University of Gaza

detail.title: Comparing Spatial Modeling Methods for Surface Prediction
detail.abstract: Predicting surfaces is a crucial aspect in infrastructure projects, particularly in road construction. Currently, technological advancements allow for the creation of new automated algorithms that improve accuracy. This study intends to use spatial modeling methods to predict surfaces, this can be achieved by determining which of the interpolators is best appropriate for surface prediction. The used methodology includes data collection using real and statistical surfaces, surface modeling, as well as statistical analysis. Results reveal that the used surfaces are best modeled using Ordinary Kriging and Splines models. Using the findings of this study, surveyors and civil engineers can enhance the accuracy of earthwork volume calculation. Moreover, results could be utilized to benefit other fields such as environmental and hydrological studies.

AI.tldr: 本研究通过比较多种空间插值方法，发现普通克里金法（Ordinary Kriging）和样条函数法（Splines）对路面表面预测效果最佳，可提高土方量计算精度，并广泛应用于环境和水文研究。
AI.research_question: 哪种空间插值方法最适合用于道路建设中的表面预测？
AI.motivation: 表面预测是基础设施项目（特别是道路建设）的关键环节，技术进步使得开发更精确的自动化算法成为可能，因此需要确定最优的插值方法。
AI.theoretical_framework: 空间建模与插值理论，涉及多种空间插值器（如普通克里金法、样条函数法等）的比较。
AI.method: 使用真实表面和统计表面进行数据收集、表面建模以及统计分析，通过对比不同插值器的表现来确定最优方法。
AI.findings: 普通克里金法（Ordinary Kriging）和样条函数法（Splines）是最适合该研究场景的表面预测模型。
AI.theory_contributions: 验证了普通克里金法和样条函数法在道路表面预测中的优越性，为空间插值方法的选择提供了理论依据。
AI.practical_contributions: 帮助测量师和土木工程师提高土方量计算的准确性；研究结果还可应用于环境研究、水文研究等其他领域。

title: Hedge Ratio Estimation and Risk-Return Dissociation in Pairs Trading: Kalman Filtering under Structural Instability
affiliations: DePaul University - College of Computing and Digital Media

detail.title: Hedge Ratio Estimation and Risk-Return Dissociation in Pairs Trading: Kalman Filtering under Structural Instability

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares no conflicts of interest.
declarations.ethicsApproval: This study uses only publicly available historical market price data. No human subjects, patients, or participants were involved. Ethics approval was not required.
declarations.funderStatement: This research received no external funding.

detail.abstract: When two equities share a long-run co-movement relationship, the ratio of their price sensitivities (the hedge ratio) determines the directional exposure of a pairs trading position. In practice hedge ratios drift as macroeconomic regimes shift, rendering static estimates stale. This paper characterises how the mode of hedge ratio estimation shapes the risk-return profile of pairs trading strategies, rather than asking whether pairs trading is profitable in aggregate. Two hypotheses are tested with econometric discipline: does Kalman-filtered dynamic estimation statistically reduce tail-risk relative to static OLS (H1), and does a two-state Hidden Markov Model (HMM) regime filter further reduce drawdown (H2)? We evaluate seven estimation branches on 50 S&P 500 equities across the structurally demanding 2020-2024 window, which compresses four macroeconomic regimes (COVID-19 shock, quantitative easing recovery, Federal Reserve rate-hike cycle, and AI-driven sector concentration) into five calendar years. This window is an intentionally selected high-instability evaluation period; results should be interpreted as conditional on this environment and may not generalise to calmer or longer samples. A walk-forward cross-validation design with 14 rolling out-of-sample folds prevents in-sample overfitting; BCa bootstrap confidence intervals on the annualised Sharpe ratio and Wilcoxon signed-rank tests on fold-level differences provide formal inference. In this demanding environment, all seven branches produce negative net-of-cost fold-mean Sharpe ratios, confirming that 28-bps round-trip transaction costs consume gross alpha at the 2.3-day average holding periods generated by the Kalman branches. Static OLS achieves a foldmean Sharpe of-0.157 versus-2.080 for Kalman (OLS dominant in 12 of 14 folds), driven 1 by the Kalman filter's 54% higher trade turnover (932 vs. 607 pooled trades) that amplifies cost drag. Despite lower net Sharpe, Kalman reduces fold-mean maximum drawdown by 71% relative to OLS (-0.31% vs.-1.07%), a dissociation of return from risk that is the paper's central empirical finding. For H2, HMM conditioning further reduces fold-mean MaxDD by 30% (to-0.22%, Wilcoxon p < 0.001) while cutting trade frequency by 45%. A mechanism decomposition (Branch D) shows Kalman's drawdown advantage is consistent with a structural explanation: short holding periods alone do not replicate it; a posterior variance entry gate (Branch F) partially repairs signal quality (52.7%→54.8% win rate) and improves fold-mean Sharpe to-1.38. The estimated Kalman-OLS cost breakeven is 6-7 bps one-way, suggesting that Kalman may be competitive at direct-market-access execution costs while retaining its drawdown advantage.

AI.tldr: 本文在2020-2024高波动窗口下，比较了静态OLS、卡尔曼滤波和隐马尔可夫模型（HMM）三种对冲比率估计方法在配对交易中的风险收益表现。核心发现：卡尔曼滤波虽降低了净夏普比率（因高换手率放大交易成本），但显著降低了最大回撤（比OLS低71%）；HMM进一步降低回撤30%并减少交易频率45%。
AI.research_question: 对冲比率估计方法（静态OLS vs. 卡尔曼滤波动态估计 vs. HMM制度滤波）如何影响配对交易策略的风险-收益特征？
AI.motivation: 实践中对冲比率会随宏观制度变迁而漂移，静态估计失效。现有文献多关注配对交易的整体盈利性，而非估计方法对风险收益轮廓的塑造机制。本文旨在填补这一空白，并利用2020-2024这一压缩了四种宏观制度的高波动窗口进行严格检验。
AI.theoretical_framework: 配对交易中的对冲比率漂移理论；卡尔曼滤波的动态状态估计框架；隐马尔可夫模型的制度切换模型；交易成本对策略净收益的侵蚀机制。
AI.method: 基于50只标普500成分股，评估7种估计分支（静态OLS、卡尔曼滤波、HMM条件滤波等）。采用滚动窗口交叉验证（14个滚动样本外折叠），以年化夏普比率和最大回撤为核心指标，使用BCa自助法置信区间和Wilcoxon符号秩检验进行统计推断。
AI.findings: 1）所有7种分支在扣除28基点双边交易成本后，折叠平均夏普比率均为负值；2）静态OLS在14个折叠中12个优于卡尔曼滤波（折叠平均夏普-0.157 vs -2.080），主因卡尔曼换手率高出54%导致成本损耗更大；3）卡尔曼滤波虽夏普比率更低，但将折叠平均最大回撤降低了71%（-0.31% vs -1.07%），收益与风险出现分离——这是本文核心发现；4）HMM条件滤波进一步降低最大回撤30%，同时减少交易频率45%；5）机制分解表明卡尔曼的回撤优势具有结构性解释，短持有期无法复制该效果；6）卡尔曼与OLS的成本盈亏平衡点约为单边6-7基点。
AI.theory_contributions: 揭示了动态估计方法（卡尔曼滤波）在配对交易中导致收益与风险分离的理论机制——高换手率降低净收益但显著降低尾部风险；阐明了HMM制度滤波在降低回撤和减少交易频率方面的增量贡献。
AI.practical_contributions: 为配对交易 practitioners 提供了估计方法选择的量化依据：若追求回撤控制，卡尔曼滤波（尤其结合HMM）显著优于静态OLS；但需注意交易成本，在直接市场接入（DMA）的低成本环境下卡尔曼才可能具有竞争力；给出了具体的成本盈亏平衡点（单边6-7基点）作为实践参考。

title: From Lifeline to System: 988 Implementation Disparities
affiliations: University of La Verne

detail.title: From Lifeline to System: 988 Implementation Disparities

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares no known financial or personal conflicts of interest that could have appeared to influence the work presented in this paper.
declarations.ethicsApproval: This paper does not involve human subjects research, patient data, or participant interviews. Ethics approval was therefore not required.
declarations.funderStatement: This research received no external funding.

detail.abstract:
This working paper examines implementation disparities within the 988 Suicide & Crisis Lifeline system and argues that the primary limitations of 988 stem not from the concept itself, but from fragmented state-level infrastructure, uneven operational capacity, and inconsistent implementation systems.

While 988 established a nationally standardized front-end access point for mental health crisis response, backend crisis infrastructure, including mobile crisis teams, stabilization centers, workforce capacity, and interstate coordination, remains highly variable across states. As a result, individuals who access the same national hotline may experience substantially different levels of care depending on their geographic location.

Drawing upon implementation theory, public administration frameworks, and policyscape analysis, this paper proposes a federal-state partnership model for incentives designed to strengthen crisis response infrastructure while preserving state-level flexibility. The paper argues that achieving equitable crisis care requires moving beyond symbolic policy adoption toward sustained institutional investment, implementation support, and coordinated infrastructure development.

AI.tldr: 本文研究988自杀与危机生命线系统的实施差异，指出其核心问题不在于概念本身，而在于碎片化的州级基础设施、不均衡的运营能力和不一致的实施体系。作者提出联邦-州合作的激励模型，以在保留州级灵活性的同时加强危机应对基础设施。
AI.research_question: 988自杀与危机生命线系统在实施过程中存在哪些州际差异？如何通过政策设计解决这些实施不均衡问题？
AI.motivation: 尽管988建立了全国统一的前端危机接入点，但后端危机响应基础设施（如流动危机团队、稳定中心、人员配置和州际协调）在各州之间存在高度差异，导致同一全国热线因地理位置不同而产生不同级别的护理水平，这引发了公平性问题。
AI.theoretical_framework: 实施理论、公共管理框架、政策景观分析
AI.method: 理论研究与政策分析，基于实施理论、公共管理框架和政策景观分析构建联邦-州合作模型。
AI.findings: 988系统的核心限制并非来自概念本身，而是来自碎片化的州级基础设施、不均衡的运营能力和不一致的实施体系。实现公平的危机护理需要从象征性的政策采纳转向持续的制度投资、实施支持和协调的基础设施发展。
AI.theory_contributions: 将实施理论和公共管理框架应用于精神健康危机响应系统的分析，丰富了政策景观分析在精神健康服务领域的应用。
AI.practical_contributions: 提出联邦-州合作激励模型，为政策制定者提供了在保留州级灵活性的同时加强危机响应基础设施的具体路径，有助于推动988系统从象征性采纳走向实质性实施。

title: Estimating and Assessing Identification of Structural Models via Deep Learning
affiliations: University of Southern California - Marshall School of Business and University of Pennsylvania - The Wharton School

detail.title: Estimating and Assessing Identification of Structural Models via Deep Learning
detail.abstract: We study using neural nets to process an entire dataset and produce an estimate for a structural econometric model (e.g., discrete choice, consumer search). To make training feasible, the neural net uses an architecture that exploits the i.i.d. structure common in empirical data. We show that with sufficient training on simulated datasets, this neural net converges to the full-information posterior. The approach allows accurate, full-information estimation for models where likelihood simulation is impractical or challenging. It also provides a tool to assess empirical identification. We apply it to a sequential search model with unobserved heterogeneity.

AI.tldr: 本文研究使用神经网络处理整个数据集来估计结构计量模型（如离散选择、消费者搜索）。通过利用经验数据中常见的i.i.d.结构设计神经网络架构，并在模拟数据集上进行充分训练，神经网络能够收敛到全信息后验。该方法允许在似然模拟不可行或具有挑战性的情况下进行准确的全信息估计，并为评估经验识别提供了工具。作者将该方法应用于具有未观测异质性的序贯搜索模型。
AI.research_question: 如何利用神经网络处理整个数据集来估计结构计量经济模型，并在似然模拟不可行的情况下实现全信息后验估计？
AI.motivation: 传统的结构计量模型估计面临似然函数计算复杂或不可行的挑战，需要开发新的方法来实现准确的全信息估计。
AI.theoretical_framework: 神经网络架构设计利用了经验数据中常见的i.i.d.结构；神经网络通过充分训练可收敛到全信息后验。
AI.method: 设计特定架构的神经网络处理整个数据集，在模拟数据上训练，利用i.i.d.结构提高训练可行性。
AI.findings: 该方法能在似然模拟不可行或困难时实现准确的全信息估计；可评估经验识别问题；成功应用于具有未观测异质性的序贯搜索模型。
AI.theory_contributions: 证明了神经网络通过充分训练可以收敛到全信息后验，为结构计量模型的估计提供了新的理论框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 提供了一种在似然模拟不可行或具有挑战性时进行全信息估计的实用方法；提供评估经验识别的工具；通过序贯搜索模型应用展示了方法的有效性。

title: When AI Is Not Force Majeure -The Hangzhou Ruling (Zhou v. Tech Co., 2026) and the Legal Limits of Causal Imputation of Automation in Labor Law

detail.title: When AI Is Not Force Majeure -The Hangzhou Ruling (Zhou v. Tech Co., 2026) and the Legal Limits of Causal Imputation of Automation in Labor Law
detail.abstract: This paper analyzes the ruling of the Hangzhou Intermediate People's Court of 28 April 2026 (Zhou v. Tech Co.), which declared unlawful the dismissal of a worker whose position had been absorbed by an AI system based on large language models. It is argued that the ruling's conceptual contribution lies less in concrete labor protection than in the underlying interpretive operation: the refusal to treat AI adoption as a "major change in objective circumstances" equivalent to force majeure. That refusal preserves a classical principle of imputationtechnological decisions remain business decisionsand forecloses a possible doctrine of exculpatory technological fatalism. Parallels are drawn with Argentine labor law (art. 247 LCT) and with the EU regime (AI Act 2024/1689 and Platform Work Directive 2024/2831), and the case is read as comparative confirmation of the principle of inverse externality: technological risk is business risk.

AI.tldr: 杭州中院2026年判决认定，因AI大模型取代岗位而解雇员工的行为违法。判决核心贡献不在于具体劳动保护，而在于拒绝将采用AI视为"客观情况重大变化"（等同于不可抗力），从而维持了"技术决策仍是商业决策"的归责原则，排除了"技术宿命论"免责路径。与阿根廷、欧盟法律比较，印证了"反向外部性"原则：技术风险即商业风险。
AI.research_question: 法院应如何认定因AI替代岗位导致劳动者被解雇的法律性质？AI技术的采用是否构成劳动合同法上的"客观情况重大变化"（不可抗力）？
AI.motivation: 随着大语言模型等AI技术的广泛商业应用，企业以"技术原因"为由解雇员工的情形日益增多。若将AI采用等同于不可抗力或客观情况重大变化，将为企业提供"技术宿命论"式的免责路径，从根本上动摇劳动合同保护制度。本案提供了一个司法检验的关键节点。
AI.theoretical_framework: （1）归责原则：技术决策仍是商业决策，企业不能以技术变迁为由转嫁用工风险；（2）"反向外部性"原则：技术风险应被视为商业风险（企业风险），而非不可抗力；（3）比较法框架：阿根廷《劳动合同法》第247条、欧盟《人工智能法案》（2024/1689）及《平台工作指令》（2024/2831）中的相关制度。
AI.method: 案例分析法（中国杭州中院判决的文本分析）、比较法研究（阿根廷、欧盟相关立法与判例）。
AI.findings: （1）法院拒绝将AI采用认定为"客观情况重大变化"；（2）该判决维护了"技术决策是商业决策"的古典归责原则；（3）排除了"技术宿命论"作为企业免责事由的可能；（4）与阿根廷劳动法第247条（技术变动属经营风险）、欧盟AI Act及平台工作指令中关于算法解雇的限制规定，在法理上形成呼应，共同确认了"反向外部性"原则。
AI.theory_contributions: （1）首次在司法层面系统论证了"AI采用≠不可抗力"的法理逻辑；（2）提出了"技术宿命论"作为潜在免责事由并予以排除的概念工具；（3）从中国案例出发，通过比较法验证了"反向外部性"原则的跨法域适用性，为劳动法应对技术变革提供了理论锚点。
AI.practical_contributions: （1）为面临AI替代风险的劳动者提供了司法救济的先例；（2）警示企业在引入AI时不能以此为由免除劳动法义务；（3）为立法者提供了"技术风险归属"的制度设计参考，避免AI成为企业规避用工责任的法律避风港。

title: Old Space, New Space: A Commercial Revolution in Innovation?
affiliations: University of Toronto - Rotman School of Management and University of Calgary

detail.title: Old Space, New Space: A Commercial Revolution in Innovation?
detail.abstract:
The emergence of firms like SpaceX and Blue Origin has made space a leading example of how private enterprise drives innovation, marking what many see as a sharp break between Old Space and New Space. Yet little systematic evidence documents when the transition to this new phase of space innovation occurred and which firms drove it. We use patent data to provide this measurement and find that the largest surge in space innovation occurred in the 1990s, coinciding with demand-side market creation, and preceding the entry of high-profile startups after 2005. Throughout this period and since, incumbent aerospace firms account for most of the space-related patenting, with entrants contributing a growing but minority share. The same geographic regions that dominated space innovation during the post-Apollo era remain dominant today. These patterns are consistent with directed technical change: incumbents direct R&D toward policy-created markets accessible from existing capabilities, while entrants bring science-based insights into domains requiring new paradigms. Our findings suggest that New Space is more closely connected to Old Space than prevailing narratives imply, and that government's most consequential role in space innovation may lie in constructing appropriable markets. We make patent data on space-related technologies available for future research.

Institutional subscribers to the NBER working paper series, and residents of developing countries may download this paper without additional charge at www.nber.org.

AI.tldr: 本文利用专利数据系统性地分析了太空创新的历史演变，发现最大规模的太空创新浪潮发生在1990年代，而非2005年后新兴航天公司（如SpaceX、Blue Origin）进入的时期。在位航天企业贡献了大部分太空相关专利，新进入者份额虽在增长但仍居少数。地理分布上，后阿波罗时代的主导区域至今仍保持优势。研究表明"新太空"与"旧太空"之间的联系比普遍叙事更为紧密，政府最重要的角色在于构建可供企业获取的市场。
AI.research_question: 太空创新从"旧太空"到"新太空"的转型何时发生？哪些企业真正推动了这一转型？新进入者与在位企业在创新中的角色有何不同？
AI.motivation: 尽管SpaceX、Blue Origin等企业的崛起使太空被视为私营企业驱动创新的典范，但现有文献缺乏系统性证据来记录这一转型发生的时间和推动者，作者希望填补这一实证空白。
AI.theoretical_framework: 定向技术变革理论（Directed Technical Change）：在位企业将研发投向政策创造的市场，利用现有能力；新进入者则利用科学基础洞察进入需要新范式的领域。
AI.method: 利用专利数据对太空相关技术进行系统性计量分析，追溯从后阿波罗时代至今的太空创新演变趋势。
AI.findings: （1）最大太空创新浪潮发生在1990年代，伴随需求侧市场创造，先于2005年后知名初创企业的进入；（2）在位航天企业始终占据大部分太空相关专利，新进入者贡献份额虽增长但仍是少数；（3）后阿波罗时代主导太空创新的地理区域至今仍保持优势；（4）在位企业路径依赖，新进入者带来范式突破。
AI.theory_contributions: 通过实证数据挑战了"新太空"与"旧太空"截然断裂的流行叙事，揭示了二者之间的连续性；验证并丰富了定向技术变革理论在航天产业的应用。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供依据：政府在太空创新中最关键的角色是构建可被企业获取的市场（需求侧政策），而非单纯支持特定企业；公开了太空相关技术专利数据供后续研究使用。

title: Sophisticated Borrowing Constraints and Macroeconomic Dynamics
affiliations: New York University (NYU) - New York University, University of California, Berkeley, University of Chicago - Booth School of Business,  and New York University (NYU) - Department of Economics

detail.title: Sophisticated Borrowing Constraints and Macroeconomic Dynamics
detail.abstract:
In traditional macro-finance models, firms' debt contracts impose hard borrowing constraints, which require indiscriminate reductions of borrowing and investment when adverse shocks tighten these limits, giving rise to financial acceleration. We study the macroeconomic implications of "sophisticated borrowing constraints" akin to financial covenants among large U.S. nonfinancial firms, commonly specified based on firms' debt relative to operating earnings. We model these constraints as debt thresholds that trigger a transfer of control rights to creditors when they are violated, in which case creditors influence firms' decisions to maximize their value instead of cutting credit unconditionally to adhere to fixed ratios. At the micro level, our model is quantitatively consistent with empirical patterns of investment and earnings around covenant violations. At the macro level, sophisticated borrowing constraints do not generate financial acceleration, because constraint tightening and violations do not induce creditors to downscale firms indiscriminately.

Institutional subscribers to the NBER working paper series, and residents of developing countries may download this paper without additional charge at www.nber.org.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了一种“复杂的借款约束”（类似于财务契约）的宏观经济影响。与传统硬性借款约束不同，这类约束在违反时不会导致信贷无条件缩减，而是触发控制权转移给债权人，债权人会以最大化自身价值的方式影响企业决策。微观层面模型与经验数据一致；宏观层面这种约束不会产生金融加速器效应。
AI.research_question: 复杂借款约束（类似于财务契约）在宏观层面是否会产生金融加速器效应？
AI.motivation: 传统宏观金融模型假设硬性借款约束会导致金融加速器效应，但现实中大型美国非金融企业常使用基于财务契约的复杂借款约束，其机制与传统假设不同，需要重新检验其宏观经济影响。
AI.theoretical_framework: 借款约束理论、金融加速器理论、控制权转移理论
AI.method: 构建理论模型，将复杂借款约束建模为债务阈值触发控制权转移，并结合美国大型非金融企业的经验数据进行微观层面的定量校准与验证。
AI.findings: 微观层面模型能定量契合企业投资和盈利在违反契约前后的经验模式；宏观层面复杂借款约束不会产生金融加速器效应，因为约束收紧和违反并不会导致债权人无条件缩减企业规模。
AI.theory_contributions: 挑战了传统硬性借款约束假设下金融加速器效应的普适性，揭示了借款约束设计差异对宏观传导机制的关键影响。
AI.practical_contributions: 为理解大型企业财务契约的真实宏观影响提供了理论基础，提示政策制定者和监管者需区分不同类型的借款约束以避免高估金融加速器风险。

title: The Psychology of Macroeconomic Expectations
affiliations: University of Oxford - Said Business School, , SKEMA Business School, Harvard University, Harvard University - Department of Economics and De Nederlandsche Bank

detail.title: The Psychology of Macroeconomic Expectations
detail.abstract:
We present a model of “animal spirits” in which context and emotions affect macroeconomic beliefs by shaping which experiences people recall to simulate similar future aggregate states. We test this mechanism by priming Dutch National Bank Survey respondents to recall personal financial or health adversities before eliciting inflation and home price expectations. The treatment causes instability in beliefs and reasoning tied to the measured similarity of the primed experiences to different macro states. This similarity structure also accounts for heterogeneity in beliefs and reasoning based on a range of other personal experiences we measure. The model micro founds several features of macroeconomic beliefs, including narratives, and yields a “confidence multiplier”: spending by some agents cues optimistic context for others, raising their spending.

Institutional subscribers to the NBER working paper series, and residents of developing countries may download this paper without additional charge at www.nber.org.

AI.tldr: 本文构建了一个"动物精神"模型，研究情境和情绪如何通过影响人们回忆过往经历来塑造对宏观经济的信念，并通过实验验证了这一机制。
AI.research_question: 情境和情绪如何通过影响个人回忆的相关经历来塑造宏观经济信念（如通胀和房价预期）？
AI.motivation: 传统宏观经济学往往假设理性预期，忽略了情绪、情境和个人经历对信念形成的影响。本文旨在从行为经济学角度微观解释宏观经济信念的形成机制。
AI.theoretical_framework: "动物精神"模型：情境和情绪通过影响人们回忆哪些个人经历（如财务或健康困境）来模拟相似的经济状态，从而影响宏观经济信念。
AI.method: 对荷兰国家银行调查的受访者进行启动实验（priming），在询问通胀和房价预期之前，诱导受访者回忆个人财务或健康方面的逆境。
AI.findings: （1）启动效应导致信念和推理的不稳定性，且这种不稳定性与被启动经历与不同宏观经济状态的测量相似性密切相关。（2）这种相似性结构也能解释基于其他个人经历的信念异质性。（3）该模型微观上解释了宏观经济信念的多项特征，包括叙事，并产生"信心乘数"效应。
AI.theory_contributions: 为宏观经济信念的形成提供了基于"动物精神"的微观基础，将情境、情绪和个人经历纳入理论框架，解释了信念的波动性和异质性。
AI.practical_contributions: 揭示了情绪和情境对经济预期的关键影响，暗示政策制定者可以通过影响公众情绪和"叙事"来调节经济信心和消费行为；"信心乘数"效应表明部分主体的支出可以营造乐观情境，带动整体经济。

title: Divergence in Climate Change Communication: LLM-Based Evidence from the IPCC and the Press
affiliations: Department of Economics,  and University of San Andres (UdeSA)

detail.title: Divergence in Climate Change Communication: LLM-Based Evidence from the IPCC and the Press
detail.abstract:
Public summaries of IPCC climate assessments lean toward the more severe end of the technical evidence. The pattern appears at two stages: the IPCC’s lead authors and member governments produce the Summary for Policymakers (SPM) from the Technical Summary (TS), and newspapers then cover the SPM. We use LLMs to score about 114,000 matched claim pairs from all six Assessment Reports (1990 to 2023) and ten major US and UK outlets. Both stages systematically shift toward the more severe end of the source while staying inside the IPCC’s accepted scientific ranges. The shift comes mainly from emphasizing higher-impact magnitudes within reported ranges, less from uncertainty compression, and almost none from selecting worst-case emissions scenarios. Left- and right-leaning outlets show similar patterns.

Institutional subscribers to the NBER working paper series, and residents of developing countries may download this paper without additional charge at www.nber.org.

AI.tldr: IPCC气候评估报告的公共摘要（包括决策者摘要和媒体报道）相对于技术证据存在系统性偏差，倾向于呈现更严重的结论。这种偏差主要源于在高影响幅度方面的强调，而非不确定性压缩或选择最坏情景。
AI.research_question: IPCC气候评估报告的公共摘要是否以及如何在技术证据基础上发生系统性偏差？
AI.motivation: 理解气候科学信息从技术报告到政策摘要再到媒体报道的传递过程中是否存在系统性偏向，这对气候政策的科学传播可信度至关重要。
AI.theoretical_framework: 信息传递中的偏差理论；科学传播中的"严重性偏向"假说。
AI.method: 使用大语言模型（LLMs）对来自全部六次IPCC评估报告（1990-2023年）以及英美十家主要媒体的约114,000组匹配声明对进行评分。
AI.findings: 1) SPM和媒体报道相对于技术摘要均系统性偏向更严重的一端；2) 这种偏向主要来自强调报告范围内的高影响幅度；3) 不确定性压缩贡献较小；4) 几乎不来自选择最坏排放情景；5) 左右翼媒体呈现相似模式。
AI.theory_contributions: 首次系统量化了IPCC科学评估从技术报告到政策摘要再到媒体报道的"严重性偏向"现象，并识别了该偏向的主要来源。
AI.practical_contributions: 为IPCC及类似科学评估机构的信息传播流程设计提供了改进依据，帮助政策制定者和公众更准确地理解气候科学的不确定性和风险范围。

title: Valuing Disaster Prevention: Desert Locust Monitoring and Control
affiliations: , University of Toulouse Capitole - Toulouse School of Economics, Stockholm University - Institute for International Economic Studies (IIES), Stockholm University, Harris Public Policy, University of Chicago , University of California, San Diego (UCSD) - School of Global Policy & Strategy and University of Chicago

detail.title: Valuing Disaster Prevention: Desert Locust Monitoring and Control
detail.abstract:
Monitoring systems for disaster prevention are costly, and measuring benefits is difficult when monitoring effort is endogenous. We provide the first causal estimate of one such system's impact using three decades of desert locust monitoring data. We document conflict-induced interruptions to monitoring in remote breeding areas, reconstruct how infestations spread to populated areas, and show that exposure to locust swarms around birth decreases child height-for-age, increasing stunting risk by over 7 percentage points. Eliminating the locust monitoring system would induce annual losses of US$25 billion, implying a benefit-cost ratio between 160:1 and 680:1 from child nutrition benefits alone.

Institutional subscribers to the NBER working paper series, and residents of developing countries may download this paper without additional charge at www.nber.org.

AI.tldr: 本文利用三十年沙漠蝗虫监测数据，首次因果估计了灾害预防监测系统的影响。研究发现冲突导致的监测中断使蝗灾扩散到人口密集区，新生儿接触蝗群会降低身高别体重Z评分，增加超过7个百分点的发育迟缓风险。消除该系统每年造成250亿美元损失，仅儿童营养效益的成本效益比就达160:1至680:1。
AI.research_question: 灾害预防监测系统（以沙漠蝗虫监测为例）对儿童健康影响的因果效应是什么？其经济效益如何？
AI.motivation: 灾害监测系统成本高昂，且当监测努力为内生时，衡量其效益十分困难。现有文献缺乏对此类系统因果影响的实证估计。
AI.theoretical_framework: 冲突影响监测中断→蝗灾扩散→儿童早期暴露冲击→长期人力资本（身高发育）的因果链条。
AI.method: 利用三十年的沙漠蝗虫监测面板数据，结合冲突导致的监测中断作为外生变异，构建自然实验，进行因果识别。
AI.findings: （1）冲突中断了偏远繁殖地的监测；（2）监测中断导致蝗灾向人口密集区扩散；（3）出生时暴露于蝗群使儿童身高别体重Z评分下降，发育迟缓风险增加超过7个百分点；（4）消除监测系统每年造成250亿美元损失，效益成本比为160:1至680:1。
AI.theory_contributions: 首次为灾害预防监测系统的因果效应提供实证证据；揭示了冲突→监测中断→环境冲击→人力资本损失的传导机制；量化了早期环境冲击对儿童长期发展的影响。
AI.practical_contributions: 为灾害监测系统的投资决策提供了直接的经济效益依据（仅儿童营养一项就具有极高的成本效益比）；强调了冲突地区监测中断的严重后果，对防灾政策和国际援助具有重要启示。

title: The Limits of Political Representation: Evidence from India
affiliations: New York University (NYU) - New York University, Abu Dhabi and University of Southern California

detail.title: The Limits of Political Representation: Evidence from India
detail.abstract:
Political inclusion is widely believed to improve governance, motivating the creation of elected representatives for highly localized constituencies. This paper studies 1.2 million "hyperlocal" representatives across 150,000 local governments in rural India. Exploiting discontinuities that determine the number and identity of these representatives, we assess how expanded representation affects governance outcomes. We find precisely estimated null effects on core functions, including public project management, intermediation in access to benefit programs, alignment of policy with citizen preferences, equity of benefit allocation, and oversight of public finances. These findings highlight the limits of expanding political representation if representative capacity is weak.

Institutional subscribers to the NBER working paper series, and residents of developing countries may download this paper without additional charge at www.nber.org.

AI.tldr: 本研究分析了印度农村15万个地方政府中120万名“超本地化”代表的影响，发现尽管这些代表旨在改善治理，但在公共项目管理、福利获取、政策匹配、资源分配公平和财政监督等核心职能上均无显著效果，揭示了在代表能力薄弱时扩大政治代表的局限性。
AI.research_question: 在印度农村的超本地化政治代表制度中，扩大基层代表数量是否能够改善治理成果？
AI.motivation: 政治包容被广泛认为能改善治理，因此许多国家设立了高度本地化的民选代表。然而，这一假设缺乏有力的因果证据，尤其是在代表能力较弱的环境中。
AI.theoretical_framework: 政治代表理论、地方治理理论、能力约束视角
AI.method: 利用决定代表数量和身份的断点回归设计（RDD），分析150,000个地方政府中120万名代表的数据。
AI.findings: 扩大超本地化代表在公共项目管理、福利项目中介服务、政策与公民偏好匹配、福利分配公平性以及公共财政监督等核心治理职能上均无显著影响（精确估计的零效应）。
AI.theory_contributions: 挑战了“政治包容必然改善治理”的传统理论假设，揭示了代表能力（而非仅仅代表数量）是治理改善的关键条件，丰富了政治代表制与治理效能关系的理论边界。
AI.practical_contributions: 为发展中国家和地区的地方治理改革提供重要警示：单纯扩大政治代表覆盖面而忽视代表能力建设，可能无法带来预期的治理改善效果；政策制定应更注重代表的能力培养与制度支持。

title: Trust, Financial Literacy, and Financial Behaviors: Shaping Retirement Security
affiliations: Hebrew University of Jerusalem and Bank of Israel, Stanford University - Stanford Institute for Economic Policy Research and

detail.title: Trust, Financial Literacy, and Financial Behaviors: Shaping Retirement Security
detail.abstract:
We extend the literature on the importance of trust for financial behaviors by examining trust, financial literacy, and financial behavior related to retirement security. Using the Health and Retirement Study, we show that Trust in Financial Institutions aligns with behaviors supportive of retirement security, while Trust in Government Programs does not. We further document racial/ethnic differences: for White respondents, Trust in Financial Institutions relates positively to retirement outcomes, but not for Blacks or Hispanics. Moreover, Trust in Government Programs among minority households is linked to reduced stockholding and lower wealth accumulation. These findings inform efforts to strengthen retirement security.

Institutional subscribers to the NBER working paper series, and residents of developing countries may download this paper without additional charge at www.nber.org.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了信任、金融素养与退休安全相关的金融行为之间的关系，发现对金融机构的信任有助于退休安全行为，但对政府项目的信任则不然，且存在显著的种族/民族差异。
AI.research_question: 信任（对金融机构 vs. 政府项目）和金融素养如何影响退休安全的金融行为？这种关系是否存在种族/民族差异？
AI.motivation: 已有文献表明信任对金融行为至关重要，但不同类型信任（对金融机构 vs. 政府项目）对退休安全的影响是否不同，以及这种影响是否存在种族/民族层面的异质性，尚缺乏深入研究。
AI.theoretical_framework: 信任理论、金融素养理论、行为金融学
AI.method: 使用健康与退休研究（Health and Retirement Study）数据，进行定量实证分析。
AI.findings: （1）对金融机构的信任与有利于退休安全的行为正相关，但对政府项目的信任则不然；（2）白人受访者中，对金融机构的信任与退休结果正相关，但黑人和西班牙裔中无此关系；（3）少数族裔家庭对政府项目的信任与股票持有减少和财富积累降低相关。
AI.theory_contributions: 区分了不同类型信任对退休金融行为的差异化影响，揭示了信任效应的种族/民族异质性，拓展了信任与金融行为关系的理论边界。
AI.practical_contributions: 为制定针对不同种族/民族群体的退休安全保障政策提供了实证依据，提示在提升退休安全时需考虑信任的差异化作用。

title: Lands of Opportunity: Differences in the Geography of Wealth and Income Mobility in the United States
affiliations: U.S. Census Bureau, Carnegie Mellon University and U.S. Census Bureau

detail.title: Lands of Opportunity: Differences in the Geography of Wealth and Income Mobility in the United States
detail.abstract:
We provide new county-level estimates of intergenerational mobility, covering multiple economic concepts: total income, labor income, homeownership, housing wealth, and total wealth. This is possible via small-area estimation techniques and linked survey and administrative data covering millions of U.S. children born between 1978 and 1986. We find that relative mobility in wealth concepts shows less spatial clustering and more spatial variation than relative mobility in income concepts. Many cities and their suburbs exhibit lower relative mobility (i.e. higher intergenerational persistence) in wealth concepts than in income concepts. Next, we show that various local characteristics are associated with some concepts of economic mobility but not with others. For example, we estimate a strong negative association between the local severity of the Great Recession and child income, regardless of parent position in the income distribution. However, the negative association between recession severity and wealth only exists among children from poorer families. We provide a public-use data package to facilitate further research.

Institutional subscribers to the NBER working paper series, and residents of developing countries may download this paper without additional charge at www.nber.org.

AI.tldr: 利用小区域估计方法和数千万美国儿童的关联调查与行政数据，提供了县一级的代际流动性新估计，涵盖收入、劳动收入、房屋所有权、住房财富和总财富等多个经济概念。
AI.research_question: 美国县一级的代际流动性在不同经济概念（收入与财富）上如何分布？地方特征如何与不同概念的流动性相关联？
AI.motivation: 现有代际流动性研究多聚焦于收入，缺乏对财富等更广泛经济概念的县级估计，限制了理解流动性的多维空间分布及其驱动因素。
AI.theoretical_framework: 代际流动性理论、小区域估计方法、多维经济概念比较框架
AI.method: 小区域估计技术；利用1978-1986年出生的数百万美国儿童的调查与行政关联数据，构建县级代际流动性估计。
AI.findings: 1）财富概念的相对流动性比收入概念的空间聚集性更弱、空间变异性更强；2）许多城市及其郊区在财富概念上的流动性较低（代际持续性更强）；3）地方特征对不同经济概念的影响不同：大衰退严重程度与所有儿童的收入负相关，但仅与贫困家庭儿童的财富负相关。
AI.theory_contributions: 首次系统提供涵盖收入与财富多重维度的县级代际流动性估计，揭示了不同经济概念在空间分布和驱动因素上的异质性。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供更精细的流动性地图，有助于针对不同地区和不同经济维度制定差异化政策；公开数据包便于后续研究。

title: Proposed Mergers Where Efficiencies Are Needed Most Might Be the Least Likely to Deliver Them
affiliations: Columbia University, International Monetary Fund (IMF) and University of Chicago - Booth School of Business

detail.title: Proposed Mergers Where Efficiencies Are Needed Most Might Be the Least Likely to Deliver Them
detail.abstract:
Mergers are commonly evaluated by weighing their expected market power effects against any efficiency gains they create. The larger the market power effect of a proposed merger, the larger must be any efficiencies for it to raise social welfare. We show selection into merger proposal distorts the observed relationship between market power and efficiency effects. Even if market power and efficiency gains are independent (or even positively correlated) across all potential mergers, they will generally be negatively related among proposed mergers. This is because parties propose to merge only if the merger’s expected profitability exceeds a threshold, so the underlying components of profitability become substitutes in clearing that hurdle. It does not rely on managerial bias, behavioral frictions, or strategic misrepresentation. We demonstrate this negative correlation is present under very general conditions when the two effects are uncorrelated among all mergers. We also characterize conditions where this still holds even in the presence of positive underlying correlations and firms’ uncertainty about their own merger’s profitability. Policies that might raise the selection hurdle for proposed mergers do not alleviate the negative correlation; indeed, they would exacerbate it. Our analysis has direct implications for interpreting empirical merger retrospectives and for evaluating efficiency defenses in antitrust policy.

Institutional subscribers to the NBER working paper series, and residents of developing countries may download this paper without additional charge at www.nber.org.

AI.tldr: 本文揭示了并购提案中的“选择偏差”：即便市场势力与效率提升在潜在并购中相互独立（甚至正相关），在已提案的并购中两者也会呈现负相关关系，因为企业只会提案那些预期盈利超过阈值的并购，导致两个成分在“过线”时相互替代。
AI.research_question: 并购提案中的选择偏差如何扭曲市场势力效应与效率提升之间的观察关系？
AI.motivation: 传统的并购评估假定可以在观察到的并购中权衡市场势力与效率，但忽略了“哪些并购被提案”这一选择过程可能系统性地改变两者间的统计关系，导致政策分析偏误。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于并购盈利门槛的选择模型，市场势力与效率作为盈利能力的组成部分，在超过提案阈值时成为替代品。
AI.method: 理论建模与一般性条件推导，不依赖特定分布假设，也考虑了正相关基数和不确定性情形。
AI.findings: 在非常一般的条件下，即使潜在并购中市场势力与效率无关，提案并购中两者必然负相关；即便底层存在正相关，该负相关在多数条件下仍成立；提高提案门槛反而会加剧这一负相关。
AI.theory_contributions: 首次系统论证并购提案的选择偏差本身足以产生市场势力与效率之间的伪负相关，无需依赖管理层偏见或策略性陈述等行为假设。
AI.practical_contributions: 对实证并购回顾研究（retrospectives）的解释和反垄断政策中的效率抗辩评估具有直接指导意义，警示政策制定者注意观察数据中的选择偏差。

title: Energy security and industrial competitiveness: the case for a European Energy Union
affiliations: European Central Bank (ECB), European Central Bank (ECB) and European Central Bank (ECB)

detail.title: Energy security and industrial competitiveness: the case for a European Energy Union
detail.abstract: The European energy market remains heavily reliant on imported fossil fuels and fragmented across Member States. This leaves the EU exposed to high and volatile energy prices, posing risks to its growth outlook and its international competitiveness. As the EU advances its energy security and climate neutrality objectives, the role of electricity and renewable energy is set to increase at the expense of fossil fuels. This paper argues that achieving a genuine European Energy Union would help to reach these goals and identifies five key policy priorities to support this process: strengthening cross-border infrastructure; mobilising innovative green finance; investing in tools to support flexibility and matching of supply and demand; improving the efficiency and harmonisation of energy taxation; and establishing a coherent industrial policy for clean tech.

AI.tldr: 本文认为，建立真正的欧洲能源联盟有助于欧盟实现能源安全和气候中和目标，并提出了五大政策优先事项：加强跨境基础设施、动员创新绿色金融、投资供需匹配与灵活性工具、提高能源税效率与协调性、建立清洁技术产业政策。
AI.research_question: 如何通过建立欧洲能源联盟来应对欧盟能源市场碎片化、进口依赖度高及能源价格波动等问题？
AI.motivation: 欧盟能源市场高度依赖进口化石燃料且成员国之间碎片化严重，导致能源价格高企且波动剧烈，威胁欧盟经济增长和国际竞争力。在推进能源安全和气候中和目标的背景下，需探讨能源联盟的作用和政策路径。
AI.theoretical_framework: 能源联盟理论、区域能源市场一体化理论、能源转型与气候政策理论。
AI.method: 政策分析与论述性研究，基于对欧盟能源市场现状、挑战和政策选项的综合分析。
AI.findings: 建立真正的欧洲能源联盟有助于实现能源安全和气候中和目标；识别出五大关键政策优先事项：跨境基础设施、绿色金融创新、供需匹配灵活性工具、能源税收优化与协调、清洁技术产业政策。
AI.theory_contributions: 系统性地将能源联盟概念与能源安全、气候中和目标联系起来，并提出了具体的政策优先框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 为欧盟政策制定者提供了可操作的政策优先事项清单，指导欧洲能源市场一体化与绿色转型的实践路径。

AI.theory_contributions: 系统梳理了通胀预期与工资关系的理论基础，深化了对通胀传导机制的理解。
AI.practical_contributions: 为货币政策制定者提供了关注通胀预期与工资联动的新视角，有助于更精准地实施宏观调控。

publicationDetails.journalName: Board of Governors: Finance & Economics Discussion Series (Topic)

detail.abstract: Outstanding mortgage debt in the commercial real estate (CRE) sector totaled $6 trillion at the end of 2024 including owner-occupied and nonowner-occupied real estate, multifamily mortgages, and loans backed by acquisition, development, and construction projects. Banks hold half of all CRE debt, with regional and small institutions (under $100 billion in assets) collectively accounting for a larger share of this lending than their larger counterparts with assets over $100 billion.

AI.tldr: 截至2024年底，美国商业房地产（CRE）未偿抵押债务总额达6万亿美元，其中银行持有半数，而区域性小型机构（资产低于1000亿美元）在CRE贷款中的占比超过大型银行。
AI.research_question: 美国商业房地产抵押债务的规模、结构及不同规模银行在其中的分布情况如何？
AI.motivation: 商业房地产债务规模巨大且高度集中于银行体系，尤其是区域性中小银行，其风险敞口可能对金融稳定构成潜在威胁，需厘清债务规模和机构分布。
AI.theoretical_framework: 金融中介理论、银行风险集中度与系统性风险理论
AI.method: 基于美联储等官方数据的统计分析
AI.findings: 1) CRE未偿抵押债务总额达6万亿美元；2) 银行持有其中一半（约3万亿美元）；3) 资产低于1000亿美元的区域性和小型银行在CRE贷款中的合计份额超过资产超1000亿美元的大型银行。
AI.theory_contributions: 揭示了CRE债务在银行体系内的非对称分布特征，为中小银行风险集聚理论提供了实证支持。
AI.practical_contributions: 提醒监管机构关注区域性中小银行在CRE贷款中的高集中度风险，为宏观审慎监管政策提供数据依据。

AI.research_question: 稳定币如何从加密市场基础设施演变为传统交易账户的潜在竞争者，其在支付处理、结算功能及短期价值储存方面的竞争力如何？

AI.theoretical_framework: 数字货币经济学、支付系统理论、货币竞争理论
AI.method: 基于市场数据与政策分析的综合性研究
AI.findings: 稳定币不再仅是加密市场基础设施，已具备与传统交易账户在支付、结算和价值储存方面竞争的能力。
AI.theory_contributions: 拓展了数字货币与传统银行体系竞争的理论视角，丰富了对稳定币功能定位的理论认识。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者评估稳定币监管框架提供依据，为金融机构应对数字支付竞争提供参考。

detail.abstract: Buy Here Pay Here (BHPH) auto dealers occupy a unique position in the auto market by serving as both the seller and financier of vehicles to their customers. This contrasts with traditional auto dealers, who connect buyers to financing options from third-party banks, credit unions, or auto finance companies, including the captive financing arms of auto manufacturers.

AI.tldr: 本文分析了"Buy Here Pay Here"（BHPH）汽车经销商这一特殊商业模式，其主要特点是将汽车销售与融资服务整合于一体，而非像传统经销商那样将买家与第三方金融机构对接。
AI.research_question: BHPH汽车经销商的独特商业模式是什么？它如何与传统汽车经销商在销售和融资模式上形成对比？
AI.motivation: BHPH模式在汽车市场中占据独特位置，同时扮演销售商和融资方角色，与传统经销商的第三方融资模式形成鲜明对比，值得深入研究。
AI.theoretical_framework: 垂直整合理论、商业模式创新理论、金融服务与销售整合理论。
AI.method: 概念分析与对比研究，通过对BHPH模式与传统经销商模式的结构性比较进行阐述。
AI.findings: BHPH经销商与传统的汽车经销商模式存在本质区别：前者集销售与融资于一体，后者则将买家与第三方金融机构（银行、信用合作社、汽车金融公司及汽车制造商的专属金融部门）对接。
AI.theory_contributions: 揭示了BHPH模式作为垂直整合型商业模式的理论独特性，丰富了汽车市场销售与金融服务整合的相关理论。
AI.practical_contributions: 为汽车经销商、金融从业者及政策制定者理解BHPH这一特殊商业模式提供了清晰的对比框架和理论支撑。

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author is the founder of dQuant Capital Management, an investment firm that utilizes quantitative strategies. The theoretical framework presented in this paper, including the Aggregate Perceived Risk (APR) model, informs the proprietary methodologies used by the firm. No external funding was received for this research.
declarations.ethicsApproval: Yes, make my paper Publicly Available.
declarations.funderStatement: The author is the founder and managing director of dQuant Capital Management, a quantitative investment firm. The Aggregate Perceived Risk (APR) framework and the concepts of the Perception Gap discussed in this research are used in the development of the firm's proprietary investment strategies. This research was conducted independently without external funding.

detail.abstract:
This paper introduces the Aggregate Perceived Risk (APR) framework, a unified valuation architecture that mathematically links classical rational expectations with behavioral finance. The core innovation is a shift from the traditional linear, additive pricing model, where price equals intrinsic value plus or minus extrinsic adjustments, to a geometric, exponential formulation in which perception scales value rather than adjusting it. By placing Aggregate Perceived Risk in the denominator and raising it to a structural exponent, the model produces a measurable Perception Gap that captures the nonlinear influence of collective comfort, liquidity, friction, and capital concentration. This structure explains why markets routinely exhibit bubbles, crashes, fat tails, and violent regime shifts that linear models cannot mathematically reproduce and therefore misclassify as anomalies.

By incorporating perception and structural constraints directly into the pricing mechanism, the APR framework provides a probabilistic observational method that allows practitioners to gauge when the perception gap is widening to a degree that makes a directional reversion toward intrinsic value increasingly likely. Because the Perception Gap expands and contracts in systematic, quantifiable ways, the model establishes conditions under which persistent alpha becomes attainable through the detection of perception‑driven mispricing. APR therefore transforms financial analysis from a qualitative description of sentiment into a rigorous, structurally grounded science of market dynamics.

AI.tldr: 本文提出聚合感知风险（APR）框架，将传统线性定价模型转变为几何指数形式，通过将感知风险置于分母并引入结构指数，生成可测量的"感知差距"，从而解释泡沫、崩盘、肥尾等市场现象，并将金融分析从定性描述转化为结构化科学。
AI.research_question: 如何将行为金融中的感知因素与理性预期理论进行数学统一，以解释线性模型无法捕捉的市场非线性现象？
AI.motivation: 传统线性定价模型（价格=内在价值±外部调整）无法数学上复现泡沫、崩盘、肥尾和剧烈制度转换等市场现象，往往将其误分类为"异常"，亟需一种能将感知纳入定价机制的结构化框架。
AI.theoretical_framework: 聚合感知风险（APR）框架：采用几何指数形式定价，将感知风险置于分母并引入结构指数，使感知对价值产生缩放效应而非调整效应，生成可量化的感知差距。
AI.method: 理论建模：构建几何指数化定价公式；引入概率观测方法，通过感知差距的扩大与收缩进行可量化的方向性回归预测。
AI.findings: 感知差距以系统化、可量化的方式扩张与收缩；在感知驱动错误定价可被检测的条件下，持续阿尔法收益变得可实现。
AI.theory_contributions: 将行为金融中的感知因素从定性描述提升为严格的结构化市场动力学科学；在数学架构上统一理性预期与行为金融。
AI.practical_contributions: 为从业者提供概率观测方法，用以判断感知差距扩大到何种程度时方向性回归趋于可能；为获取持续阿尔法收益提供结构化基础。

detail.abstract: Trade finance encompasses a range of financial instruments and services designed to facilitate international trade. U.S. banks are key providers of these services. AI.tldr: 本文利用美国监管数据，分析了贸易融资在美国国际贸易中的规模、集中度及随时间变化的趋势。研究发现，贸易融资支撑了相当大份额的国际贸易，高度集中于大型美国银行，且其规模随时间推移有所下降。
AI.research_question: 美国贸易融资在国际贸易中的作用、集中度及时间趋势如何？
AI.motivation: 贸易融资是促进国际贸易的关键金融服务，但关于其规模、银行集中度和长期趋势的系统性实证证据有限。本文旨在填补这一空白，为政策制定者和研究者提供基于监管数据的量化分析。
AI.theoretical_framework: 国际贸易金融理论、银行中介理论
AI.method: 基于多项美国监管数据源的描述性统计分析
AI.findings: 1）贸易融资支撑了美国相当大份额的国际贸易；2）该服务高度集中于大型美国银行；3）贸易融资的整体规模随时间推移呈下降趋势。
AI.theory_contributions: 提供了关于贸易融资规模、集中度和时间趋势的系统性实证证据，丰富了国际贸易金融领域的研究。
AI.practical_contributions: 为监管机构了解贸易融资市场结构、评估大型银行系统性风险，以及为贸易政策制定提供数据支撑和参考。

title: Absolute Strategic Vacuum - An Analysis Of The Invisibility Of Civil Servants With Disabilities In The Institutional Development Plans Of Brazilian Federal Universities

detail.title: Absolute Strategic Vacuum - An Analysis Of The Invisibility Of Civil Servants With Disabilities In The Institutional Development Plans Of Brazilian Federal Universities

declarations.declarationOfInterest: Does not apply
declarations.ethicsApproval: Does not apply
declarations.funderStatement: FAPESC - Fundação de Amparo à Pesquisa e Inovação de Santa Catarina (Brazil)

detail.abstract: This article presents the ndings of a study that investigated the gap between inclusive discourse and the people-management practices directed at persons with disabilities (PWDs) in Brazilian federal universities, examining the extent to which Institutional Development Plans (IDPs) incorporate policies for the professional development and advancement of federal civil servants with disabilities. Through a qualitative-quantitative documentary analysis of the current IDPs of all 69 federal universities, the results reveal the complete absence of strategically planned actions for this group, with 0% of the documents presenting policies, goals, or career-related measures specically targeting federal civil servants with disabilities. The analysis demonstrates that, whereas student inclusion is a recurring theme, career management for civil servants with disabilities is systematically rendered invisible, constituting what the authors term an absolute strategic vacuum. It is concluded that this omission, interpreted through the lens of structural ableism, is not accidental but rather a systemic failure of governance and accountability. By remaining silent on the career development of their own civil servants, federal universities reinforce attitudinal barriers, undermine belonging, and perpetuate exclusion in direct opposition to current legislation and to the principles of public administration. The study argues for the urgent promotion of eective and ecient inclusion and equity through institutional policies in the forthcoming IDP cycles, most of which are not scheduled to occur until 2030.

AI.tldr: 本文通过对巴西69所联邦大学的机构发展计划进行文献分析，发现所有大学均未针对残疾公务员制定任何战略性职业发展政策，存在"绝对战略真空"，揭示了包容性话语与人员管理实践之间的巨大鸿沟。
AI.research_question: 巴西联邦大学的机构发展计划在多大程度上纳入了针对残疾公务员的职业发展与晋升政策？
AI.motivation: 揭示包容性话语与针对残疾人士的人事管理实践之间的差距，检验巴西联邦大学在内部人事管理层面是否真正践行了包容性理念。
AI.theoretical_framework: 结构性能力主义（Structural Ableism）——将系统性忽视残疾公务员职业发展的现象解释为一种结构性的治理与问责失败。
AI.method: 对巴西全部69所联邦大学的现行机构发展计划进行定性与定量相结合的文献分析。
AI.findings: 0%的机构发展计划包含针对残疾公务员的政策、目标或职业相关措施；学生包容是常见主题，但残疾公务员的职业管理系统性被忽视，形成"绝对战略真空"。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出"绝对战略真空"概念，从结构性能力主义视角阐释组织层面对残疾人士系统性忽视的机制，丰富了组织包容性与残障研究的理论框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 揭示巴西联邦大学在残疾公务员人事管理中的系统性失败，呼吁在下一轮机构发展计划（多数预计2030年）中紧急制定有效的包容性与公平性政策。

title: Buffering the Storm: Firm Exposure to Social Unrest and Environmental and Social Disclosure
affiliations: Lehigh University - College of Business and Dalhousie University

detail.title: Buffering the Storm: Firm Exposure to Social Unrest and Environmental and Social Disclosure
detail.abstract: This study investigates the impact of social unrest on environmental and social disclosure quality. We first develop a firm-level measure of exposure to social unrest (FESU) and then examine the impact of this measure on environmental and social disclosure (ESD). Our main results show that firms with greater exposure to social unrest reduce their substantive disclosures while increasing their boilerplate disclosures. We also find that country-level factors, including macroeconomic stability, environmental and social norms, and capital market development, play a significant role in shaping the relationship between FESU and ESD. The impact of FESU on boilerplate ESD is concentrated among large firms and firms with low growth opportunities, while the impact of FESU on substantive ESD is comparatively less sensitive to firm heterogeneity. Finally, we show that FESU has no impact on substantive ESD in countries with mandatory ESG reporting.

AI.tldr: 本研究构建了企业层面社会动荡暴露度（FESU）指标，发现社会动荡暴露度越高的企业会减少实质性环境与社会披露，增加模板化披露；国家层面因素和企业异质性对此关系有调节作用，且强制ESG报告能消除对实质性披露的负面影响。
AI.research_question: 社会动荡如何影响企业环境与社会披露（ESD）质量？
AI.motivation: 社会动荡事件频发，但鲜有研究从企业层面量化其对社会责任信息披露质量的影响，尤其是区分实质性披露与模板化披露。
AI.theoretical_framework: 信号理论、合法性理论、制度理论
AI.method: 构建企业层面社会动荡暴露度（FESU）指标；实证分析FESU对ESD质量的影响；考虑国家层面因素（宏观经济稳定性、环境与社会规范、资本市场发展）和企业异质性的调节作用。
AI.findings: ①FESU越高，企业实质性ESD减少、模板化ESD增加；②国家宏观经济稳定、ES规范、资本市场发展显著调节该关系；③模板化ESD影响集中于大型企业和低增长企业；④强制ESG报告国家中FESU对实质性ESD无显著影响。
AI.theory_contributions: 首次从企业层面衡量社会动荡暴露度，并揭示其对企业披露策略的差异化影响（实质性vs.模板化），丰富了合法性理论与信号理论在社会动荡情境下的应用。
AI.practical_contributions: 为企业管理者、投资者和监管者提供启示：社会动荡环境下，企业倾向于象征性披露而非实质性改进；强制ESG报告制度可缓解该负面效应，为政策制定提供依据。

title: Humankind as a System. Part 1 [Series Paper #5]: The Super-Invention Taxonomy and Direction of Humankind
affiliations: Independent

detail.title: Humankind as a System. Part 1 [Series Paper #5]: The Super-Invention Taxonomy and Direction of Humankind

declarations.ethicsApproval: There were no patients/participants in this study.
declarations.funderStatement: This work was not funded by anybody.

detail.abstract:
Note: This version has been updated to reflect current terminology. The terms 'resource' and 'resource group' used in the original 2020 publication have been replaced with 'super-invention' and 'class of super-Inventions' to align with the Super-Invention Taxonomy and Direction of Humankind Series. Original source: Torvich V.V. Humankind as a system. Part 1. Slozhnyye systemy [The complex systems]. 2020. No. 1 (7). P. 61-72. This paper constitutes one of the core components of the System Definition Phase within the broader research series: The Super-Invention Taxonomy and Direction of Humankind.

For an in-depth understanding of the processes underlying the development of humankind as a whole, an approach is proposed that includes opportunities for people's actions and for humanity. The social structures and the impact of humankind on the environment are excluded from consideration. In the works I know of, this approach is practically absent.

The purpose of this study is to develop criteria for searching for components or groups of components of such a system and to identify their list. The other purpose is to consider the dynamics of development over time of a system composed of these component groups. The search criteria for components, called super-inventions, or groups of components, called classes of super-inventions, that may constitute such a system, are described. A list of super-invention classes is provided, including “Man-made materials”, “Mass transport”, etc. The totality of super-invention classes determines the range of opportunities for people's actions and for humanity as a whole. An analysis of the temporal evolution of the proposed set of super-invention classes was conducted. It has been established that the range of these opportunities expands over time and that this expansion accelerates.

During the search, the proposed criteria information was used from various areas of knowledge. Those areas are associated with the development of technologies, means of communication, social activity, globalization, and cognitive abilities.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种分析人类发展过程的新方法，通过定义“超级发明”及其类别作为系统组件，构建了描述人类行动机会范围的系统框架，并发现该范围随时间加速扩张。
AI.research_question: 如何识别构成人类发展系统的核心组件（超级发明及其类别），并分析这些组件随时间演化的动态规律？
AI.motivation: 现有研究缺乏从人类行动机会角度出发、排除社会结构与环境影响来考察人类整体发展过程的系统性方法。
AI.theoretical_framework: 超级发明分类法（Super-Invention Taxonomy）；系统定义阶段理论；人类发展方向理论。
AI.method: 提出组件搜索标准，从技术、通信、社会活动、全球化和认知能力等多领域收集信息，识别超级发明类别，并进行时间演化分析。
AI.findings: 识别出一系列超级发明类别（如“人造材料”、“大众交通”等）；这些类别构成了人类行动机会的全部范围；该范围随时间扩张，且扩张速度呈加速趋势。
AI.theory_contributions: 构建了以超级发明为核心的系统定义框架，为理解人类整体发展提供了新的理论视角和分析工具。
AI.practical_contributions: 为技术预测、战略规划和人类发展方向评估提供了可操作的分析框架和分类标准。

title: Keju, Not Violence: How the Medieval Chinese Aristocracy Declined in the Tang Dynasty Long Before the Huang Chao Rebellion
affiliations: New York University (NYU) - Wilf Family Department of Politics

detail.title: Keju, Not Violence: How the Medieval Chinese Aristocracy Declined in the Tang Dynasty Long Before the Huang Chao Rebellion

contentType.other: Translation of a published article in a top Chinese journal

detail.abstract:
When and how did the medieval Chinese aristocracy decline? Generations of historians have argued that the political power of the aristocracy was gradually displaced by the imperial examination system (Keju) during the Tang dynasty. In recent decades, however, other historians have alleged that aristocratic political dominance persisted until the Huang Chao Rebellion at the end of the Tang, pointing to the ostensibly stable share of aristocrats among high ranking officials across the dynasty. This article identifies several fundamental flaws in the statistical reasoning underlying claims of aristocratic persistence, including conceptual ambiguity, definitional tautology, misinterpretation of conditional probabilities, and the absence of control variables in existing quantitative analyses. Using multivariate statistical models applied to a large sample of Tang tomb epitaphs, drawn from essentially the same epitaph based evidence used in prior quantitative studies but analyzed with more adequate methods, I show that the political advantage associated with aristocratic pedigree declined rapidly after the early Tang, while the net premium associated with Keju credentials increased steadily over time, even after controlling for aristocratic influence. Both trends-the erosion of pedigree-based advantage and the rising importance of Keju-were already underway more than two centuries before the Huang Chao Rebellion and other violent upheavals marking the end of the Tang and its immediate successor polities. These new findings leave the social and political dimensions of the Tang-Song Transition thesis on shaky ground.

This article is an English translation of a study previously published in Historical Research (历史研究), with minor adaptations for an English-language audience.

AI.tldr: 本文利用多元统计模型分析唐代墓志铭数据，反驳了"贵族政治优势持续到晚唐"的观点，证明了贵族血统的政治优势在初唐后迅速衰退，而科举功名的回报则稳步上升，这两大趋势在黄巢起义前两个多世纪就已开始。
AI.research_question: 中世纪中国贵族何时以及如何衰落？贵族政治优势是否真的持续到晚唐黄巢起义时期？
AI.motivation: 史学界对唐代贵族衰落的时间节点存在重大争议。一派认为科举制逐步取代贵族权力，另一派（基于统计数据）声称贵族政治主导地位持续到唐末。作者指出后者的统计推理存在根本性缺陷，因此需要更严谨的量化分析来澄清这一问题。
AI.theoretical_framework: 涉及唐代贵族政治社会学、科举制度的社会流动功能、以及唐宋变革论的社会政治维度。
AI.method: 使用多元统计模型，对大量唐代墓志铭样本进行分析。与以往量化研究使用相同的墓志铭数据基础，但采用更恰当的方法，包含控制变量以克服概念模糊、定义循环、条件概率误读等统计缺陷。
AI.findings: （1）贵族血统的政治优势在初唐后迅速下降；（2）科举功名的净回报随时间稳步上升（即使控制了贵族影响）；（3）这两大趋势在黄巢起义（及唐末其他暴力动荡）前两个多世纪已在进行中。
AI.theory_contributions: 对"贵族政治持续到晚唐"的观点进行了有力的实证反驳，修正了关于唐宋变革时间线的认识，动摇了唐宋变革论在政治与社会维度的既有基础。
AI.practical_contributions: 为理解中国历史上精英更替、制度变迁（科举制）与社会流动的关系提供了更精确的时间框架和实证依据。

title: Beyond U-3: A County-Level Comprehensive Labor Underutilization Index
affiliations: University of the Cumberlands

detail.title: Beyond U-3: A County-Level Comprehensive Labor Underutilization Index

declarations.declarationOfInterest: N/A
declarations.ethicsApproval: N/A
declarations.funderStatement: N/A

detail.abstract: The Bureau of Labor Statistics U-3 unemployment rate captures a single dimension of labor market health. This paper constructs a County-Level Comprehensive Labor Underutilization Index (CLUI) using Fay-Herriot small-area estimation on 3,082 U.S. counties. The index combines three layers of distress: official unemployment, labor force non-participation, and poverty-wage employment. Nationally, poverty-wage employment accounts for 37 percent of the CLUI, the participation gap for 25 percent, and unemployment for just 15 percent. The Fay-Herriot EBLUP achieves 78 percent variance reduction over direct survey estimates. Five contributions follow. First, the CLUI predicts county premature mortality 3.6 times better than U-3 (R-squared = 0.417 versus 0.116) and disability non-participation 3.1 times better (Rsquared = 0.419 versus 0.134); neither outcome enters the CLUI construction. Under spatial buffered cross-validation, the CLUI reduces premature death prediction error by 39.3 percent. Second, Vuong (1989) and Williams (1959) tests confirm CLUI superiority in 12 of 20 pairwise comparisons against five competing indices. Third, spatial autocorrelation is substantial (Moran's I = 0.603); a spatial Fay-Herriot extension preserves baseline rankings (Spearman rho = 0.987), and the Chen (2026) diagnostic indicates that standard shrinkage understates distress in small rural counties. Fourth, 292 hidden-distress counties representing 6.6 million residents have official unemployment below 4 percent but severe comprehensive underutilization. Fifth, these counties shifted toward the Republican ticket in 2024, though this association does not survive spatial HAC correction. Results are stable across ten robustness checks.

AI.tldr: 本文利用Fay-Herriot小区域估计方法，构建了美国3,082个县的综合劳动力未充分利用指数（CLUI），该指数融合了官方失业、劳动参与缺口和贫困工资就业三个维度，发现CLUI在预测县级过早死亡和残疾非参与方面远优于传统的U-3失业率，并识别出292个隐性困境县。
AI.research_question: 如何构建一个多维度、更全面的县级劳动力未充分利用指数，以替代单一维度的官方失业率，并检验其在预测社会经济后果方面的优越性？
AI.motivation: 官方U-3失业率仅捕捉劳动力市场健康的一个维度，忽略了劳动参与不足和贫困工资就业等隐性困境，导致政策制定者对地方经济真实状况的误判。
AI.theoretical_framework: Fay-Herriot小区域估计模型、空间自相关理论（Moran's I）、空间Fay-Herriot扩展模型、Vuong检验与Williams检验。
AI.method: 基于3,082个美国县级数据，使用Fay-Herriot小区域估计构建CLUI指数（融合失业率、劳动参与缺口、贫困工资就业三个维度），通过空间缓冲交叉验证、多重指标对比检验（Vuong检验、Williams检验）、空间自相关分析及稳健性检验进行验证。
AI.findings: (1) CLUI预测过早死亡的能力是U-3的3.6倍，预测残疾非参与的能力是U-3的3.1倍；(2) 在20次两两比较中，CLUI在12次显著优于其他5个竞争性指数；(3) 空间自相关显著（Moran's I=0.603），小农村县存在统计低估；(4) 识别出292个隐性困境县（官方失业率低于4%但综合未充分利用严重），涉及660万居民；(5) 这些县在2024年偏向共和党，但空间HAC校正后不显著。
AI.theory_contributions: 首次将Fay-Herriot小区域估计应用于多维度劳动力未充分利用指数的构建，并系统验证了空间效应对县级劳动力市场测度的影响，为劳动力市场统计方法提供了新的方法论框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供了一个比官方失业率更全面的县级劳动力市场监测工具，能够识别官方数据无法揭示的隐性困境区域，有助于更精准地配置就业和社会福利资源。

title: LLM-Powered Services for Automating Building Permit Processes in Bavarian Municipalities: A Case Study on Residential Building Extensions in Ingolstadt

detail.title: LLM-Powered Services for Automating Building Permit Processes in Bavarian Municipalities: A Case Study on Residential Building Extensions in Ingolstadt
detail.abstract: This thesis examines whether LLM-powered services can serve as bridge technologies for Bavarian municipal building-permit workflows during the transition towards BIM-based automation. Using Ingolstadt as case study, the research combines stakeholder interviews, LLM benchmarking, desktop research and prototype development. Findings demonstrate that automation potential maps onto task discretion: completeness checking and parameter extraction show high potential, yet Human-in-the-Loop verification remains essential given hallucination risks. Efficiency gains operate upstream through preventing correction cycles rather than accelerating processing. The decisive constraints are organizational rather than technical, requiring open data infrastructure and state-level governance enabling municipal experimentation. Incremental deployment with embedded verification routines can simultaneously deliver operational value and build structured data foundations for future automation.

AI.tldr: 本文研究LLM能否在巴伐利亚州建筑许可流程中作为向BIM自动化过渡的桥梁技术。以英戈尔施塔特为案例，结合访谈、LLM基准测试、桌面研究和原型开发，发现自动化潜力取决于任务自由裁量权，人机交互验证不可或缺，效率提升主要来自预防返工而非加速处理，核心约束是组织而非技术因素。
AI.research_question: LLM驱动的服务能否作为巴伐利亚州市政建筑许可流程向BIM自动化过渡过程中的桥梁技术？
AI.motivation: 市政建筑许可流程正面临向BIM自动化转型的过渡期，需要找到能够在当前传统流程与未来全自动化之间起衔接作用的技术方案。
AI.theoretical_framework: 任务自由裁量权（task discretion）理论、人机协同（Human-in-the-Loop）框架、技术过渡期桥梁技术概念
AI.method: 以英戈尔施塔特为案例，综合运用利益相关者访谈、LLM基准测试（benchmarking）、桌面研究（desktop research）和原型开发四种方法
AI.findings: （1）自动化潜力与任务自由裁量权呈映射关系，完整性检查和参数提取潜力高；（2）幻觉风险使人机交互验证不可或缺；（3）效率提升来自预防纠正周期，而非直接加速处理；（4）关键约束是组织因素（开放数据基础设施、州级治理）而非技术因素
AI.theory_contributions: 将任务自由裁量权概念与LLM自动化潜力进行理论关联，并提出"渐进式部署+嵌入式验证"作为过渡期技术桥梁的理论路径。
AI.practical_contributions: 为市政部门提供了LLM技术在建筑许可流程中的实际应用边界和部署策略，强调了开放数据基础设施和州级治理赋能的重要性。

title: Honey, Who Shrunk the U.S. Income Surplus?
affiliations: Federal Reserve Bank of New York and Federal Reserve Bank of New York

detail.title: Honey, Who Shrunk the U.S. Income Surplus?

publicationDetails.journalName: Federal Reserve Bank of New York Research Paper Series

detail.abstract:
Foreign holdings of U.S. financial assets are immense, with official estimates putting their current market value at $69 trillion. U.S. holdings of foreign assets are also impressive but much smaller, at $41 trillion. The shortfall in U.S. foreign assets relative to foreign liabilities has been mounting for decades. Yet U.S. investment income receipts—in profits, dividends, and interest—comfortably exceeded income payments until recently. We show that the fading of the net investment income surplus stems from the upward shift in interest rates in the aftermath of the pandemic along with the continued net sales of U.S. assets to foreign investors.

To view post: https://libertystreeteconomics.newyorkfed.org/2026/05/honey-who-shrunk-the-u-s-income-surplus/

AI.tldr: 本文分析了美国净投资收入盈余消失的原因，指出新冠疫情后利率上升以及美国持续向外国投资者净出售资产是主要驱动因素。
AI.research_question: 为什么美国原本持续数十年的净投资收入盈余（投资收益超过支出）在近期消失了？
AI.motivation: 尽管美国对外负债（69万亿美元）远大于对外资产（41万亿美元），美国长期以来却一直享有净投资收入盈余。这一看似矛盾的现象近年来发生了变化，理解其背后原因对评估美国外部财务状况和国际收支可持续性具有重要意义。
AI.theoretical_framework: 国际投资头寸与净投资收入之间的关系；利率变动对国际收支平衡的影响；资产组合与收益率差异理论。
AI.method: 基于官方统计数据的实证分析，比较美国对外资产与负债的规模、结构及收益率变化，结合疫情后利率上升的时间序列数据进行因果推断。
AI.findings: 美国净投资收入盈余的消失主要归因于两个因素：（1）新冠疫情后利率的显著上升；（2）美国持续向外国投资者净出售资产。
AI.theory_contributions: 揭示了"超额收益率"（美国对外资产收益率高于对外负债收益率）这一传统优势被利率上升侵蚀的机制，为理解国际金融中的"暗物质"假设提供了新证据。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者和投资者提供了关于美国外部头寸可持续性的警示，说明利率环境变化可能通过国际收支渠道影响美国经济稳定。

title: Forced Migration, Statelessness, and Conflict in Africa: Legal Frameworks, Institutional Gaps, and Policy Pathways

detail.title: Forced Migration, Statelessness, and Conflict in Africa: Legal Frameworks, Institutional Gaps, and Policy Pathways

publicationDetails.detailsText: Case Legal Studies Research Paper Forthcoming
publicationDetails.journalName: Case Research Paper Series in Legal Studies

detail.abstract: Forced migration and statelessness constitute significant yet often underexamined structural drivers of conflict affecting peace and security across Africa. While frequently framed as humanitarian challenges, both phenomena generate profound governance, legal, and socioeconomic implications capable of intensifying instability where institutional protection mechanisms remain weak. This essay clarifies core concepts relating to forced migration, internal displacement, refugee protection, and statelessness, and evaluates the effectiveness of international, regional, and subregional legal frameworks, including the 1951 Refugee Convention, the 1954 and 1961 Statelessness Conventions, the 1969 Organization of African Unity (OAU) Refugee Convention, and the 2009 Kampala Convention on internally displaced persons. Through doctrinal legal analysis and comparative case studies drawn from the Lake Chad Basin, Côte d'Ivoire, and the Sudan-South Sudan context, the study demonstrates how exclusion from nationality, weak civil registration systems, and inconsistent policy implementation contribute to grievances capable of reinforcing conflict dynamics. Evidence suggests that large-scale displacement may initially intensify competition over resources and heighten communal tensions, particularly where legal identity systems and socioeconomic inclusion mechanisms are insufficiently developed. However, inclusive legal frameworks and coordinated governance approaches may generate stabilizing effects, including economic participation and strengthened social cohesion. The essay identifies key policy gaps including securitization of migration, political resistance to nationality reform, and limited institutional coordination among regional actors. It concludes that strengthening nationality protection, civil registration systems, and regional legal harmonization constitutes an important preventive peacebuilding strategy capable of reducing structural vulnerabilities associated with forced migration and statelessness in Africa.

AI.tldr: 本文分析了强迫迁移与无国籍状态作为非洲冲突的结构性驱动因素，评估了国际与区域法律框架的有效性，指出国籍排斥、登记制度薄弱等加剧冲突，并提出加强国籍保护与法律协调是预防性建设和平的关键策略。
AI.research_question: 强迫迁移与无国籍状态如何在非洲成为影响和平与安全的结构性冲突驱动因素？现有国际与区域法律框架在应对这些问题上的有效性如何？
AI.motivation: 强迫迁移与无国籍状态常被视为人道主义挑战，但其作为冲突的结构性驱动因素在非洲研究不足。本文旨在填补这一空白，为预防性建设和平提供理论依据。
AI.theoretical_framework: 结构性冲突驱动因素理论；国籍保护与法律身份理论；区域治理与法律协调理论。
AI.method: 教义性法律分析（doctrinal legal analysis）与比较案例研究，涵盖乍得湖盆地、科特迪瓦、苏丹-南苏丹三个案例。
AI.findings: 1. 国籍排斥、薄弱的民事登记制度以及不一致的政策执行加剧了冲突动态。2. 大规模流离失所初期会加剧资源竞争与社区紧张。3. 包容性法律框架与协调治理方式可产生稳定效应。4. 存在移民安全化、国籍改革政治阻力、区域机构协调不足等政策缺口。
AI.theory_contributions: 将强迫迁移与无国籍状态明确定位为冲突的结构性驱动因素，超越传统人道主义框架，丰富了非洲冲突研究的理论视角。
AI.practical_contributions: 提出加强国籍保护、民事登记制度及区域法律协调是预防性建设和平的重要策略，为政策制定者提供了可操作的建议。

detail.abstract:
The University of Illinois Chicago School of Law’s International Human Rights Clinic (IHRC) and the Saint Louis University Law School Human Rights at Home Litigation Clinic (HRAHLC) release this unofficial summary of reports compiled from 151 reports by civil society (and other non-state actors) submitted by April 7, 2025, in relation to the Fourth Cycle of the Universal Periodic Review of the United States. A new submission window for stakeholders opened until April 10, 2026, however, this unofficial summary does not include reports from that period.

The Universal Periodic Review (UPR) is a unique mechanism of the United Nations Human Rights Council that requires each UN Member State to undergo a peer review of its human rights record every 4.5 years.1 The UPR is currently in its Fourth Cycle, which began in November 2022 during the Forty-First Working Group Session.2 It aims to “prompt, support, and expand the promotion and protection of human rights in every country.”3 Additionally, this mechanism enables the sharing of the best practices in human rights protection across States.4 The UPR’s stated objective is to contribute to improvements in States’ human rights practices, though its impact depends on implementation at the national level.5

The UPR provides UN Member States with an opportunity to report on actions taken to improve domestic human rights conditions and to address challenges that prevent the full enjoyment of human rights.6 This review process also allows other UN Member States to offer recommendations for continued improvement.7 During the review, the 47 members of the Human Rights Council constitute the UPR Working Group.8 However, any UN Member State may participate in the discussion and dialogue with the State under review (SUR).9 For each review, three Council members serve as “troikas,” acting as rapporteurs.10 for the SUR.11 The Council selects troikas by random selection from different regional groups.12 The troikas facilitate the process by receiving questions from states and transmitting them to the SUR.13

AI.tldr: 本文是伊利诺伊大学芝加哥分校法学院和圣路易斯大学法学院联合发布的关于美国第四轮普遍定期审议（UPR）的非官方民间报告摘要，总结了151份来自公民社会等非国家行为体的报告，并介绍了UPR机制的基本运作方式。
AI.research_question: 美国在第四轮普遍定期审议中，民间社会和非国家行为体提交的151份报告反映了哪些人权状况与问题？
AI.motivation: 整理和汇总民间社会在美国第四轮UPR中提交的报告，为非官方利益相关方提供一份综合摘要，促进对美国国内人权状况的了解和监督。
AI.theoretical_framework: 联合国普遍定期审议（UPR）机制框架，该机制要求每个UN成员国每4.5年接受一次人权记录的同侪审查，旨在促进和保护各国人权。
AI.method: 对151份截至2025年4月7日由公民社会及其他非国家行为体提交的关于美国第四轮UPR的报告进行汇总和整理，形成非官方摘要。
AI.findings: 民间社会提交了大量关于美国国内人权状况的报告；UPR机制为成员国提供了报告人权改善行动、接受其他国家建议的机会；第四轮UPR于2022年11月开始；新的利益相关方提交窗口开放至2026年4月10日。
AI.theory_contributions: 展示了UPR机制在实践中如何收集和整合来自非国家行为体的信息，丰富了关于国际人权审查机制运作的实证理解。
AI.practical_contributions: 为关注美国人权状况的研究者、政策制定者和倡导者提供了系统的民间报告摘要，有助于评估美国在UPR框架下的人权表现，并为后续审议提供参考依据。

title: The Effect of Contingent Value Rights on Drug Approval in Biopharma M&A

detail.title: The Effect of Contingent Value Rights on Drug Approval in Biopharma M&A

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares no conflicts of interest.
declarations.ethicsApproval: This study uses transaction-level data obtained through a subscription to Evaluate Pharma and does not involve human participants, patient data, or identifiable personal information. Access to the data was provided through the author’s relationship with future employer Lazard. Accordingly, ethics approval and informed consent were not required.
declarations.funderStatement: This research received no external funding. Data access was provided through a subscription to Evaluate Pharma made available via the author’s relationship with future employer Lazard.

detail.abstract:
Opaque assets in mergers and acquisitions (M&A) create the need for unique transaction structures such as contingent value rights (CVRs) and earnouts. Prior research exposes two main functions of these contingent contracts. The first is to align post acquisitions incentives and retain human capital. The second is to bridge valuation disagreements, allowing inher- ently riskier assets to sell by spreading uncertainty across parties. The capital-intensive and risk-centric biopharmaceutical industry makes it an ideal setting to explore these functions. This paper aims to address the gap in M&A contracting literature by examining CVRs in biopharmaceutical acquisitions to analyze how contingent payment structures influence drug approval.

This paper compiles 313 biopharma transactions from Evaluate Pharma’s transaction database and assesses their post-acquisition success measure through primary asset approval. The data is comprised of 91 transactions structured with a CVR and 222 with upfront payment. It then models out a linear probability model (LPM), logit, and propensity score model (PSM) to compare the percentage of approved deals. The regression models control for three main determinants of drug approval as found in the literature: inherent drug risk, resource risk, and timing risk. These models produce 13% to 19% lower drug approval in CVR transactions, indicating that contingent contracting in biopharma is primarily used to bridge valuation disagreements and thus is more densely used in transactions with greater underlying risk. While this does not refute the possibility of an incentive aligning hypothesis, the findings provide empirical support that CVRs in biopharma transactions serve to bridge valuation and spread risk for assets with extreme uncertainty.

AI.tldr: 本文通过分析313笔生物医药并购交易，发现使用或有价值权（CVR）的交易相比全现金交易，药物获批概率低13%-19%，表明CVR主要用于弥合估值分歧和分散极端不确定性风险，而非主要激励管理者。
AI.research_question: 在生物医药并购中，或有支付结构（CVR）如何影响标的资产的药物获批概率？
AI.motivation: 已有文献揭示了CVR等或有合约的两大功能——激励留任与弥合估值分歧，但缺乏实证检验哪种功能占主导。生物医药行业资本密集、风险高，是检验这一问题的理想场景。
AI.theoretical_framework: 并购中有条件支付合约的功能理论：激励对齐假说（incentive alignment）与估值分歧弥合假说（valuation bridging）。
AI.method: 收集Evaluate Pharma数据库中的313笔生物医药交易（91笔含CVR，222笔为全额预付），以主要资产获批作为成功度量，采用线性概率模型（LPM）、Logit模型和倾向得分匹配（PSM）进行回归分析，控制药物内在风险、资源风险和时机风险。
AI.findings: 含CVR交易的药物获批概率比全额预付交易低13%-19%，表明CVR更多用于弥合估值分歧和分散风险，而非激励管理层。
AI.theory_contributions: 为并购中或有支付合约的"估值弥合假说"提供了生物医药领域的实证支持，补充了M&A契约文献。
AI.practical_contributions: 提示并购双方：CVR并非万能激励工具，其背后往往对应更高风险资产，需审慎评估交易结构与资产风险的匹配性。
