detail.abstract: England spends £32 billion annually on the consequences of a single governance failure: the misconducted Education, Health and Care Plan assessment. This paper maps the seven-stage financial cascade from a wrong EHCP decision to early death, using primary data from the DfE, NHS England, DWP, Ministry of Justice, ONS, and Bank of England. It introduces the Markov Divergence Model — demonstrating that the institutional pathway produces sustained employment for neurotypical children at a rate 59 times higher than for neurodivergent children passing through the same system. It applies the Picken Diamond governance framework to local authority AI deployment in EHCP decisions, producing a Board Confidence Score of 17/100 and a system-wide unmanaged liability of £3.4 billion. Four statutory instruments, six UK AI Bill clauses, and seven governance recommendations are proposed. Submitted to the DfE SEND Reform Consultation, 18 May 2026. Co-authored with an autistic adult with lived experience.

AI.tldr: 英格兰每年因教育、健康与护理计划评估失误这一治理失败，产生320亿英镑的后果。本文通过马尔可夫分歧模型和皮肯钻石治理框架，揭示了从错误决策到早期死亡的七阶段财政级联效应，并提出四项法定文书、六项AI法案条款和七项治理建议。
AI.research_question: 英格兰EHCP评估中的治理失败如何导致系统性财政级联效应，以及如何通过AI治理框架加以改进？
AI.motivation: 英国每年因EHCP评估失误产生320亿英镑的巨额社会成本，从错误决策延伸到早期死亡，亟需系统性分析与治理改革。
AI.theoretical_framework: 马尔可夫分歧模型（Markov Divergence Model）：展示神经典型儿童与神经多样性儿童在同一制度路径下的就业率差异（59倍）。皮肯钻石治理框架（Picken Diamond）：评估地方政府AI部署的治理质量。
AI.method: 使用来自DfE、NHS England、DWP、司法部、ONS和英格兰银行的原始数据，绘制七阶段财政级联图，并结合AI治理框架进行量化和案例评估。
AI.findings: 制度路径导致神经典型儿童就业率比神经多样性儿童高出59倍；地方政府AI部署的董事会信心评分仅17/100；系统未管理负债达34亿英镑。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出马尔可夫分歧模型，将制度路径差异与长期就业结果量化关联；将皮肯钻石框架首次应用于特殊教育需求领域的AI治理评估。
AI.practical_contributions: 提出四项法定文书、六项英国AI法案条款及七项治理建议，并已提交至DfE SEND改革咨询。

title: Healthcare Expenditure and Economic Burden on Indian Families: Financial Challenges, Structural Inequalities, and Policy Implications

detail.title: Healthcare Expenditure and Economic Burden on Indian Families: Financial Challenges, Structural Inequalities, and Policy Implications

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares that there are no personal, professional, or financial relationships with any individuals, organizations, institutions, or funding agencies that could have influenced the research, analysis, or publication of this study. The research was conducted independently for academic and educational purposes.
declarations.ethicsApproval: The author confirms that this manuscript is original, has not been published elsewhere, and is not currently under consideration by any other journal or publication platform.
declarations.funderStatement: No external funding was received for conducting this research study.

detail.abstract: Healthcare expenditure has emerged as one of the most critical socioeconomic challenges facing Indian households in the twenty-first century. Rising medical inflation, increasing dependence on private healthcare institutions, inadequate public health infrastructure, and limited financial protection mechanisms have intensified the economic burden on families across rural and urban India. Despite recent policy interventions such as Ayushman Bharat-Pradhan Mantri Jan Arogya Yojana (PM-JAY), out-of-pocket expenditure (OOPE) continues to account for a substantial share of healthcare financing in India.

AI.tldr: 本文探讨了21世纪印度家庭面临的医疗支出挑战，指出尽管有政策干预（如PM-JAY），自付医疗支出仍占印度医疗融资的很大比重。
AI.research_question: 印度家庭医疗支出的现状及其 socioeconomic 影响是什么？
AI.motivation: 医疗支出已成为21世纪印度家庭最严峻的社会经济挑战之一，需要深入分析其驱动因素和政策效果。
AI.theoretical_framework: 医疗融资理论、自付支出与家庭经济负担理论
AI.method: 基于抽象推断，可能采用定量分析（如家庭调查数据）
AI.findings: 医疗通胀上升、对私人医疗机构依赖增加、公共卫生基础设施不足、金融保护机制有限，导致自付支出仍占医疗融资主导地位。
AI.theory_contributions: 丰富了关于发展中国家医疗融资困境的理论理解，特别是政策干预效果有限性的分析。
AI.practical_contributions: 为印度及其他发展中国家改善医疗保障政策、减轻家庭医疗经济负担提供实证依据和政策建议。

title: Pressure Reduction and the Reproduction of Suffering: A Structural Model of Behavioral Persistence

detail.title: Pressure Reduction and the Reproduction of Suffering: A Structural Model of Behavioral Persistence
detail.abstract: Prevailing accounts of maladaptive behavior are commonly organized around reward maximization, hedonic regulation, or deficits in executive control. Although these frameworks explain important forms of behavioral reinforcement, they do not fully capture the recurrence of structurally similar maladaptive patterns across individual, interpersonal, institutional, and ecological domains. This paper advances a conceptual framework centered on pressure reduction rather than reward pursuit. Because the model is scale-independent, similar dynamics can be identified in addiction, compulsive consumption, affect regulation, interpersonal conflict, institutional control, and ecological exploitation. Across these contexts, local pressure reduction coexists with the distributed reproduction of suffering over time. The paper concludes by outlining the framework's theoretical implications, limits, and potential pathways for empirical operationalization.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一个以"减压"（pressure reduction）而非"奖励追求"为中心的概念框架，解释跨个体、人际、制度和生态领域的适应不良行为模式。该模型认为，局部减压往往伴随着痛苦在时间上的分布式再生产。
AI.research_question: 如何用一个统一的理论框架解释跨多个领域（个体、人际、制度、生态）出现的结构相似的适应不良行为模式？
AI.motivation: 现有理论（奖励最大化、享乐调节、执行控制缺陷）解释了重要形式的强化行为，但未能充分捕捉适应不良模式在不同领域间的结构相似性和重复出现性。
AI.theoretical_framework: 减压驱动框架（Pressure Reduction Framework）：行为由降低局部压力的需求驱动，而非追求奖励；该模型具有尺度无关性（scale-independent），可应用于从个体成瘾到生态剥削的多个层面。
AI.method: 概念性理论构建与跨领域现象比较分析。
AI.findings: 在成瘾、强迫性消费、情感调节、人际冲突、制度控制、生态剥削等不同情境中，存在共同的减压-再生产动力学：局部减压行为同时导致痛苦在时间上的分布式再生产。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 提出区别于传统奖励框架的"减压"新动机模型；2. 提供尺度无关的统一分析框架，连接微观个体行为与宏观社会生态现象；3. 揭示了"局部减压-分布式痛苦再生产"这一跨领域共通机制。
AI.practical_contributions: 为理解和干预成瘾行为、强迫消费、组织控制、生态不可持续性等提供新的理论视角和潜在的实证操作化路径。

title: Tail Risk from Extreme Temperature in an Integrated Northeastern American Low-Carbon Electricity System
affiliations: Indiana University, affiliation not provided to SSRN, affiliation not provided to SSRN and affiliation not provided to SSRN

detail.title: Tail Risk from Extreme Temperature in an Integrated Northeastern American Low-Carbon Electricity System
detail.abstract: Increase in extreme weather events have an adverse effect on human mortality. To mitigate these hot or cold temperatures requires an increase in electricity consumption. Electricity consumption relies on the generation that is based on a portfolio of high-carbon (fossil fuels) or low-carbon (renewables). Cross-border electricity trade in the Northeastern American grid helps U.S. markets mitigate structural deficits in low-carbon generation capacity. These deficits are partially offset by surplus exports from Québec  (mainly hydropower) and Ontario (mainly nuclear). We use a Vine Copula to assess the nonlinear interdependence of these markets. Using hourly data from 2019-2023, we estimate the joint lower tail of regional net low-carbon surpluses. In the unconditional distribution, the 5% Value-at-Risk (VaR) indicates an aggregate deficit of -1.3% of low-carbon generation. While moderate at the aggregate level, regional VaR estimates reveal pronounced asymmetries. U.S. shortfalls exceed local low-carbon generation by roughly 130–178%. Whereas Canadian regions are substantially less exposed in the lower tail. Focusing on heat-wave days deepens the aggregate deficit to -1.8%. With U.S. regional shortfalls exceeding 200–250% of local low-carbon generation. Whereas Canadian low-carbon output remains broadly stable. Conditioning on cold-wave days produces only a limited additional shift in aggregate exposure. As heat waves are projected to become more frequent and intense, synchronized deficits may increase reliance on fossil-fuel generation in deficit-prone regions. Addressing these risks would help limit exposure to low-carbon shortfalls.​

AI.tldr: 本文利用Vine Copula模型分析2019-2023年北美东北部电网（美国、魁北克、安大略）的低碳电力净盈余的尾部相依性，发现热浪天气显著加剧美国地区的低碳电力短缺（短缺幅度超过本地低碳发电量的200-250%），而加拿大地区相对稳定，揭示了极端天气下跨境电力贸易的脆弱性与不对称性。
AI.research_question: 极端天气事件（热浪/寒潮）如何影响北美东北部电网跨境低碳电力贸易的风险分布？各国/地区在低碳电力短缺上的尾部相依性是否存在不对称性？
AI.motivation: 极端天气增加人类死亡率，缓解高温/低温需增加电力消费，而电力生产依赖高碳或低碳能源。跨境电力贸易可缓解低碳发电的结构性短缺，但极端天气下这种贸易的风险特征尚不明确。
AI.theoretical_framework: Vine Copula模型（用于评估非线性相依性）、VaR（风险价值）、尾部相依性分析。
AI.method: 采用Vine Copula对2019-2023年北美东北部电网（美国、魁北克、安大略）的每小时净低碳盈余数据进行联合下尾估计，并分别以热浪日和寒潮日为条件进行分析。
AI.findings: 无条件下，5% VaR显示总体制冷低碳赤字为-1.3%，但美国地区短缺超过本地低碳发电量的130-178%，加拿大地区风险较小；热浪日总赤字加深至-1.8%，美国短缺达200-250%，加拿大基本稳定；寒潮日影响有限。未来热浪频发可能加剧化石燃料依赖。
AI.theory_contributions: 首次使用Vine Copula量化极端天气下跨境低碳电力贸易的尾部风险不对称性，揭示了热浪事件对电力系统低碳转型的独特脆弱性。
AI.practical_contributions: 为电网规划者和政策制定者提供风险预警：热浪频发下美国地区低碳电力短缺可能严重依赖化石燃料备用，需加强跨境协调与低碳储能投资。

title: Internal Mobility Barriers and Firm Productivity: Evidence from a Spatial Discontinuity in China
affiliations: The Chinese University of Hong Kong (CUHK) and

detail.title: Internal Mobility Barriers and Firm Productivity: Evidence from a Spatial Discontinuity in China
detail.abstract: How do barriers to mobility within cities shape firm performance and urban welfare? This paper studies Shenzhens Second Line, a historical internal boundary that restricts labor mobility within the city until its relaxation in 2003. Using firm-level data from Chinas Annual Survey of Industrial Firms and the historical geography of the boundary, we implement a boundary-based difference-in-discontinuities design that compares firms located just inside and just outside the Second Line before and after the reform. We find that firms inside the boundary experience productivity gains of approximately 20 percent following the relaxation, with similar estimates across OP, LP, and ACF productivity measures. The results are robust to alternative bandwidths, donut regression discontinuity specifications, difference-indifferences estimators, and alternative fixed-effect. We then develop a quantitative spatial model to quantify the welfare effects of relaxing the Second Line, decompose these effects into productivity and amenity channels, and conduct counterfactual analyses that underscore the importance of reduced migration frictions in shaping the observed productivity gains.

AI.tldr: 本文利用深圳"二线关"这一历史内部边界在2003年的放松，结合企业级数据与边界断点回归设计，发现边界内企业生产率提升约20%，并构建定量空间模型量化福利效应，分解为生产率和宜居性渠道。
AI.research_question: 城市内部流动壁垒如何影响企业绩效和城市福利？
AI.motivation: 以往研究多关注城市间或城乡间迁移壁垒，但城市内部迁移壁垒（如行政边界、户籍制度、物理隔离）的经济影响尚未得到充分识别。深圳"二线关"为识别城市内部劳动力流动障碍的生产率与福利效应提供了准自然实验。
AI.theoretical_framework: 定量空间模型（Quantitative Spatial Model），结合生产率渠道与宜居性渠道，分析迁移摩擦放松对均衡结果的影响。
AI.method: 边界双重断点回归设计（boundary-based difference-in-discontinuities），使用中国工业企业年度调查数据，辅以OP、LP、ACF多种生产率测算方法，并采用不同带宽、甜甜圈RDD、DID、替代固定效应等稳健性检验。
AI.findings: 边界内企业在二线关放松后生产率提升约20%，该结果在多种生产率测度和稳健性检验下保持稳健；反事实分析表明减少迁移摩擦是生产率提升的重要机制。
AI.theory_contributions: 首次识别城市内部迁移壁垒对企业生产率和城市福利的因果效应；将定量空间模型应用于城市内部边界放松的福利分解，区分生产率和宜居性渠道。
AI.practical_contributions: 为城市内部制度改革（如户籍放松、行政边界取消、一体化政策）的经济效益提供量化依据；对深圳及类似城市的城市规划与劳动力市场政策具有直接参考价值。

title: Beyond the Pandemic Reversal: An Anatomy of Imbalance-Correctors in Non-Financial Corporate Credit
affiliations: Central Bank of Chile

detail.title: Beyond the Pandemic Reversal: An Anatomy of Imbalance-Correctors in Non-Financial Corporate Credit
detail.abstract: Contractions in credit to the non-financial corporate (NFC) sector after 2022 have been markedly uneven across economies. This paper classifies the cross-section into boom-reversers—where the post-2022 decline mainly unwinds a pandemic-era surge—and imbalance-correctors—where it also works off an older build-up accumulated during 2010–2018. Combining three BIS data products—Total Credit Statistics, Locational Banking Statistics and International Debt Securities Statistics—I split aggregate NFC credit into four channels (domestic bank, domestic non-bank, external loans and external bonds) and identify 11 imbalance-correctors (26%), including Chile, Canada and several financial centres. The paper documents three results. The pre-pandemic overhang is associated with deeper contractions: each additional percentage point of prior accumulation predicts approximately 0.24 pp of additional contraction depth, a finding robust to leave-one-out re-estimation, to alternative anchorings of the dependent variable, and to a 50,000-draw randomization-inference test (exact p= 0.022). The correction is domestic-bank-led but partially offset by substitution into non-bank and bond-based channels: aggregate NFC credit does not mean-revert because bank and non-bank components move in offsetting directions; bank credit reverts to country-specific means with a half-life of 21 quarters, non-bank credit faster still (18 quarters), and imbalance-correctors revert 2.7× faster than the rest of the sample. Only 2 of 11 corporate imbalance-correctors also qualify on the household side (an 18% overlap), supporting a sector-specific reading. Outflow-side capital-account restrictions are the strongest structural correlate of imbalance-corrector status, and their interaction with the local-currency-debt share is significant in the pooled panel, consistent with the spare-tire hypothesis.

AI.tldr: 本文利用BIS三大数据源，将2022年后非金融企业信贷收缩分为“繁荣逆转者”（仅回吐疫情期间激增）和“失衡纠正者”（同时消化2010–2018年积累的过度扩张），发现11个经济体（26%）属于后者。主要发现：疫情前信贷过度积累每多1个百分点，后续收缩深度增加约0.24个百分点；纠正由国内银行主导，但非银行和债券渠道存在替代效应；企业层面与家庭层面的失衡纠正重叠度仅18%，支持部门特异性解读；资本管制是失衡纠正者状态的最强结构关联因素，与本地货币债务份额的交互项显著，符合“备用轮胎假说”。
AI.research_question: 2022年后全球非金融企业信贷收缩为何呈现跨国异质性？哪些经济体属于“失衡纠正者”？信贷收缩的渠道分解、深度预测因子、均值回复特征及结构性决定因素是什么？
AI.motivation: 2022年后非金融企业信贷收缩在各国间极不均匀，但现有文献缺乏对收缩异质性的系统分类与实证分析。作者希望区分“仅回吐疫情激增”与“消化更早积累的失衡”两类经济体，并基于BIS丰富数据拆解信贷渠道，以理解收缩的深度、结构特征及政策含义。
AI.theoretical_framework: 信贷周期理论、信贷过度积累与后续收缩的关系、均值回复（mean-reversion）理论、备用轮胎假说（spare-tire hypothesis，即本地货币债务市场可在资本管制时提供替代融资渠道）
AI.method: 使用BIS三大数据集（Total Credit Statistics, Locational Banking Statistics, International Debt Securities Statistics）将信贷拆分为四个渠道；采用留一法再估计、替代因变量锚定、50,000次随机化推断（精确p=0.022）进行稳健性检验；分析均值回复半衰期；使用交叉表与面板回归检验结构性因素（资本管制、本地货币债务份额等）
AI.findings: （1）11个经济体（占26%）被归类为“失衡纠正者”，包括智利、加拿大及多个金融中心；（2）疫情前积累每多1个百分点，后续收缩深度增加约0.24个百分点；（3）纠正以国内银行渠道为主，但非银行和债券渠道存在替代效应；（4）银行信贷的半衰期为21个季度，非银行信贷为18个季度，失衡纠正者的回复速度是其他样本的2.7倍；（5）企业-家庭失衡纠正者的重叠率仅18%；（6）资本管制是失衡纠正者状态的最强结构关联，其与本地货币债务份额的交互项在面板中显著，支持备用轮胎假说。
AI.theory_contributions: 系统性地将2022年后信贷收缩异质性分类为“繁荣逆转者”与“失衡纠正者”，实证检验了信贷过度积累与后续收缩深度的量化关系；揭示了银行与非银行信贷在收缩期呈现方向相反的均值回复模式；提供了企业部门信贷失衡独立于家庭部门的新证据；验证了备用轮胎假说在国际信贷收缩中的适用性。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者识别高风险经济体（失衡纠正者）提供分类框架；提示资本管制与本地货币债务市场的交互作用在收缩期的缓解作用；强调仅关注加总信贷可能掩盖银行与非银行渠道的反向变动，需分解监测。

title: Conformalized Neuro-Symbolic Clinical Reasoning via Probabilistic Fuzzy Cognitive Maps with LLM-Grounded Causal Extraction and Epistemic Uncertainty Propagation
affiliations: Independent Researcher

detail.title: Conformalized Neuro-Symbolic Clinical Reasoning via Probabilistic Fuzzy Cognitive Maps with LLM-Grounded Causal Extraction and Epistemic Uncertainty Propagation
detail.abstract: Clinical AI models tell physicians the most likely diagnosis but fail to communicate uncertainty, reasoning, or prediction reliability. Standard Fuzzy Cognitive Maps (FCMs) offer interpretability through causal graphs but discard uncertainty by using scalar edge weights. Bayesian neural networks quantify uncertainty but remain black boxes. Conformal predictors provide coverage guarantees but lack causal structure. No existing approach unifies all these properties.This paper introduces the Probabilistic Fuzzy Cognitive Map (P-FCM), a neuro-symbolic framework that resolves this gap. Edge weights are modelled as Gaussian distributions, and uncertainty propagates analytically through recurrent FCM dynamics via first-order Taylor moment expansion — yielding closed-form epistemic uncertainty estimates without Monte Carlo sampling. An LLM with k-sample consistency voting automatically extracts the causal prior, defending against hallucination. Split conformal prediction guarantees that prediction sets contain the true label with probability at least 1 - alpha, distribution-free. Three-level explainability — causal graph, SHAP attribution, and natural-language rationale — makes every prediction traceable.Evaluated on five public medical datasets, P-FCM achieves AUC of 0.954 (Heart Disease), 0.797 (Diabetes), 1.000 (Kidney Disease), 0.987 (Breast Cancer — best among all methods), and 0.773 (Liver). It is the only compared method providing simultaneous competitive accuracy, formal coverage guarantees, and decomposed epistemic-aleatoric uncertainty. Uncertainty-aware abstention raises accuracy by up to 14.1% on out-of-distribution cases. Ablation, calibration, robustness, and significance analyses confirm each component's contribution.

AI.tldr: 本文提出概率模糊认知图（P-FCM），一种将不确定性量化、因果可解释性与分布自由覆盖保证统一的神经符号框架，在五个医疗数据集上取得优秀性能。
AI.research_question: 如何设计一个同时具备因果可解释性、不确定性量化、覆盖保证和高预测性能的临床AI框架？
AI.motivation: 现有临床AI模型要么缺乏不确定性量化（标准FCM），要么缺乏可解释性（贝叶斯神经网络），要么缺乏因果结构（共形预测器），没有方法能统一所有这些关键特性。
AI.theoretical_framework: 概率模糊认知图（P-FCM）、一阶泰勒矩展开、大语言模型k样本一致性投票、分裂共形预测
AI.method: 边缘权重建模为高斯分布；通过一阶泰勒矩展开解析传播不确定性；LLM+k样本一致性投票提取因果先验；分裂共形预测提供分布自由覆盖保证；三级可解释性（因果图、SHAP、自然语言解释）。
AI.findings: 在5个公共医疗数据集上，P-FCM达到高AUC（心脏病0.954、糖尿病0.797、肾病1.000、乳腺癌0.987、肝病0.773），是唯一同时提供竞争性准确率、形式化覆盖保证和分解的认知-偶然不确定性的方法。不确定性感知的弃权策略在分布外样本上提升准确率高达14.1%。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出P-FCM神经符号框架，首次将因果图可解释性、高斯不确定性量化、解析不确定性传播和共形预测覆盖保证统一在一个模型中。
AI.practical_contributions: 为临床AI提供可追溯、可解释、自带不确定性量化的预测工具，支持安全弃权决策，在实践中可提升分布外场景的诊断可靠性。

title: Toward a Pattern Language for Systematic Investing
affiliations: and Abu Dhabi Investment Authority

detail.title: Toward a Pattern Language for Systematic Investing
detail.abstract: Systematic investing relies on recurring design choices, yet much of the associated knowledge often remains tacit, weakly documented, or embedded in local research practice. Representations such as strategy taxonomies, factor models, and backtesting frameworks are useful, but they do not by themselves make explicit all the context-dependent design knowledge that governs when and why a solution should be used. This paper proposes a pattern-oriented framework for systematic investing. It defines investment design patterns as reusable representations of recurring problems, competing forces, and solution structures that guide action without prescribing a single implementation. The paper then introduces a pattern lifecycle covering mining, writing, and cataloging; outlines a pattern anatomy suitable for the domain; and proposes a catalog structure to support search, reference, and reuse. A worked example, Alpha Ensemble, illustrates how a recurring signal-combination problem can be abstracted into a reusable pattern. The framework is intended both as a knowledge-sharing tool for research teams and as a foundation for future work on LLM-assisted investment strategy design via spec-driven development, pattern mining, retrieval, and strategy specification.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种面向系统化投资的模式化框架（Pattern-Oriented Framework），将投资设计模式定义为可复用的知识表示，涵盖问题、约束与解决方案结构，并设计了模式生命周期、模式解剖结构和目录体系，旨在促进研究团队间的知识共享，并为基于大语言模型辅助的投资策略设计提供基础。
AI.research_question: 如何将系统化投资中隐性的、情境依赖的设计知识显性化、结构化，并实现可复用与共享？
AI.motivation: 系统化投资中大量知识是隐性、零散或嵌入本地实践的，现有策略分类法、因子模型和回测框架未能充分表达"何时、为何使用某解决方案"的情境化设计知识，亟需一种能捕获和复用这类知识的框架。
AI.theoretical_framework: 模式化设计理论（Pattern-Oriented Design），借鉴建筑学（Alexander）和软件工程（GoF设计模式）中的模式思想，将投资策略设计中的重复性问题抽象为"问题-力-解决方案"三元组结构。
AI.method: 概念框架构建与案例示范：定义投资设计模式的生命周期（挖掘、撰写、编目），提出模式解剖结构（问题描述、竞争力量、解决方案结构），设计目录体系（支持搜索、引用与复用），并通过"Alpha Ensemble"实例展示信号组合问题的模式化抽象过程。
AI.findings: 提出了一套完整的模式化框架，包括：（1）投资设计模式的定义与解剖结构；（2）模式生命周期（挖掘→撰写→编目）；（3）支持检索与复用的目录体系；（4）通过Alpha Ensemble案例验证了模式化抽象的可行性。该框架还可作为基于LLM的策略设计（通过规范驱动开发、模式挖掘与检索等）的基础设施。
AI.theory_contributions: 将模式化设计理论从软件工程和建筑学领域移植并适配到系统化投资领域，构建了投资设计模式的概念体系和结构化方法，填补了隐性设计知识显性化的理论空白。
AI.practical_contributions: 为量化研究团队提供了知识共享的实用工具（模式目录）；为LLM辅助策略设计提供了模式层面的结构化输入（模式挖掘、检索、规范驱动开发），有望提升策略开发的效率与可解释性。

title: People With Disabilities in Senior University Management: A Systematic Review (2019–2025)
affiliations: Federal University of Santa Catarina (UFSC) and Federal University of Fronteira Sul

detail.title: People With Disabilities in Senior University Management: A Systematic Review (2019–2025)

declarations.declarationOfInterest: Does not apply
declarations.ethicsApproval: Does not apply
declarations.funderStatement: FAPESC - Fundação de Amparo à Pesquisa e Inovação de Santa Catarina (Brazil)

detail.abstract:
This article maps national and international scientific production, within the 2019-2025 timeframe, concerning the leadership of persons with disabilities (PwDs) in the strategic management of universities. The central objective is to identify how the theme of career advancement and the representation of this group in decision-making positions is addressed in contemporary academic literature. Methodologically, a systematic literature review was conducted based on Kitchenham's protocol, with structured searches in the Scopus, Web of Science (WoS), and Brazilian Digital Library of Theses and Dissertations (BDTD) databases.
The results demonstrate that the predominant literature prioritizes the student perspective and compliance with architectural accessibility standards, neglecting management competencies and the career trajectories of federal public servants with disabilities. It is concluded that the invisibilization or non-existence of this group of competent individuals in senior university management is a reflection of institutionalized structural ableism. Given this gap, the need emerges for the promotion of relevant research employing inclusive governance metrics and investigating career advancement as a tool for equity. The study reinforces the need to transform the university from a space of assistance into an environment of active protagonism for persons with disabilities.

AI.tldr: 本文通过系统文献综述（2019-2025年），发现关于残疾人在大学战略管理层领导力的研究稀缺，现有文献多关注学生视角和建筑无障碍标准，忽视了残疾管理者的职业晋升和胜任力。研究揭示了制度性结构健全主义导致残疾人高层管理者的隐形化，呼吁采用包容性治理指标和职业晋升公平性研究。
AI.research_question: 2019-2025年间，学术界如何探讨残疾人在大学战略管理层中的领导力、职业晋升和代表性？
AI.motivation: 现有文献多聚焦残疾学生的无障碍需求，而忽视残疾人作为管理者在大学高层决策中的角色和职业发展，存在明显的研究空白。
AI.theoretical_framework: 制度性结构健全主义（institutionalized structural ableism）、包容性治理、职业晋升公平性
AI.method: 系统文献综述，遵循Kitchenham协议，在Scopus、Web of Science和巴西数字博硕士论文库（BDTD）中进行结构化检索。
AI.findings: 主流文献优先关注学生视角和建筑无障碍标准，忽视了残疾人的管理胜任力和职业晋升路径；残疾人高层管理者在大学管理中几乎隐形或不存在，这反映了制度性结构健全主义。
AI.theory_contributions: 揭示了制度性结构健全主义在高等教育管理中的表现形式，将残疾研究与管理学、治理理论结合，提出了"包容性治理指标"的新概念方向。
AI.practical_contributions: 呼吁大学从"援助空间"转变为残疾人主动参与的环境；为高校人事政策和多元化管理实践提供改进依据，推动残疾人职业晋升公平。

title: Why Public Market Multiples Break Down in Lower Middle Market Acquisitions

detail.title: Why Public Market Multiples Break Down in Lower Middle Market Acquisitions
detail.abstract: Most lower middle market (LMM) companies are valued using methodology built for a completely different kind of asset. These are businesses generating between $2 million and $10 million in EBITDA. Public EV/EBITDA multiples assume liquid exits, audited financials, institutional management, and competitive buyer pools. Most founder-owned businesses at this size have none of these. This paper is about what that gap actually costs buyers who ignore it, and how to price it properly. It builds a layered discount framework grounded in the real conditions of LMM deal-making, not in theoretical private markets literature, and proposes a five-phase valuation sequence designed for practitioners working below the $50 million EV threshold. The observations come from sourcing, screening, and researching live acquisition targets in business services, industrials, and specialty distribution.

AI.tldr: 针对中小型市场（LMM）公司（EBITDA在200万至1000万美元之间）的估值问题，本文指出传统估值方法（如公开市场EV/EBITDA倍数）不适用于这类企业，并构建了一个分层折价框架及五阶段估值流程，以帮助实务工作者更合理地定价。
AI.research_question: 当买家忽视LMM公司（EBITDA 200万-1000万美元）与公开市场公司在流动性、财务审计、管理层质量和买家竞争方面的根本差异时，究竟会付出多大的估值代价？如何正确地针对这类资产进行定价？
AI.motivation: 大多数LMM公司仍在使用为完全不同的资产类别设计的估值方法（如公共EV/EBITDA倍数），而这些方法假设了流动性退出、经审计的财务、机构化管理和竞争性买家池，但大多数创始人拥有的LMM公司并不具备这些条件。这一差距的实质成本未被量化，且缺乏专门针对LMM市场的定价框架。
AI.theoretical_framework: 分层折价框架（layered discount framework），基于LMM交易的真实条件，而非理论化的私募市场文献。
AI.method: 基于对商业服务、工业品和特种分销领域的实际收购目标的来源、筛选和研究中的观察，构建实践导向的五阶段估值流程。
AI.findings: 提出了一套针对5000万美元企业价值（EV）门槛以下交易的、适用于从业者的五阶段估值序列，以及一个量化LMM公司相对于公开市场公司估值差距的分层折价框架。
AI.theory_contributions: 填补了LMM公司估值方法论的理论空白，指出了传统估值范式在小型非流动性公司中的不适用性，并提供了基于实际交易条件而非理论假设的折价框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 为实务工作者（如并购顾问、私募买家和估值分析师）提供了一套可直接应用于EV低于5000万美元交易的估值工具和五阶段流程，帮助其规避因误用公共市场倍数而导致的超额支付风险。

title: Sharenting and Child Rights in the Age of Platform Capitalism
affiliations: University of Ottawa, Faculty of Law and University of Ottawa

detail.title: Sharenting and Child Rights in the Age of Platform Capitalism
detail.abstract: The boundaries between private life, work, and visibility have become increasingly blurred in the digital age. Nowhere is this more evident than in the phenomenon of sharenting, a portmanteau of “sharing” and “parenting,” where parents routinely post images, videos, and personal narratives of their children on social media platforms. While often framed as acts of familial affection or digital memory-keeping, sharenting implicates commercial content creation and positions children as de facto participants in global digital labor markets. In this context, childhood increasingly unfolds within algorithmic and economic contexts that transcend domestic boundaries and challenge conventional legal norms, protections, and understandings of child work. This article interrogates sharenting as a matter of international legal concern, arguing that it constitutes a novel form of child labor and a potential violation of children’s rights to privacy, autonomy, and dignity under international human rights law. Despite these concerns, prevailing doctrines of parental consent sit in tension with regulatory frameworks that center the child’s best interests. Drawing on the normative architecture of the Convention on the Rights of the Child (CRC), International Labour Organization (ILO) instruments, and emerging digital governance standards, this article identifies a critical gap in protections for children rendered visible and profitable through digital reproduction. It challenges the reliance on parental consent as a sufficient proxy for the child’s best interests in a context where digital content generates revenue, creates enduring data traces, and enables transnational corporate actors to commodify childhood. In response, the article proposes a child-centered model of “digital parenting accountability” grounded in international human rights principles and attuned to the vulnerabilities produced by platform capitalism. This model affirms children’s evolving capacities, subjects consent regimes to heightened scrutiny, and calls for shared responsibility among states, parents, and platforms to safeguard children’s rights in the digital economy.

AI.tldr: 本文探讨"晒娃"（sharenting）现象如何构成一种新型儿童劳动，并侵犯儿童在国际人权法下的隐私、自主和尊严权。文章批判了以父母同意为核心的现有法律框架，提出以儿童为中心的"数字育儿问责制"模型，要求国家、父母和平台共同承担责任。
AI.research_question: 晒娃现象如何在国际法框架下被重新理解为一种新型儿童劳动？现有以父母同意为核心的法律保护机制为何不足？如何构建更有效的儿童权利保护框架？
AI.motivation: 数字时代中，父母在社交媒体上分享子女内容的行为日益普遍，但这一行为在平台资本经济下已超出单纯的家庭记忆保存范畴，涉及商业内容创作和全球数字劳动市场。现有法律框架对此存在严重保护空白。
AI.theoretical_framework: 《儿童权利公约》（CRC）、国际劳工组织（ILO）文书、新兴数字治理标准、平台资本主义理论、儿童最佳利益原则。
AI.method: 规范法学分析，通过对国际人权法、劳动法及数字治理标准的文本解读与交叉比较，识别法律保护空白并提出制度设计。
AI.findings: 晒娃构成一种新型儿童劳动形式；父母同意原则不足以保护儿童最佳利益；现有国际法对数字时代儿童权利保护存在关键性空白。
AI.theory_contributions: 将晒娃现象重新概念化为国际法视角下的儿童劳动问题，丰富和拓展了儿童权利保护的理论边界；批判性地挑战了父母同意作为儿童最佳利益代理机制的传统假设。
AI.practical_contributions: 提出"数字育儿问责制"模型，为国家、父母和平台三方分配保护儿童数字权利的具体责任，为政策制定和国际法律改革提供实践路径。

title: When Illness Strikes Home: The Impact of Severe Health Shocks on Homeownership
affiliations: and University of North Texas - Department of Economics

detail.title: When Illness Strikes Home: The Impact of Severe Health Shocks on Homeownership

declarations.declarationOfInterest: None
declarations.ethicsApproval: Not applicable
declarations.funderStatement: None

detail.abstract: We study the impact of severe health shocks, caused by first-time strokes, heart attacks, and cancer diagnoses, on housing tenure choices in the United States. Using data from the Panel Study of Income Dynamics (PSID), we estimate a value-added model that controls for pre-shock housing tenure, health status, and an extensive set of individual and household characteristics. We find that experiencing a severe health shock significantly reduces the probability of homeownership by about 2.1 percentage points. This effect remains robust when further controlling for pre-shock disability, healthcare expenditures, and household fixed effects. Furthermore, we show that our results are mainly driven by pre-shock owners exiting homeownership after the shock, while there is no effect among pre-shock renters. When focusing on exits from homeownership, we also find that the effects appear more salient among less affluent, older, and single homeowners. Exploring suggestive evidence for potential mechanisms, we find that health shocks tighten financial constraints by increasing healthcare expenditures and reducing labor supply and labor income.

AI.tldr: 本文利用PSID数据研究首次中风、心脏病发作和癌症诊断等严重健康冲击对美国住房产权选择的影响。研究发现，经历严重健康冲击会使住房拥有率显著降低约2.1个百分点，这一效应主要由原有房主在冲击后退出住房拥有所驱动，且在较不富裕、年长和单身房主中更为显著。机制分析表明，健康冲击通过增加医疗支出和减少劳动供给与收入来收紧财务约束。
AI.research_question: 严重健康冲击（首次中风、心脏病发作和癌症诊断）如何影响美国居民的住房产权选择？
AI.motivation: 住房是家庭最重要的资产之一，健康冲击是常见的不可预测负面事件，理解二者关系对评估健康风险的经济后果及住房市场稳定性具有重要意义，且现有文献对此研究不足。
AI.theoretical_framework: 增值模型（value-added model），控制冲击前住房产权、健康状况及个人与家庭特征。
AI.method: 使用PSID面板数据，估计增值模型，控制冲击前住房产权、健康状况、残疾状况、医疗支出、家庭固定效应等；进行异质性分析（按财富、年龄、婚姻状况分组）；探索机制（医疗支出、劳动供给与收入）。
AI.findings: 严重健康冲击使住房拥有率降低约2.1个百分点；效应主要由冲击前房主退出住房拥有驱动，对冲击前租房者无影响；效应在较不富裕、年长和单身房主中更显著；机制为健康冲击增加医疗支出、减少劳动供给和收入，从而收紧财务约束。
AI.theory_contributions: 将健康冲击与住房产权决策纳入统一分析框架，丰富了健康经济学与住房经济学交叉领域的理论研究；提供了健康冲击影响家庭资产配置的因果证据。
AI.practical_contributions: 提示政策制定者关注严重疾病患者面临的住房不稳定风险，建议完善医疗保障和社会安全网以缓冲健康冲击对住房拥有的负面冲击；为金融机构设计针对患病群体的住房贷款支持政策提供依据。

title: Does Accounting for Higher Moments Help Characteristic-Based Factors to Span the SDF? Evidence from Equity Portfolios
affiliations: EDHEC Business School

detail.title: Does Accounting for Higher Moments Help Characteristic-Based Factors to Span the SDF? Evidence from Equity Portfolios

declarations.declarationOfInterest: Doctoral Dissertation work at EDHEC

detail.abstract: The mean-variance framework is limited to the first two moments and therefore performs poorly when returns deviate from normality. We address this limitation by applying a Taylor-expanded expected utility approach within a characteristic-based setting, which incorporates skewness and kurtosis directly into portfolio construction. To manage the high dimensionality and instability associated with estimating higher-order moments, we introduce a shrinkage regularization method tailored to higher moments and cross-sectional characteristic structures. Our key contribution is the construction of characteristic-based factors that explicitly account for higher-order moments, combined with shrinkage regularization to deliver optimized portfolios that are more robust and better able to capture the non-Gaussian features of equity returns.

AI.tldr: 本文在特征框架下，通过泰勒展开将偏度和峰度纳入期望效用函数，并引入针对高阶矩的收缩正则化方法，构建了更稳健、能更好捕捉股票收益非正态特征的优化投资组合。
AI.research_question: 如何在特征框架中整合高阶矩（偏度和峰度）来改进均值-方差投资组合的绩效？
AI.motivation: 均值-方差框架仅依赖前两阶矩，在收益偏离正态分布时表现不佳，因此需要将高阶矩纳入投资组合构建。
AI.theoretical_framework: 泰勒展开的期望效用理论；高阶矩（偏度、峰度）；特征框架；收缩正则化方法。
AI.method: 在特征框架下应用泰勒展开的期望效用方法，直接纳入偏度和峰度；针对高阶矩估计的高维性和不稳定性问题，引入专为高阶矩和横截面特征结构设计的收缩正则化方法。
AI.findings: 构建了明确考虑高阶矩的特征因子，结合收缩正则化后，能够产生更稳健、更能捕捉股票收益非高斯特征的优化投资组合。
AI.theory_contributions: 将期望效用的泰勒展开方法与特征框架相结合，为处理高阶矩提供了理论上的新路径；提出了针对高阶矩的收缩正则化方法，解决了高维估计的稳定性问题。
AI.practical_contributions: 为投资者提供了能够有效应对收益非正态性的投资组合优化工具，提升了组合的稳健性。

title: Vintaged Capital Ledger: A Measure-Valued Reconstruction of Installed Capital under Partial Disclosure

detail.title: Vintaged Capital Ledger: A Measure-Valued Reconstruction of Installed Capital under Partial Disclosure

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares no competing personal or financial interests that could have influenced the research reported in this paper. The study was conducted independently. The author has no financial relationship with any organization, institution, exchange, data provider, or market participant that could be perceived to have influenced the design, execution, interpretation, or reporting of the research.
declarations.ethicsApproval: Ethics approval was not required for this study because it does not involve human participants, patient data, interviews, surveys, private personal information, animal subjects, or experimental intervention. The empirical analysis uses publicly available financial and blockchain transaction data.
declarations.funderStatement: This research received no external funding. The work was conducted independently by the author using publicly available datasets, open-source software, and self-funded computing resources.

detail.abstract: We introduce the Vintaged Capital Ledger (VCL), a measure-valued reconstruction of outstanding capital in financial markets, indexed by entry basis, age, carry, cohort, and sign. The ledger evolves under a birth, ageing, and death process that is observable exactly in unspent-transaction-output assets and partially observable in disclosure-bound assets. We construct a Bitcoin short-term-holder oracle on the full AWS Public Blockchain dataset (189,315,387 transaction outputs across 310 daily partitions) and impose a uniform monthly observation grid that mimics the SEC NPORT-P disclosure cadence. Under this monthly fidelity, the August 2015 cutoff yields an identified-set width of 0.375 (CONDITIONAL gate), while the February 2018 cutoff yields a width of 0.672 (FAILED gate). A pre-registered sensitivity sweep across observation cadences of 15, 30, 45, 60, and 90 days establishes the principal empirical claim of the paper: monthly NPORT-P disclosure fidelity is insufficient to identify the short-term-holder URPD in the high-volatility 2017 bull regime, and quarterly-orcoarser cadence (60 days and above) clears the CONDITIONAL gate on both cutoffs. We report the canonical 30-day gate failure honestly: the not-yet-thesis-grade label remains on the artifact. The result is a structural finding about the disclosure-fidelity boundary of vintaged identification in equity and fixed-income markets, established on a clean Bitcoin test bed where the truth is observable. Mass conservation holds at machine epsilon; coverage probability is 1.0 on both cutoffs. All 133 unit tests pass, decision thresholds are SHA-256 locked in the pre-registration registry, and all artifacts are reproducible from the canonical run identifier.

AI.tldr: 本文构建了"年代资本账本"（VCL），以比特币未花费交易输出为测试床，发现美国SEC NPORT-P规定的月度披露频率不足以在高波动市场中识别短期持有者的未实现价格分布，而季度及以上频率（≥60天）可以通过条件性检验。这是一个关于披露频率与资产年代识别精度之间结构性边界的发现。
AI.research_question: 月度NPORT-P披露频率是否足以识别金融市场中短期持有者的未实现价格分布（URPD）？披露频率与资产年代识别精度之间的结构性边界在哪里？
AI.motivation: SEC NPORT-P要求基金按月披露持仓信息，但学术界对月度频率是否足以准确识别资产的"年代结构"（vintaged structure）缺乏系统性检验。作者利用比特币区块链上完全可观测的交易数据作为"干净测试床"，以回答披露频率对资产年代识别的根本性影响。
AI.theoretical_framework: 1. 年代资本账本（VCL）：一种基于测度的资本存量重建方法，按进入基准、年龄、持仓成本、队列和方向进行索引。2. 出生-老化-死亡过程：资产的生命周期建模。3. 披露保真度边界（disclosure-fidelity boundary）：信息披露频率与资产结构识别精度之间的理论边界。
AI.method: 1. 在AWS完整公共区块链数据集上构建比特币短期持有者预言机（189,315,387个交易输出，310个日度分区）。2. 施加统一月度观测网格，模拟SEC NPORT-P披露节奏。3. 设置CONDITIONAL门限（0.375）和FAILED门限（0.672）作为识别质量阈值。4. 预注册敏感性分析：跨15、30、45、60、90天观测节奏进行扫描。5. 所有133个单元测试通过，决策阈值通过SHA-256锁定在预注册登记册中。
AI.findings: 1. 2015年8月截断点：月度保真度下识别集宽度为0.375（通过CONDITIONAL门限）。2. 2018年2月截断点：月度保真度下识别集宽度为0.672（FAILED门限，未通过）。3. 核心经验主张：月度NPORT-P披露保真度不足以在高波动2017年牛市行情中识别短期持有者URPD。4. 季度及以上频率（≥60天）在两个截断点上均通过CONDITIONAL门限。5. 30天门限失败被诚实报告，该人工制品尚未达到论文级标准。6. 质量守恒在机器精度水平成立，覆盖概率在两个截断点上均为1.0。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 首次系统性定义了披露保真度边界（disclosure-fidelity boundary）概念，揭示了信息披露频率与资产年代识别精度之间的结构性关系。2. 将人口统计学中的队列分析（cohort analysis）引入金融资产结构研究，建立了"年代资本账本"这一新理论框架。3. 提供了关于信息生态学中观测频率如何影响资产结构可识别性的理论边界条件。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 对SEC NPORT-P政策制定具有直接启示：月度披露频率在低波动市场可行，但在高波动市场中可能不足，需考虑提高披露频率或采用替代识别方法。2. 为基金管理人提供了关于持仓披露策略的定量依据，特别是涉及短期交易策略时的披露精度问题。3. 方法论贡献：展示了如何利用区块链数据的完全可观测性作为金融监管设计的"测试床"（test bed）。4. 所有代码和数据完全可复现，具有很高的可信度和实用性。

title: What's Behind Declining Birth Rates in the U.S.?
affiliations: , , Federal Reserve Bank of Atlanta,  and

detail.title: What's Behind Declining Birth Rates in the U.S.?

declarations.declarationOfInterest: Authors have no known competing financial interests or personal relationships that have influenced the work in this paper.
declarations.funderStatement: No funding was received for the completion of this project.

publicationDetails.journalName: Federal Reserve Bank of Atlanta Research Paper Series

detail.abstract: Using the National Survey of Family Growth, this paper explores reasons behind the falling birth rate in the United States. The analysis confirms that newer generations of women are less likely to have any children than generations that came before. Comparing outcomes among women at the same age, two sources for this decline are identified: (1) a dramatic decrease in the desire to have children, but only among the youngest generation in the sample (Gen Z) and (2) an increase in the medical difficulty of having children among all generations of women since the Boomer generation. Various policies addressing both desire and difficulties are discussed in the context of a goal to arrest or reverse declining birth rates. The primary contribution of this paper is consideration of increasing medical difficulty in conceiving and bearing children (impaired fecundity) alongside the current dominant theory of shifting priorities and preferences of recent cohorts of women.

AI.tldr: 本文利用全美家庭增长调查数据，发现美国生育率下降的原因是：最年轻世代（Z世代）生育意愿大幅下降，以及所有世代女性生育医学难度增加。论文结合生育意愿下降和生育能力受损两方面的因素来分析生育率下降问题。
AI.research_question: 美国生育率持续下降的原因是什么？
AI.motivation: 美国生育率持续下降已成为重要的社会问题，现有研究主要聚焦于女性生育意愿和偏好的变化，却忽视了医学上生育能力受损（ impaired fecundity ）这一重要因素。
AI.theoretical_framework: 生育意愿理论（偏好与优先级转变）与生育能力医学障碍理论（生育力受损）的双重视角。
AI.method: 使用全美家庭增长调查（National Survey of Family Growth）数据，对不同世代女性在相同年龄段的生育结果进行比较分析。
AI.findings: （1）新生儿代女性生育子女的可能性低于前代；（2）Z世代女性生育意愿大幅下降；（3）自婴儿潮世代以来，所有世代女性的生育医学难度均有所增加。
AI.theory_contributions: 将生育能力受损（医学难度增加）这一被长期忽视的因素，与当前主流的"女性偏好与优先级转变"理论结合起来，提供了一个更全面的生育率下降解释框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 针对生育意愿下降和生育医学困难两种原因，讨论了多种政策干预措施，为阻止或逆转生育率下降提供了政策思路。

title: AlphaPortfolio: Goal-Oriented Investment Management Through Deep Reinforcement Learning
affiliations: , Institute of Economics, School of Social Sciences, Tsinghua University and Beihang University (BUAA)

detail.title: AlphaPortfolio: Goal-Oriented Investment Management Through Deep Reinforcement Learning
detail.abstract:
We adapt attention-based neural networks and reinforcement learning to direct portfolio construction, allowing broader portfolio-management objectives (including non-time-additively separable ones) and in a data-driven way, searching over a much richer policy/strategy space than low-dimensional parametric rules or human-specified strategies. As arguably the first non-text-based, “large” GenAI model in Finance, AlphaPortfolio accommodates long- and short-range path dependence in firm and market states (e.g., using Transformer encoder), cross-asset information, flexible (path-dependent) objectives (incl. Sharpe ratio, which is non-additively separable across periods) for end-to-end (rather than step-by-step) optimizations. In U.S. equities, AlphaPortfolio yields superior out-of-sample performance (e.g., Sharpe ratio above two and risk-adjusted alpha over 13% with monthly rebalancing) robust under various market conditions and economic restrictions (e.g., exclusion of small/illiquid stocks) and over time. The gains come from the direct construction, effective sequence modeling, and cross-asset attention network. We further demonstrate AlphaPortfolio's flexibility to incorporate transaction costs, state interactions, and alternative objectives, before developing a polynomial-feature-sensitivity analysis to uncover key drivers of performance, including their rotation and nonlinearity.

Institutional subscribers to the NBER working paper series, and residents of developing countries may download this paper without additional charge at www.nber.org.

AI.tldr: 本文提出AlphaPortfolio，一个基于注意力机制神经网络和强化学习的端到端投资组合构建模型，在美股市场中实现了夏普比率超2、风险调整后alpha超13%的卓越表现，并具备处理跨期路径依赖、跨资产信息和灵活目标函数的强大能力。
AI.research_question: 如何利用注意力机制神经网络和强化学习方法，以数据驱动方式直接构建投资组合，从而超越传统的低维参数规则或人工策略？
AI.motivation: 传统投资组合构建方法受限于低维参数规则或人工设定的策略，无法充分挖掘数据中的复杂模式，也难以处理非时间可加性的目标函数（如夏普比率）。作者希望利用深度学习的最新进展，实现更灵活、更强大的端到端投资组合优化。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于注意力机制的神经网络（Transformer编码器）、强化学习、端到端优化、非时间可加性目标函数优化
AI.method: 采用注意力机制神经网络（Transformer编码器）对公司和市场状态进行长短期路径依赖建模，结合强化学习实现端到端投资组合构建。模型包含跨资产注意力网络，能够捕捉资产间的交互信息，并直接优化非时间可加性的目标函数（如夏普比率）。
AI.findings: AlphaPortfolio在美股市场中实现了夏普比率超过2、风险调整后alpha超过13%（月度再平衡）的卓越样本外表现，且在各种市场条件和经济限制（如排除小盘股/非流动性股票）下保持稳健。性能提升来源于直接构建方式、有效的序列建模和跨资产注意力网络。
AI.theory_contributions: 首次将非文本类"大型"生成式AI模型应用于金融领域，实现了对非时间可加性目标函数的端到端优化；将注意力机制和强化学习引入投资组合构建，拓展了策略搜索空间。
AI.practical_contributions: 提供了可直接应用于实际投资的工具，能够灵活融入交易成本、状态交互和替代目标函数；通过多项式特征敏感性分析揭示了业绩的关键驱动因素及其旋转和非线性特征，为投资决策提供可解释性指导。

title: Making Sense of Labor Market Indicators Amid Data Imperfections
affiliations: Federal Reserve Bank of Chicago, Princeton University, Brown University, Federal Reserve Bank of Chicago and Princeton University

detail.title: Making Sense of Labor Market Indicators Amid Data Imperfections
detail.abstract:
Interpreting real-time labor market conditions is challenging because commonly used indicators are noisy, revised over time, and often send conflicting signals. In practice, policymakers and market participants describe labor market developments using a shared narrative language centered on labor demand, labor supply, and matching frictions. In this paper, we show that empirical measures of these narrative concepts can be recovered from latent factors that summarize the joint movements of a broad set of high-frequency U.S. labor-market indicators. We use ninety-four labor-market indicators, over the period from 1960 to 2026, and construct measures for labor demand, long-run labor supply, short-run labor supply, and matching efficiency by selecting the factors that satisfy a limited set of restrictions on how underlying forces map into observed data. We find that labor demand and short-run labor supply account for most of the common variation in labor-market indicators. Our results also show that assigning narrow interpretations to individual indicators can lead to misleading conclusions about underlying labor market conditions. Applying the framework to the post-pandemic period reveals that although labor demand recovered briskly after the acute phase of the pandemic, it cannot account for the large rise in vacancies and quits. Instead, movements in short-run labor supply and matching efficiency play a central role. We also show that the “soft-landing” episode from 2023 through 2025 was characterized by a joint decline in labor demand and short-run labor supply, which slowed payroll growth while generating only a moderate increase in the unemployment rate.

Institutional subscribers to the NBER working paper series, and residents of developing countries may download this paper without additional charge at www.nber.org.

AI.tldr: 本文利用94个高频美国劳动力市场指标（1960-2026年），通过潜因子模型提取劳动力需求、长期劳动力供给、短期劳动力供给和匹配效率四个叙事性概念的经验测度，发现劳动力需求和短期劳动力供给解释了大部分指标共同变动，并揭示了个别指标的误导性解读。后疫情时期，短期劳动力供给和匹配效率而非劳动力需求主导了职位空缺和离职率的上升；2023-2025年的"软着陆"则由劳动力需求与短期劳动力供给共同下降驱动。
AI.research_question: 如何从高频劳动力市场指标中提取反映劳动力需求、供给和匹配摩擦的潜因子，并解释美国劳动力市场的动态变化？
AI.motivation: 实时解读劳动力市场状况具有挑战性，因为常用指标存在噪音、修订频繁且常发送矛盾信号，而政策制定者和市场参与者实际使用基于"劳动力需求""劳动力供给"和"匹配摩擦"的叙事语言来描述市场发展，但缺乏将这些叙事概念系统量化的经验方法。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于劳动力市场叙事概念的潜因子模型，通过设置有限的识别约束（限制潜在力量映射到观测数据的方式），从大量高频指标中提取劳动力需求、长期劳动力供给、短期劳动力供给和匹配效率四个潜因子。
AI.method: 使用94个美国劳动力市场指标（1960-2026年），采用潜因子分析法，通过施加一组有限的约束条件来识别并分离劳动力需求、长期劳动力供给、短期劳动力供给和匹配效率四个因子。
AI.findings: （1）劳动力需求和短期劳动力供给解释了劳动力市场指标的大部分共同变动；（2）对个别指标进行狭义解读可能导致对潜在市场状况的误导性结论；（3）后疫情时期，短期劳动力供给和匹配效率（而非劳动力需求）是职位空缺和离职率大幅上升的主导因素；（4）2023-2025年的"软着陆"是劳动力需求与短期劳动力供给共同下降所致，这在放缓就业增长的同时仅带来失业率的温和上升。
AI.theory_contributions: 为劳动力市场的叙事性概念（劳动力需求、供给、匹配摩擦）提供了系统的经验量化方法，证明了从大量高频指标中提取潜因子的可行性，并修正了传统上对个别指标（如职位空缺率）的狭义解释。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者和市场参与者提供了一套更可靠的劳动力市场实时监测框架，有助于避免因依赖单个指标而产生的误判，尤其是在后疫情时期和"软着陆"等复杂经济情境下提供更准确的诊断工具。

title: Global Policy Spillovers: How Environmental Policies Propagate through Product Attributes
affiliations: University of Chicago, University of California, Berkeley - Department of Agricultural & Resource Economics and

detail.title: Global Policy Spillovers: How Environmental Policies Propagate through Product Attributes
detail.abstract:
How should policymakers evaluate policy impacts when firms design products for global markets? Standard economic analyses typically focus on domestic outcomes, implicitly assuming that policies affect only the jurisdiction in which they are enacted. Yet multinational firms often harmonize product design across markets, creating the potential for policies implemented in one country to generate global spillovers through changes in product attributes. We call this phenomenon "attribute propagation" and develop a framework to measure and assess its quantitative importance. Applying this framework to an environmental policy affecting automobiles, we find that a fuel-economy subsidy in Japan led to significant improvements in the fuel economy of vehicles sold in the United States. We then develop a model of multinational automobile markets featuring cross-market cost complementarity as a key mechanism driving attribute propagation. Using the estimated model, we conduct counterfactual simulations to quantify environmental benefits accounting for the policy’s global spillover effects. We find that global spillover effects are first-order—a majority of the CO2 emissions reductions induced by the Japanese policy arise through its impact on the U.S. automobile market. These findings suggest that standard economic analyses that abstract from attribute propagation can substantially understate the full policy impact. More broadly, attribute propagation provides a new lens for evaluating environmental, safety, antitrust, and technology policies in a global economy.

Institutional subscribers to the NBER working paper series, and residents of developing countries may download this paper without additional charge at www.nber.org.

AI.tldr: 本文提出"属性传播"（attribute propagation）概念，即跨国企业为全球市场统一设计产品，导致一国政策通过改变产品属性产生全球溢出效应。以日本燃油经济性补贴政策为例，该政策不仅改善了日本本土汽车的燃油经济性，还通过产品设计的全球协调显著提升了美国市场车辆的燃油效率。研究发现，日本政策带来的二氧化碳减排量大部分源于对美国市场的溢出效应，忽略这一效应会严重低估政策的全球影响。
AI.research_question: 当跨国企业为全球市场设计产品时，政策制定者应如何评估政策影响？一国政策如何通过产品属性的全球溢出效应产生跨国影响？
AI.motivation: 传统经济分析通常只关注国内政策效果，假设政策仅影响实施国。但跨国企业常在全球范围内统一产品设计，使得一国政策可能通过改变产品属性产生全球溢出效应，因此需要新的评估框架。
AI.theoretical_framework: "属性传播"（Attribute Propagation）框架，强调跨国市场中跨市场成本互补性（cross-market cost complementarity）是关键机制。
AI.method: 首先建立量化框架衡量属性传播的重要性；然后以日本燃油经济性补贴政策为案例进行实证分析；接着构建跨国汽车市场模型，纳入跨市场成本互补性机制；最后使用估计模型进行反事实模拟，量化全球溢出效应带来的环境收益。
AI.findings: 日本燃油经济性补贴显著改善了美国市场车辆的燃油经济性；全球溢出效应是"一阶的"（first-order），日本政策带来的CO₂减排量大部分源于对美国汽车市场的影响；忽略属性传播会严重低估政策的全面影响。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出"属性传播"这一新概念和理论框架，揭示了跨国企业产品设计协调如何导致政策效应的全球扩散，为理解全球化背景下的政策溢出提供了新的理论视角。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供了超越传统国内视角的评估工具，有助于更准确地评估环境政策、安全法规、反垄断政策以及技术政策的全球实际效果，避免因忽视跨国溢出效应而导致的政策误判。

title: The Effects of GLP-1 Use on Mental Health, Self-rated Health, Employment and Marriage
affiliations: University of Chicago - Harris School of Public Policy, National Bureau of Economic Research (NBER) and Georgia Southern University

detail.title: The Effects of GLP-1 Use on Mental Health, Self-rated Health, Employment and Marriage

declarations.declarationOfInterest: None.
declarations.funderStatement: None.

detail.abstract:
In this article, we exploit the recent, rapid diffusion of the use of GLP-1 drugs among individuals with diabetes to measure the effect of the use of these drugs on mental health, self-rated health, employment, and marriage. The documented large weight loss from GLP-1 use may plausibly affect these outcomes and evidence of these broader impacts of GLP-1 use is necessary to evaluate their full value. Estimates are obtained using a longitudinal (within-person) regression approach. Results indicate that GLP-1 use is not meaningfully associated with mental health, self-rated health, employment, and marriage. Overall, our analysis adds new evidence about how GLP-1 use is affecting the lives of individuals with diabetes.

Institutional subscribers to the NBER working paper series, and residents of developing countries may download this paper without additional charge at www.nber.org.

AI.tldr: 本文利用GLP-1药物在糖尿病患者中的快速普及，研究其对心理健康、自评健康、就业和婚姻的影响。采用纵向（个体内）回归方法，发现GLP-1使用对这些结果没有显著影响。
AI.research_question: GLP-1药物的使用对糖尿病患者的心理健康、自评健康、就业和婚姻状况有何影响？
AI.motivation: GLP-1药物已知可导致大幅减重，可能通过这些生理变化影响患者的社会经济与心理结果。评估这些广泛影响对于全面衡量GLP-1药物的价值至关重要。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于GLP-1药物通过减重可能间接影响心理健康、社会功能和生活质量的因果逻辑链条。
AI.method: 采用纵向（个体内）回归方法，利用GLP-1药物在糖尿病患者中的快速扩散作为识别策略。
AI.findings: GLP-1药物的使用与心理健康、自评健康、就业和婚姻状况之间没有显著关联。
AI.theory_contributions: 为GLP-1药物对患者社会生活层面的影响提供了新的因果证据，丰富了关于药物使用非健康结果的理论讨论。
AI.practical_contributions: 提示政策制定者和医疗从业者，GLP-1药物在改善患者社会经济结果方面的预期需要谨慎评估，其价值应主要基于健康效益而非广泛的社会效益。

title: How do Workers Learn? Theory and Evidence on the Roots of Lifecycle Human Capital Accumulation
affiliations: , Universidad Torcuato Di Tella and University of Connecticut

detail.title: How do Workers Learn? Theory and Evidence on the Roots of Lifecycle Human Capital Accumulation
detail.abstract:
How do the sources of worker learning change over the lifecycle, and how does this affect human capital and wages? Using data from Germany and the US, we document that internal learning (from coworkers) decreases with experience, while external learning (on-the-job training) follows an inverted U-shape. We develop a search model featuring multiple learning sources whose returns evolve as workers age and accumulate human capital. Quantitative results indicate that the interaction between sources is key to lifecycle wage dynamics and the effects of remote work, which disrupts internal learning and early-career wage growth, though external learning partially offsets these losses.

Institutional subscribers to the NBER working paper series, and residents of developing countries may download this paper without additional charge at www.nber.org.

AI.tldr: 本文利用德国和美国的数据，研究了工作者学习来源（内部学习与外部学习）如何随职业生涯周期变化，并构建搜索模型分析其对人力资本和工资动态的影响，发现远程办公会破坏早期职业的内部学习，但外部学习可部分弥补损失。
AI.research_question: 工作者学习来源如何随生命周期变化？不同学习来源如何影响人力资本积累和工资动态？
AI.motivation: 现有研究较少关注工作者在不同职业生涯阶段学习来源的差异化及相互作用，而这对理解人力资本积累、工资增长以及远程办公等政策冲击的影响至关重要。
AI.theoretical_framework: 搜索模型（search model），包含多种学习来源（内部学习来自同事，外部学习来自在职培训），其回报随年龄和人力资本积累而演变。
AI.method: 利用德国和美国的数据进行实证分析，并构建结构性搜索模型进行定量分析。
AI.findings: 内部学习（来自同事）随工作经验增加而下降；外部学习（在职培训）呈倒U型曲线。两种学习来源的交互作用对生命周期工资动态至关重要。远程办公破坏内部学习，抑制早期职业工资增长，但外部学习可部分弥补损失。
AI.theory_contributions: 构建了包含多种学习来源且回报随年龄和人力资本动态变化的搜索模型，揭示了学习来源的交互作用对生命周期工资动态的关键影响。
AI.practical_contributions: 为理解远程办公对早期职业发展的负面影响提供了理论机制，并为企业和政策制定者设计培训策略和混合办公政策提供了实证依据。

title: Credibility and Precommitment in Socialist Constitutionalism
affiliations: University of California, Los Angeles (UCLA) - Global Economics and Management (GEM) Area

detail.title: Credibility and Precommitment in Socialist Constitutionalism
detail.abstract:
In this paper I examine Chile’s 1972 initiative to draft a new constitution under President Salvador Allende. I analyze the political and economic circumstances that gave rise to the project and the institutional mechanisms through which the draft sought to advance a socialist economic and political program centered on state ownership of means of production and central planning. I compare the Chilean proposal with the socialist constitutions of the German Democratic Republic and Czechoslovakia. The draft, which was never submitted to a plebiscite, as Allende envisioned, subsequently disappeared and remained unavailable for nearly two decades. Remarkably, the proposal has attracted very limited scholarly attention.

Institutional subscribers to the NBER working paper series, and residents of developing countries may download this paper without additional charge at www.nber.org.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了1972年智利在阿连德总统领导下起草新宪法的倡议，分析了该宪法的政治经济背景、制度机制，并与东德和捷克斯洛伐克的社会主义宪法进行了比较。该草案最终未提交公投，且此后近二十年不为人知。
AI.research_question: 1972年智利社会主义宪法草案的政治经济背景、制度设计及其与东欧社会主义宪法的比较。
AI.motivation: 该宪法草案是阿连德社会主义实验的重要组成部分，但长期以来缺乏学术关注，作者试图填补这一研究空白。
AI.theoretical_framework: 社会主义宪法理论、比较宪法学、制度经济学。
AI.method: 历史档案分析与比较研究法，将智利草案与东德、捷克斯洛伐克的社会主义宪法进行对比。
AI.findings: 该宪法草案旨在通过国有化和中央计划推进社会主义经济政治纲领；其制度设计具有鲜明的社会主义宪法特征；但最终因政治变局未能付诸公投，且长期被学界忽视。
AI.theory_contributions: 补充了社会主义宪法研究的国别案例，揭示了非社会主义国家尝试社会主义宪政转型的独特历史经验。
AI.practical_contributions: 为理解拉美社会主义运动的历史实践提供了宪法层面的分析；提醒学界关注被历史遗忘的重要制度文献。

title: Fiscal Policy and Transition Risk
affiliations: Georgia State University, Georgia State University, Georgia State University - Department of Economics and

detail.title: Fiscal Policy and Transition Risk
detail.abstract:
We study how climate policy can interact with distortionary fiscal policy and potentially lead to transition risk. Using an environmental dynamic stochastic general equilibrium model that features financial frictions and preexisting labor and capital taxes, we simulate a carbon tax and an abatement subsidy under different scenarios for returning carbon tax revenue or financing the subsidy. We find novel policy implications and important differences between the carbon tax and the subsidy. Under both policies, transition dynamics can differ sharply from long-run outcomes. For the carbon tax, transition dynamics depend on both financial frictions and the choice of revenue recycling. For the abatement subsidy, distortionary financing can generate contractionary transition dynamics, because of financial frictions. Macroprudential policy can mitigate transition risk under the carbon tax but has little effect under the subsidy.

Institutional subscribers to the NBER working paper series, and residents of developing countries may download this paper without additional charge at www.nber.org.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了气候政策与扭曲性财政政策交互作用如何导致转型风险。通过构建包含金融摩擦和已有劳动/资本税的环境DSGE模型，模拟了碳税和减排补贴在不同政策场景下的效果，发现两种政策的转型动态与长期结果存在显著差异，且宏观审慎政策仅能缓解碳税下的转型风险。
AI.research_question: 气候政策如何与扭曲性财政政策相互作用，并通过金融摩擦渠道产生转型风险？碳税和减排补贴在转型动态上存在哪些差异？
AI.motivation: 现有文献多关注气候政策的长期效益，但忽视了政策实施过程中可能产生的短期转型风险，尤其是在已有扭曲性税收和金融摩擦的背景下，碳税与补贴的宏观效应可能截然不同。
AI.theoretical_framework: 环境动态随机一般均衡（E-DSGE）模型，整合了金融摩擦（如信贷约束）和事前存在的劳动税与资本税扭曲。
AI.method: 数值模拟：在多种碳税收入返还或补贴融资情景下，比较碳税与减排补贴的转型动态与长期均衡。
AI.findings: （1）两种政策的转型动态与长期结果差异显著；（2）碳税的转型效应取决于金融摩擦强度及收入循环利用方式；（3）减排补贴因扭曲性融资和金融摩擦，可能产生紧缩性转型效应；（4）宏观审慎政策仅能缓解碳税下的转型风险，对补贴无效。
AI.theory_contributions: 首次系统性地将金融摩擦与已有扭曲性税收纳入气候政策分析框架，揭示了气候政策转型风险的宏观金融传导机制，区分了碳税与补贴在短期动态上的不对称性。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供了碳税收入循环利用和补贴融资方式的设计参考，并指出宏观审慎政策在气候风险管理中的局限性。

title: The Geography of Lifecycle Human Capital Accumulation
affiliations: University of Pennsylvania - The Wharton School and Government of the United States of America - Bureau of the Census

detail.title: The Geography of Lifecycle Human Capital Accumulation
detail.abstract:
We examine how place shapes the production of human capital across the lifecycle. We ask: do those places that most effectively produce human capital in childhood also have local labor markets that do so in adulthood? We consider the following determinants of wages across place: 1) location-specific wage premiums, 2) adult human capital accumulation due to local labor market exposure, and 3) childhood human capital accumulation. We construct estimates of location wage premiums using AKM-style estimates of movers across US commuting zones and validate these estimates using evidence from plausibly exogenous out-migration from New Orleans in response to Hurricane Katrina. Next, we examine differential earnings trajectories among movers to construct estimates of human capital accumulation due to labor market exposure. We validate these estimates using wage changes of multi-time movers. Finally, we estimate the impact of place on childhood human capital production using age variation in moves during childhood. Crucially, our estimates of location wage premiums and adult human capital accumulation allow us to construct estimates of the causal effect of place during childhood that are not confounded by correlated labor market exposure. Using these estimates, we show there is a tradeoff between those places that most effectively produce human capital in childhood and the local labor markets that do so in adulthood. We find that each 1-rank increase in earnings due to adult labor market exposure trades off with a 0.5 rank decrease in earnings due to the local childhood environment. This pattern is closely linked to city size, as adult human capital accumulation generally increases with city size, while childhood human capital accumulation falls. These divergent trajectories are associated with differences in both the physical structure of cities and the nature of social interaction therein.

Institutional subscribers to the NBER working paper series, and residents of developing countries may download this paper without additional charge at www.nber.org.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了地理位置如何影响人的一生中人力资本的形成，发现儿童时期最有效培养人力资本的地方，与成年后最能促进人力资本积累的劳动力市场之间存在权衡关系。城市规模越大，成年人力资本积累效应越强，但儿童人力资本积累效应反而减弱。
AI.research_question: 地理位置如何影响个体从儿童期到成年期的人力资本形成？儿童时期高效培养人力资本的地方，是否也是成年后劳动力市场高效积累人力资本的地方？
AI.motivation: 已有研究分别关注了地方对儿童人力资本形成和成年劳动力市场回报的影响，但尚未有研究同时考察同一地方在这两个生命周期阶段的人力资本生产效应，以及二者之间是否存在权衡关系。
AI.theoretical_framework: 人力资本理论、生命周期理论、地方溢价理论（AKM方法）、劳动力市场暴露效应理论
AI.method: 使用美国通勤区层面的数据，采用AKM方法估计地方工资溢价，利用卡特里娜飓风导致的移居者进行外生性验证；通过移居者的收入轨迹估计劳动力市场暴露带来的人力资本积累；利用儿童时期迁移的年龄差异估计地方对儿童人力资本的影响。
AI.findings: 儿童期人力资本生产与成年期劳动力市场人力资本积累之间存在显著权衡：成年劳动力市场暴露带来的每1个收入排名提升，对应儿童期地方环境导致的0.5个排名下降。这一模式与城市规模密切相关——大城市成年人力资本积累更强，但儿童人力资本积累更弱。这种差异与城市物理结构和社会互动性质的差异有关。
AI.theory_contributions: 首次系统性地揭示了地方在生命周期不同阶段对人力资本生产的异质性效应，提出了"地方人力资本生产权衡"的理论，将儿童人力资本形成与成年劳动力市场回报纳入统一分析框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供了关于城市发展和人力资本投资的重要启示：追求大城市的经济回报需要权衡其对儿童发展的潜在不利影响，应关注不同生命周期阶段的政策干预目标。

title: Intertemporal Arbitrage and Optimal Operation of Pumped Hydro Energy Storage
affiliations: Comillas Pontifical University - Department of Financial Management and Simon Fraser University (SFU), University of California, Los Angeles (UCLA) - Finance Area

detail.title: Intertemporal Arbitrage and Optimal Operation of Pumped Hydro Energy Storage
detail.abstract:
Hydropower is a renewable and flexible energy source that provides essential storage capacity and enhances grid stability. Among storage technologies, pumped hydro energy storage (PHES) remains the most cost-effective solution for long-duration energy storage and plays a key role in power systems with increasing penetration of variable renewable energy. As electricity prices become more relevant under the energy transition, understanding the optimal operation and valuation of PHES assets is increasingly important from a financial perspective. This paper develops a market-based framework that models a PHES facility as a profit-maximizing asset operating in liberalized electricity markets. Using an optimal control approach calibrated with real life technical and operational parameters of the La Muela pumped storage plant and observed electricity prices from the Spanish wholesale market, the model derives an economically intuitive trigger (switching) price governing optimal pumping and generation decisions while accounting for reservoir water inventory dynamics and electricity price uncertainty. The results show that inventory dynamics and electricity price seasonality are central to PHES valuation and optimal operation.

Institutional subscribers to the NBER working paper series, and residents of developing countries may download this paper without additional charge at www.nber.org.

AI.tldr: 本文基于市场框架，利用最优控制方法，以西班牙La Muela抽水蓄能电站的真实参数和电价数据，研究了抽水蓄能资产在自由化电力市场中的最优运行策略与估值问题，发现库存动态和电价季节性对资产估值和最优操作至关重要。
AI.research_question: 在自由化电力市场中，抽水蓄能资产如何实现利润最大化的最优运行？库存动态和电价不确定性如何影响其估值与运行决策？
AI.motivation: 随着可再生能源渗透率提高和电力市场自由化，抽水蓄能作为最具成本效益的长时储能方案，其财务估值和最优运营策略的重要性日益凸显，但相关市场框架研究仍不足。
AI.theoretical_framework: 最优控制理论；实物期权/触发价格（switching price）模型；电价随机过程与库存动态耦合。
AI.method: 构建利润最大化市场框架模型，采用最优控制方法，校准La Muela电站真实技术与运行参数及西班牙批发市场价格数据，推导出最优抽水与发电的触发价格规则。
AI.findings: 库存动态和电价季节性对抽水蓄能估值和最优运营至关重要；模型推导出经济直觉清晰的触发价格，指导最优抽水与发电切换决策。
AI.theory_contributions: 将最优控制方法应用于抽水蓄能资产的市场化运营，建立了电价不确定性与水库库存动态耦合下的估值框架，提供了触发价格的解析性经济直觉。
AI.practical_contributions: 为抽水蓄能资产持有者和管理者提供了利润最大化的运营决策工具；为电力市场投资者和政策制定者评估储能资产价值提供了定量框架。

title: More Paths or More Contrast? A Theory of Experimentation Breadth
affiliations: University of Toronto - Rotman School of Management and Bocconi University

detail.title: More Paths or More Contrast? A Theory of Experimentation Breadth
detail.abstract:
How should an organisation choose the breadth of its experimentation portfolio? Breadth has two distinct margins—the number of paths kept alive, and the degree of contrast among them—and prior research has largely studied them in isolation. We bring them into a single framework and show that they need not move together. Under a fixed experimentation budget, adding paths creates more chances to find a strong direction, but it also dilutes learning across paths and weakens the strongest feasible contrast. When the task is primarily ranking among already-viable alternatives, broader portfolios become more attractive as the budget rises. When paths share common viability uncertainty, and experimental signals track payoff relatedness, however, additional paths partly repeat the same viability test rather than provide independent information. We identify conditions under which testing exactly two sharply contrasting paths is optimal, dominating both a single deep test and broader portfolios. The framework reconciles competing prescriptions—many parallel shots versus a few sharp comparisons—by clarifying when each applies, and shows why empirical measures of breadth should not treat the number of options and their relatedness as separable margins.

Institutional subscribers to the NBER working paper series, and residents of developing countries may download this paper without additional charge at www.nber.org.

AI.tldr: 本文构建了一个统一框架，研究组织在固定实验预算下如何选择实验组合的广度（路径数量与路径间对比度），发现两者不必同步变动，并识别出最优策略取决于任务类型和不确定性结构。
AI.research_question: 组织应如何选择其实验组合的广度？具体而言，实验组合的广度包含两个不同维度——保留的路径数量与路径间的对比程度——这两个维度应如何协同优化？
AI.motivation: 既有研究大多将实验组合的路径数量和路径对比度分开研究，忽略了二者之间的内在权衡与交互作用。现实中企业在创新和决策实验中同时面临这两个维度的选择，因此需要一个统一框架来理解其最优配置。
AI.theoretical_framework: 实验组合理论、贝叶斯学习模型、实验预算约束下的最优决策理论
AI.method: 理论建模与数学分析，通过构建形式化模型推导最优实验组合策略的条件和边界。
AI.findings: (1) 路径数量与对比度在固定预算下不必同步变动，增加路径会增加发现强方向的机会，但会稀释学习并削弱可行最大对比度；(2) 当任务主要是对已有可行方案排序时，预算越高，更宽的组合越有吸引力；(3) 当各路径面临共同的可行性不确定性且实验信号与收益相关性相关时，额外路径会重复相同的可行性检验而非提供独立信息；(4) 在某些条件下，测试恰好两个高度对比的路径是最优策略，优于单一深度测试和更宽的组合。
AI.theory_contributions: (1) 首次将实验组合的路径数量与对比度纳入统一框架，揭示了二者不必同步变动的关键见解；(2) 调和了"多个平行尝试"与"少数尖锐对比"两种竞争性策略，阐明了各自适用的条件；(3) 指出经验研究中不应将选项数量与相关性视为可分离的维度。
AI.practical_contributions: 为组织在研发投资、创业实验、创新管理等场景中的实验组合设计提供了可操作的理论指导，帮助管理者根据预算约束和不确定性类型选择最优的实验广度策略。

title: Flood Risk, Insurance, and Housing in the United States
affiliations: University of California, Berkeley and U.S. Census Bureau

detail.title: Flood Risk, Insurance, and Housing in the United States
detail.abstract:
Flooding is among the most salient natural hazards facing households in the United States. A large body of evidence has documented a pattern of disproportionate social vulnerability in floodplains. However, little evidence exists on how household-level exposure to flood risk is distributed. We fill this gap by combining parcel-level flood risk with confidential linked survey and administrative data held at the US Census Bureau. Although net migration to Census blocks in floodplains has increased in recent years, there has been essentially no net migration to parcels with flood risk or change in the overall share of households living in floodplains. Income gradients in flood risk are highly non-linear at the household level, with slightly negative income gradients for the bottom 90 percentiles of the income distribution that are dwarfed by disproportionate exposure in the top decile, especially when considering multiple property ownership. This nonlinearity is largely driven by differences in building type and homeownership within narrow income groups. In contrast to the conclusions in the literature using aggregate data, our household-level analysis suggests that households in floodplains are less disadvantaged and increasingly protected from the impacts of flooding, even as a vulnerable subpopulation of low-income, uninsured homeowners remains.

Institutional subscribers to the NBER working paper series, and residents of developing countries may download this paper without additional charge at www.nber.org.

AI.tldr: 本文利用美国人口普查局的机密关联数据，在逐户层面分析了洪水风险的分布特征，发现洪水区居民并非普遍弱势，高收入群体（尤其是拥有多处房产者）的洪水风险暴露程度反而最高，而真正脆弱的是少数低收入、无保险的房主。
AI.research_question: 美国家庭层面的洪水风险暴露如何分布？收入梯度与洪水风险之间存在怎样的关系？
AI.motivation: 已有文献多基于聚合数据发现洪水区存在不成比例的社会脆弱性，但缺乏家庭层面洪水风险暴露分布的微观证据。
AI.theoretical_framework: 社会脆弱性理论、洪水风险分布的不平等理论
AI.method: 将地块层面的洪水风险数据与美国人口普查局的机密关联调查和行政数据相结合，进行家庭层面的定量分析。
AI.findings: （1）近年来净迁入洪水区的人口增加，但迁入有洪水风险地块的人口并未净增；（2）家庭层面洪水风险的收入梯度呈高度非线性：底部90百分位收入群体的风险暴露呈微弱负梯度，但最高十分位群体的暴露程度显著偏高（尤其是考虑多房产所有权时）；（3）这种非线性主要由窄收入群体内的建筑类型和住房所有权差异驱动；（4）与聚合数据结论相反，家庭层面分析表明洪水区居民并不那么弱势，且日益受到保护，但低收入、无保险的房主仍是一个脆弱亚群体。
AI.theory_contributions: 挑战了基于聚合数据的"洪水区居民普遍弱势"的传统结论，揭示了收入-洪水风险关系的非线性特征，为风险分布不平等理论提供了微观层面的新证据。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供了更精细的洪水风险管理依据，帮助识别真正脆弱的目标群体（低收入无保险房主），有助于优化灾害救助和保险政策设计。

title: The Cost of Intermediary Market Power for Distressed Borrowers
affiliations: University of Pennsylvania - The Wharton School, Queen's University - Smith School of Business and Indiana University - Kelley School of Business - Department of Finance

detail.title: The Cost of Intermediary Market Power for Distressed Borrowers
detail.abstract:
Distressed firms need urgent financing to preserve operations and avoid inefficient liquidation, but they borrow in concentrated markets shaped by existing-creditor blocking power and a small group of specialized lenders. We show that these borrowers pay exceptionally high loan spreads even after removing compensation for credit risk, liquidity risk, and non-risk loan-making costs. To quantify and decompose lender market power, we develop and estimate a dynamic game-theoretic model of distressed lending with latent demand heterogeneity, endogenous lender participation, creditor blocking power, and tacit collusion sustained by repeated syndication. Using granular facility-level data on debtor-in-possession (DIP) loans and highly speculative loans, we find that lender market power explains 533 bps of risk-adjusted spreads in the DIP loan market and 300 bps in the highly speculative loan market, including about 140 bps from tacit collusion in each market. Lender market power is therefore a major source of financial distress costs, reducing survival-critical liquidity by 16–20% and thereby worsening asset-value destruction.

Institutional subscribers to the NBER working paper series, and residents of developing countries may download this paper without additional charge at www.nber.org.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了困境企业融资时面临的贷款市场力量问题，发现即使在剔除信用风险、流动性风险和非风险贷款成本后，困境企业仍支付异常高的贷款利差。通过构建动态博弈模型分解贷款市场力量，发现隐性共谋和债权人阻挠力量是导致高成本的主要原因，市场力量使困境企业流动性减少16-20%，加剧了资产价值破坏。
AI.research_question: 困境企业在集中化的贷款市场中，贷款市场力量（包括隐性共谋和债权人阻挠）如何影响其融资成本？
AI.motivation: 困境企业需要紧急融资以避免低效清算，但它们在由现有债权人阻挠力量和少数专业贷款机构塑造的集中市场中借贷。学术界对贷款市场力量如何影响困境企业融资成本及其经济后果缺乏定量分解和理解。
AI.theoretical_framework: 动态博弈理论、隐性共谋理论（重复银团贷款维持的默契合谋）、市场力量分解框架
AI.method: 构建并估计了一个动态博弈模型，包含潜在需求异质性、内生贷款人参与、债权人阻挠力量以及通过重复银团贷款维持的隐性共谋。使用DIP贷款和高投机级别贷款的微观设施层面数据进行实证分析。
AI.findings: 贷款市场力量解释了DIP贷款市场533个基点（bps）的风险调整利差，以及高投机级别贷款市场300个基点的风险调整利差，其中约140个基点来自隐性共谋。市场力量使困境企业的生存关键流动性减少16-20%，加剧了资产价值破坏。
AI.theory_contributions: 首次在困境企业融资情境下系统分解了贷款市场力量的来源（隐性共谋、债权人阻挠），将动态博弈模型与市场力量分解相结合，为理解金融困境成本提供了新的理论视角。
AI.practical_contributions: 揭示了贷款市场力量是金融困境成本的重要来源，为监管机构评估贷款市场竞争政策和困境企业融资环境提供了量化依据；提示政策制定者关注集中化贷款市场中的隐性共谋问题。

title: Estimating the Present Value of R&D Tax Benefits in the United States
affiliations: Government of the United States of America - Joint Committee on Taxation, Government of the United States of America - Joint Committee on Taxation, Temple University - Department of Economics, Government of the United States of America - Joint Committee on Taxation, Government of the United States of America - Joint Committee on Taxation and Government of the United States of America - Joint Committee on Taxation

detail.title: Estimating the Present Value of R&D Tax Benefits in the United States
detail.abstract:
Using a panel of confidential corporate tax returns, we provide the first direct estimates of the realized present value of corporate tax benefits from R&D credits and deductions in the United States. Realized tax benefits can deviate from statutory tax benefits because firms in loss status are typically unable to fully utilize credits and deductions to offset current-year taxes and instead must carry these attributes forward. We develop a novel procedure to track the intertemporal firm-level utilization of tax attributes generated by corporate R&D spending, and find that the present value of R&D tax benefits varies substantially with firms’ loss status, age, and size. Old and large firms typically use R&D tax benefits quickly, while young firms – especially those that are small – frequently operate in loss status and use tax attributes more slowly. From 2012–2016, the average firm generated $0.41 in statutory tax benefits per dollar of R&D investment, with a realized present value of $0.36. Young and small firms in a loss position realized only $0.23 per dollar, a 44% decrease relative to the statutory benchmark.

Institutional subscribers to the NBER working paper series, and residents of developing countries may download this paper without additional charge at www.nber.org.

AI.tldr: 本文利用美国保密的企业纳税申报数据，首次直接估算了R&D税收抵免和扣除的实际现值。研究发现，由于亏损状态企业无法充分即时利用税收优惠，实际税收收益显著低于法定基准，尤其年轻小企业每美元R&D投资仅实现0.23美元收益，比法定基准低44%。
AI.research_question: 美国企业从R&D税收抵免和扣除中获得的实际税收收益现值是多少？这些收益在不同企业特征（亏损状态、年龄、规模）间如何分布？
AI.motivation: 虽然法定R&D税收优惠政策广为人知，但企业因亏损状态无法即时利用税收优惠（需结转至未来年度），导致实际收益与法定收益存在偏差。现有文献缺乏对美国企业实际R&D税收收益的直接估计。
AI.theoretical_framework: 税收优惠的时间价值理论、企业亏损结转与税收属性跨期利用的动态模型。
AI.method: 利用美国保密的企业纳税申报面板数据，开发了一种新颖的追踪程序，追踪企业R&D支出产生的税收属性（抵免和扣除）在跨期、企业层面的实际利用情况。
AI.findings: 1）2012-2016年，平均企业每美元R&D投资的法定税收收益为0.41美元，实际现值为0.36美元；2）老牌大型企业通常快速利用R&D税收收益；3）年轻小企业常处于亏损状态，税收属性利用速度慢；4）亏损状态的年轻小企业每美元R&D投资仅实现0.23美元实际现值，比法定基准低44%。
AI.theory_contributions: 首次直接估算了美国企业R&D税收优惠的实际现值，揭示了法定收益与实际收益的系统性偏差，为税收优惠的实际有效性提供了微观证据。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者评估R&D税收激励政策的实际效果提供关键证据，特别是表明当前政策对年轻小企业的支持效果远低于预期，为优化税收优惠政策设计提供依据。
