title: Medical Innovation and Racial Health Disparities: Evidence from a Breakthrough Treatment
affiliations: Montana State University - Bozeman - Department of Agricultural Economics and Economics, Yale School of Management and Charles III University of Madrid

detail.title: Medical Innovation and Racial Health Disparities: Evidence from a Breakthrough Treatment

declarations.declarationOfInterest: None.
declarations.funderStatement: Dr. Anderson acknowledges support from a Eunice Kennedy Shriver National Institute of Child Health and Human Development research infrastructure grant, R24 HD042828, to the Center for Studies in Demography and Ecology at the University of Washington. Dr. Rees acknowledges support from Grant PID2024-157918NB-I00 funded by MCIN/AEI/ 10.13039/501100011033.

detail.abstract: Whether medical innovation exacerbates or reduces racial health disparities remains an open question. We study surfactant replacement therapy (SRT), a life-saving intervention for premature infants with respiratory disorders. Before its approval by the FDA in 1989, premature Black infants were much less likely than their White counterparts to die from respiratory-related causes. Within a few years of FDA approval, the Black-White gap in respiratory-related neonatal mortality had essentially disappeared. Using 1980-2000 vital statistics data and non-respiratory-related mortality as a counterfactual outcome, we find that both Blacks and Whites benefited from the introduction of SRT, but White neonates experienced larger and more immediate reductions in mortality. We estimate that, by 1993, SRT had reduced respiratory-related mortality among White neonates by 46 percent, compared to 30 percent for Black neonates. These results are not explained by differences in health care access, as proxied by socioeconomic status or distance to the nearest neonatal intensive care unit. We conclude that racial differences in fetal pulmonary maturation, rather than barriers to access, likely drove the uneven impact of SRT on neonatal mortality.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了表面活性剂替代疗法（SRT）对新生儿死亡率种族差异的影响。1989年FDA批准SRT后，黑人和白人婴儿的呼吸道相关死亡率差距基本消失，但白人婴儿的死亡率降幅更大（46% vs 30%）。研究发现，这种差异并非由医疗可及性导致，而可能源于种族间胎儿肺部成熟度的差异。
AI.research_question: 医疗创新是加剧还是减少种族健康差距？具体而言，表面活性剂替代疗法（SRT）对黑人和白人新生儿死亡率的影响有何不同？
AI.motivation: 医疗创新对种族健康差距的影响方向尚不明确，既有研究认为创新可能扩大差距（因特权群体先受益），也可能缩小差距（因针对弱势群体的疾病）。本文利用SRT这一外生冲击提供因果证据。
AI.theoretical_framework: 技术扩散理论（新医疗技术对不同群体的受益程度差异）、健康差距的决定因素框架（区分医疗可及性与生物学机制）
AI.method: 使用1980-2000年生命统计数据，以非呼吸道相关死亡作为反事实对照，采用双重差分等因果推断方法。
AI.findings: （1）FDA批准SRT后，黑-白新生儿呼吸道死亡率差距基本消失；（2）白人新生儿死亡率降幅更大且更迅速（1993年降46% vs 黑人30%）；（3）这种差异不能用社会经济地位或距离NICU远近来解释；（4）种族间胎儿肺部成熟度差异是主要原因。
AI.theory_contributions: 揭示了医疗技术扩散中种族差异的生物学机制（而非单纯可及性），为技术创新与健康不平等理论提供了新证据。
AI.practical_contributions: 为公共卫生政策制定者提供了重要启示：即使医疗技术普及，生物学差异也可能导致不同群体的受益程度不同，需针对性地调整干预策略。

reference: GWU Legal Studies Research Paper No. 2026-39; GWU Law School Public Law Research Paper No. 2026-39
title: Policy Brief: The OCC Has Violated Four Federal Statutes by Allowing National Trust Banks to Engage in Crypto-Related Nonfiduciary Activities, including the Issuance of Stablecoins
affiliations: George Washington University Law School

detail.title: Policy Brief: The OCC Has Violated Four Federal Statutes by Allowing National Trust Banks to Engage in Crypto-Related Nonfiduciary Activities, including the Issuance of Stablecoins

keywords: Office of the Comptroller of the Currency

publicationDetails.detailsText: GWU Legal Studies Research Paper No. 2026-39
publicationDetails.journalName: George Washington University Law School Legal Studies Research Paper Series

publicationDetails.detailsText: GWU Law School Public Law Research Paper No. 2026-39
publicationDetails.journalName: George Washington University Law School, Public Law & Legal Theory Research Paper Series

detail.abstract:
The Office of the Comptroller of the Currency (“OCC”) has recently approved charters for nine limited-purpose national trust banks controlled by crypto firms (hereinafter “NTB charter approvals”). The OCC’s NTB charter approvals permit those national trust banks to engage in a wide range of nonfiduciary crypto-related activities. The OCC’s NTB charter approvals violate four federal statutes and must be rescinded. Under 12 U.S.C. §§ 27(a) and 92a, national trust banks are authorized to exercise only fiduciary powers and to act solely in federally-recognized fiduciary capacities. Sections 27(a) and 92a forbid the OCC from allowing national trust banks to engage in any nonfiduciary activities.

Three of the OCC’s NTB charter approvals involve national trust banks that converted from state-chartered trust companies.  The OCC claims that state-to-federal charter conversions allow national trust banks to engage in nonfiduciary crypto-related activities that were permissible for their state-chartered predecessors.  In fact, those charter conversion approvals violate 12 U.S.C. § 35.  Section 35 prohibits national trust banks, following state-to-federal charter conversions, from exercising any nonfiduciary powers or engaging in any nonfiduciary activities, regardless of whether their state-chartered predecessors could do so under state law.

Four of the OCC’s NTB charter approvals allow national trust banks to issue stablecoins while acting in nonfiduciary roles.  Those charter approvals violate 12 U.S.C. §§ 92a(d) and 378(a)(2).  The issuance of stablecoins in nonfiduciary roles by national trust banks constitutes an illegal acceptance of “deposits,” prohibited by §§ 92a(d) and 378(a)(2).

The OCC’s unlawful NTB charter approvals pose grave and unacceptable risks to U.S. financial and economic stability by allowing uninsured national trust banks to engage in highly speculative activities involving hazardous and extremely volatile crypto-assets. The OCC does not have any viable plan or external source of funding to deal with failures of crypto-focused national trust banks. As a result, threatened failures of large crypto-focused national trust banks are likely to precipitate bailouts, imposing significant losses on federal agencies and taxpayers.

The OCC must immediately rescind all nine of its NTB charter approvals.  The OCC may not approve a charter for any national trust bank unless that bank exercises only fiduciary powers, acts solely in federally-recognized fiduciary capacities, and complies fully with the requirements of §§ 27(a) & 92a.

AI.tldr: 本文论证美国货币监理署（OCC）批准九家加密公司控制的有限目的全国性信托银行牌照违反了四项联邦法律，必须立即撤销，因为这些银行被允许从事非受托人加密活动，构成违法存款吸收，并对金融稳定构成重大风险。
AI.research_question: OCC批准加密企业控制的有限目的全国性信托银行牌照是否合法？这些牌照应否被撤销？
AI.motivation: OCC批准九家加密公司控制的全国性信托银行从事非受托人加密活动，可能违反联邦法律并对美国金融和经济稳定构成严重风险。
AI.theoretical_framework: 联邦成文法解释（12 U.S.C. §§ 27(a)、92a、35、92a(d)、378(a)(2)），以及银行监管中的"受托人权力"与"非受托人活动"的法律边界。
AI.method: 法律条文分析与解释，结合具体案例（九家信托银行牌照）进行违法性论证。
AI.findings: 1. OCC的NTB牌照批准违反§27(a)和§92a，允许信托银行从事非受托人活动；2. 三家州转联邦的转换批准违反§35；3. 四家批准发行稳定币的银行违反§92a(d)和§378(a)(2)，构成非法吸收存款；4. 无保险的信托银行从事高风险加密活动可能引发救助危机。
AI.theory_contributions: 明确了全国性信托银行的法定权力边界仅限于"受托人职权"，并澄清了"州转联邦"转换后的权力范围、稳定币发行是否构成"存款"等法律争议。
AI.practical_contributions: 为监管机构提供了明确的法律合规指引：OCC应立即撤销九家牌照，未来批准信托银行牌照必须要求其仅从事受托人活动并遵守§27(a)和§92a。

title: From Summer to Spring: A Shift in US Housing Market Seasonality
affiliations: Cardiff University - Cardiff Business School - Economics Section and University of Cambridge

detail.title: From Summer to Spring: A Shift in US Housing Market Seasonality
detail.abstract: The US housing market exhibits pronounced seasonal cycles: prices and sales rise through spring, peak in summer, and decline through autumn and winter. Since 2021, this pattern has shifted earlier in the calendar year, with spring strengthening at the expense of the traditional summer peak. A leading explanation for housing market seasonality is the search-and-matching model of Ngai and Tenreyro (2014), which links these cycles to household mobility through a thick-market mechanism. In this framework, periods with higher mobility generate thicker markets and higher prices and transaction volumes. Viewed through this lens, a shift in the seasonal cycle of prices and sales raises the question of whether the timing of household moves has changed. Did residential mobility shift earlier in the calendar year after 2021? We find that it did. Using SIPP data, and corroborating evidence from Google Trends indicators, we document a post-2021 shift in mobility toward spring. We extend the model to a monthly frequency, prove the existence and uniqueness of the equilibrium, and calibrate it to the observed mobility patterns. The calibrated model reproduces the spring shift in both prices and transaction volumes, consistent with the view that a change in the timing of household mobility alone can account for the recent shift in housing market seasonality.

AI.tldr: 本文发现2021年后美国住房市场的季节模式发生了春季提前的转变，并证明家庭搬迁时间的季节性变化是导致这一现象的主要原因。通过扩展搜索匹配模型至月度频率，校准后的模型成功复现了房价和交易量的春季提前特征。
AI.research_question: 2021年后美国住房市场价格和销售季节模式为何提前（春季增强、夏季峰值减弱）？家庭搬迁时间的季节性变化是否是其驱动因素？
AI.motivation: 美国住房市场存在显著季节性周期（春涨夏峰秋冬跌），但2021年后这一模式提前了。现有理论（Ngai & Tenreyro, 2014）将住房市场季节性归因于家庭搬迁的"厚市场机制"，因此有必要检验家庭搬迁时间是否也发生了春季提前。
AI.theoretical_framework: 搜索匹配模型（Search-and-Matching Model）及厚市场机制（Thick-Market Mechanism）：搬迁活动更多的时期形成更厚的市场，从而提高价格和交易量。
AI.method: 使用SIPP数据（Survey of Income and Program Participation）测量家庭搬迁的季节模式，并用谷歌趋势数据作为佐证；将Ngai-Tenreyro模型扩展至月度频率，证明均衡存在唯一性，并根据观测到的搬迁模式进行校准。
AI.findings: 2021年后，美国家庭搬迁活动确实向春季提前；校准后的模型表明，仅搬迁时间的季节性变化就足以复现房价和交易量的春季提前特征。
AI.theory_contributions: 将搜索匹配模型从季度频率扩展至月度频率，并证明了均衡的存在性与唯一性；为住房市场季节性的动态变化提供了理论解释。
AI.practical_contributions: 帮助市场参与者（如房地产从业者、购房者）理解住房市场季节模式变化的原因；为政策制定者预测市场走势提供依据。

reference: University of Missouri School of Law Legal Studies Research Paper No. 2026-40; Tax Law Review, forthcoming
title: The Federal Taxing Power in Its New Constitutional Era
affiliations: University of Missouri School of Law and Fordham University School of Law

detail.title: The Federal Taxing Power in Its New Constitutional Era

publicationDetails.detailsText: University of Missouri School of Law Legal Studies Research Paper No. 2026-40
publicationDetails.journalName: University of Missouri School of Law Legal Studies Research Paper Series

detail.abstract:
A paradox now sits at the heart of constitutional tax law. Recent jurisprudence culminating in Moore v. United States has presumably revived the realization requirement as a constitutional constraint while also reaffirming that income taxes rest on Article I’s excise power. Those commitments reflect potentially competing conceptions of the federal taxing power: one seemingly limiting Congress through realization-tied definitions of “income,” the other treating excises as a broad category that can reach wealth-adjacent tax bases, potentially including unrealized income. This recent jurisprudence leaves both many long-standing tax provisions and major reform proposals on uncertain constitutional ground.

This Article synthesizes this jurisprudence to describe a theory of the taxing power for this new era. We argue that sense can be made of the competing lines of cases by seeing the key constitutional questions as structural, not definitional: first, whether a tax provision targets a proper excise subject—an activity, transaction, or institutional participation distinct from ownership as such—and, second, whether statutory design keeps liability bounded to and satisfiable from that taxed base. We develop these questions through our proposed Base-Tether framework, an interpretive reconstruction that synthesizes the anti-detachment intuition from Moore and Eisner v. Macomber with the long line of excise tax cases. While we view the taxing power at the founding as originally broader than this, we are undoubtedly now in a new constitutional era that scholars, attorneys, and policymakers must take seriously. The Base-Tether framework supplies drafting and litigation guidance for navigating the post-Moore minefield of uncertainty as to which tax provisions are constitutionally vulnerable.

AI.tldr: 本文提出"Base-Tether"框架，认为后Moore时代的宪法税收问题应从结构性而非定义性角度理解：税收条款是否针对与所有权本身不同的活动、交易或制度参与（适格的消费税主体），以及立法设计是否将纳税义务限制在且可从此税基中满足。该框架为评估税收条款的合宪性提供了解释性指南。
AI.research_question: 后Moore时代，如何在宪法税收法中存在两条竞争性判例路线（一条以"实现"要求限制国会权力，另一条将消费税视为可涵盖未实现收入的广泛范畴）的情况下，构建一个融贯的联邦征税权理论？
AI.motivation: Moore案后的宪法税收法存在根本性悖论：一方面复兴了"实现"要求作为宪法约束，另一方面又确认所得税基于第一条的消费税权力。这使得许多长期存在的税收条款和重大改革方案的合宪性处于不确定状态，亟需一个融贯的分析框架。
AI.theoretical_framework: Base-Tether框架：核心问题是结构性而非定义性的，包含两个检验标准——(1)税收条款是否针对一个适格的消费税主体（与所有权本身相区别的活动、交易或制度参与）；(2)立法设计是否将纳税义务限制在且可从此税基中满足。
AI.method: 判例法综合分析与解释性重构，将Moore案和Eisner v. Macomber案中的"反脱离"直觉与长期的消费税判例进行融合。
AI.findings: 通过Base-Tether框架可以调和看似冲突的判例路线；虽然建国时期的征税权原本更宽泛，但现已进入一个新的宪法时代，必须认真对待；该框架为评估哪些税收条款在宪法上脆弱提供了起草和诉讼指导。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了结构性（而非定义性）分析宪法税收问题的新理论框架"Base-Tether"；成功调和了Moore案中"实现"要求与消费税权力宽泛性之间的张力；对宪法税收法的历史演变提供了新的解释。
AI.practical_contributions: 为法律实务者（学者、律师、政策制定者）在后Moore时代的不确定性中导航提供了具体的起草和诉讼指导；帮助评估哪些现有税收条款和改革方案在宪法上易受攻击。

title: Federal Hiring Dysfunction and the Self-Shrinking Skew
affiliations: Drexel University Thomas R. Kline School of Law

detail.title: Federal Hiring Dysfunction and the Self-Shrinking Skew
detail.abstract:
A half-century of remodeling agency workforces against corporate blueprints has hollowed out the civil service, enervated oversight, and facilitated the rise of tech oligarchy. Progressive commentors have criticized the neoliberal turn and proposed reinvigorating reforms, but they’ve overlooked a foundational obstacle: federal hiring dysfunction. Hiring dysfunction entrenches low-resource, deferential regulatory tactics, makes sharper or more onerous approaches less feasible, and undermines recruitment of technical staff for policy and regulatory functions. Concerns about hiring dysfunction and capacity dampen regulatory ambitions. Finally, hiring dysfunction creates plausible-seeming capacity pretexts to oppose novel or more confrontational tactics. Cumulatively, hiring dysfunction cements regulatory dismantlement. 

Prominent federal hiring critiques evangelize private sector hiring strategies and tie agencies’ precarious political legitimacy to their adoption. This Article is the first to filter those critiques through a law and political economy lens, which illustrates their contributions to what I call federal hiring’s “self-shrinking skew”—a fixation with containing agency discretion that drives brittle procedures and erratic hiring outcomes, even when hiring is highly prioritized. 

Current hiring approaches cannot replenish razed workforces, and reliance on them will imperil valiant efforts to upend neoliberalism’s crabbed regulatory tactics. Progressive efforts to reoxygenate the regulatory state and facilitate sharper confrontations with tech oligarchy must therefore grapple with federal hiring dysfunction and reject the extractive ideologies that perpetuate it.

AI.tldr: 本文指出联邦招聘功能障碍是美国监管能力空心化、科技寡头崛起的关键但被忽视的原因。现有招聘改革倡导私营部门策略，反而加剧了"自我收缩偏斜"——一种过度限制机构自由裁量权、导致僵化程序和招聘结果不稳定的倾向。文章通过法律与政治经济学视角首次系统分析这一现象，并呼吁进步派改革者正视招聘问题，拒绝助长该问题的剥削性意识形态。
AI.research_question: 联邦招聘功能障碍如何影响监管能力，以及现有改革建议为何无法解决问题？
AI.motivation: 过去半个世纪按照企业蓝图重塑公务员队伍的做法导致公务员体系空心化、监管能力削弱，并助长了科技寡头的崛起。进步派评论家批评新自由主义转向并提出改革，但忽视了联邦招聘功能障碍这一根本障碍。
AI.theoretical_framework: 法律与政治经济学视角（Law and Political Economy lens）；"自我收缩偏斜"（self-shrinking skew）理论——一种过度限制机构自由裁量权、导致僵化招聘程序和结果不稳定的倾向。
AI.method: 法律与政治经济学分析，对现有联邦招聘批评进行批判性审视。
AI.findings: 1) 招聘功能障碍固化了低资源、顺从性的监管策略，使更强硬或更繁重的监管方式难以实施；2) 削弱了政策与监管岗位技术人员的招聘；3) 对招聘障碍和能力的担忧抑制了监管雄心；4) 招聘功能障碍为反对新型或更具对抗性的监管策略提供了看似合理的"能力不足"借口；5) 现有主流招聘批评宣扬私营部门策略，将机构脆弱的政治合法性与采用这些策略挂钩，反而加剧了"自我收缩偏斜"。
AI.theory_contributions: 首次通过法律与政治经济学视角系统分析联邦招聘批评，揭示了其如何助长"自我收缩偏斜"——一种自我强化的、削弱监管能力的动态过程。
AI.practical_contributions: 为进步派改革者指明了方向：必须正视联邦招聘功能障碍，拒绝延续这一问题的剥削性意识形态，否则任何试图复兴监管国家和对抗科技寡头的努力都将失败。

reference: University of Chicago, Becker Friedman Institute for Economics Working Paper No. 2026-69
title: Proposed Mergers Where Efficiencies Are Needed Most Might Be the Least Likely to Deliver Them
affiliations: Columbia University, International Monetary Fund (IMF) and University of Chicago - Booth School of Business

detail.title: Proposed Mergers Where Efficiencies Are Needed Most Might Be the Least Likely to Deliver Them

publicationDetails.detailsText: University of Chicago, Becker Friedman Institute for Economics Working Paper No. 2026-69
publicationDetails.journalName: Becker Friedman Institute for Economics Working Paper Series

detail.abstract: Mergers are commonly evaluated by weighing their expected market power effects against any efficiency gains they create. The larger the market power effect of a proposed merger, the larger must be any efficiencies for it to raise social welfare. We show selection into merger proposal distorts the observed relationship between market power and efficiency effects. Even if market power and efficiency gains are independent (or even positively correlated) across all potential mergers, they will generally be negatively related among proposed mergers. This is because parties propose to merge only if the merger's expected profitability exceeds a threshold, so the underlying components of profitability become substitutes in clearing that hurdle. It does not rely on managerial bias, behavioral frictions, or strategic misrepresentation. We demonstrate this negative correlation is present under very general conditions when the two effects are uncorrelated among all mergers. We also characterize conditions where this still holds even in the presence of positive underlying correlations and firms' uncertainty about their own merger's profitability. Policies that might raise the selection hurdle for proposed mergers do not alleviate the negative correlation; indeed, they would exacerbate it. Our analysis has direct implications for interpreting empirical merger retrospectives and for evaluating efficiency defenses in antitrust policy.

AI.tldr: 本文证明，由于企业选择性地提出并购提案，即使市场势力和效率提升在所有潜在并购中独立（甚至正相关），在已提出的并购中两者也会呈现负相关关系，这一发现对反垄断政策中的效率抗辩具有重要启示。
AI.research_question: 在企业选择性并购提案的背景下，市场势力效应与效率提升之间的关系如何被扭曲？
AI.motivation: 传统并购评估依赖市场势力与效率的权衡，但忽视了"企业选择性地提案"这一内生性问题。作者试图解释为何实证中常观察到负相关，即使潜在总体可能并非如此。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于并购提案的选择模型：企业仅在预期盈利超过阈值时提出并购，因此市场势力与效率作为盈利性的两个组成部分，在跨越门槛时成为替代品，导致负相关。
AI.method: 理论建模与推导，在一般性条件下证明负相关关系，并探讨在正相关基础分布及企业不确定性下的稳健性。
AI.findings: (1) 即使市场势力与效率在全部潜在并购中独立，在已提案并购中两者必然负相关；(2) 该负相关在正相关基础分布下在一定条件下仍成立；(3) 提高提案门槛的政策（如更严格审查）会加剧而非缓解这种负相关。
AI.theory_contributions: 识别并形式化了"选择偏差"如何扭曲并购评估中的市场势力-效率权衡关系，丰富了产业组织理论与反垄断经济学的理论框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 为反垄断机构解读并购回顾实证研究提供警示：观察到负相关不代表总体关系；对效率抗辩的评估需考虑选择偏差的影响；提高审查门槛可能适得其反。

reference: University of Chicago, Becker Friedman Institute for Economics Working Paper No. 2026-70
title: Sophisticated Borrowing Constraints and Macroeconomic Dynamics
affiliations: New York University (NYU) - New York University and

detail.title: Sophisticated Borrowing Constraints and Macroeconomic Dynamics

publicationDetails.detailsText: University of Chicago, Becker Friedman Institute for Economics Working Paper No. 2026-70
publicationDetails.journalName: Becker Friedman Institute for Economics Working Paper Series

detail.abstract: In traditional macro-finance models, firms' debt contracts impose hard borrowing constraints, which require indiscriminate reductions of borrowing and investment when adverse shocks tighten these limits, giving rise to financial acceleration. We study the macroeconomic implications of "sophisticated borrowing constraints" akin to financial covenants among large U.S. nonfinancial firms, commonly specified based on firms' debt relative to operating earnings. We model these constraints as debt thresholds that trigger a transfer of control rights to creditors when they are violated, in which case creditors influence firms' decisions to maximize their value instead of cutting credit unconditionally to adhere to fixed ratios. At the micro level, our model is quantitatively consistent with empirical patterns of investment and earnings around covenant violations. At the macro level, sophisticated borrowing constraints do not generate financial acceleration, because constraint tightening and violations do not induce creditors to downscale firms indiscriminately.

AI.tldr: 本文研究美国大型非金融企业使用的"复杂借贷约束"（类似于财务契约）的宏观经济影响。与传统的硬性借贷约束不同，这种约束在违约时会将控制权转移给债权人，债权人会最大化自身价值而非无条件削减信贷。研究发现，这种约束在微观层面与数据一致，在宏观层面不会产生金融加速器效应。
AI.research_question: 复杂借贷约束（即基于企业债务与营业利润比率的财务契约）对宏观经济有何影响？它们是否会产生金融加速器效应？
AI.motivation: 传统宏观金融模型中，硬性借贷约束在负面冲击下会迫使企业无差别缩减借贷和投资，从而产生金融加速器。但现实中美国大型非金融企业普遍使用基于财务契约的复杂借贷约束，其机制与传统模型不同，值得研究其宏观含义。
AI.theoretical_framework: 引入复杂借贷约束的宏观金融模型，其中债务阈值触发控制权转移给债权人，债权人在违约后影响企业决策以最大化自身价值，而非无条件按固定比例削减信贷。
AI.method: 构建包含复杂借贷约束的宏观模型，并与美国大型非金融企业关于契约违约前后的投资和盈利的实证模式进行定量校准和对比。
AI.findings: 微观层面，模型与契约违约前后投资和盈利的实证模式一致；宏观层面，复杂借贷约束不会产生金融加速器效应，因为约束收紧和违约不会导致债权人无差别地缩减企业规模。
AI.theory_contributions: 挑战了传统宏观金融模型中硬性借贷约束必然产生金融加速器的理论认知，揭示了复杂借贷约束（如财务契约）的独特传导机制。
AI.practical_contributions: 为理解真实世界中美国大型非金融企业借贷契约的宏观经济影响提供了理论基础，有助于政策制定者评估金融约束对经济波动的作用。

title: A comprehensive approach to food security: measuring food insecurity in France
affiliations: affiliation not provided to SSRN, affiliation not provided to SSRN, affiliation not provided to SSRN and affiliation not provided to SSRN

detail.title: A comprehensive approach to food security: measuring food insecurity in France
detail.abstract: The Covid-19 pandemic has renewed attention on food insecurity, including in northern countries. Additional pressures from global economic recovery and the war in Ukraine caused inflation, especially in energy and food. Western governments responded with poverty reduction efforts and expanded food aid, but ongoing challenges include accurately measuring food insecurity, as many countries lack adequate and reliable tools.This study addresses these gaps through a nationally representative survey conducted in France in 2024. The survey included both a 24-hour dietary recall and a questionnaire designed to capture multiple dimensions of food insecurity, ranging from concerns and qualitative insufficiencies to behavioral coping strategies. The objective was twofold: to provide updated estimates of food insecurity in a country often assumed to be relatively unaffected, and to provide a methodological contribution by testing a multidimensional approach to food insecurity measurement.Findings show that food insecurity prevalence in France is higher than typically reported, with an estimated 16% of adults affected. Importantly, food insecurity does not manifest in a uniform way. The compound score developed in this study made it possible to capture the diversity of coping strategies and subjective experiences related to food insecurity. A clustering of individuals with the highest scores revealed distinct profiles, illustrating the heterogeneity of food insecurity situations. The first group is the most severely affected, combining strong food insecurity with broader financial precarity and composed mainly of older, non-working women, often in single-parent or older-adult households. The second group moderately uses various coping strategies, shows qualitative food insufficiency despite some financial capacity to save, and is largely made up of young, working people living as couples. The third and smallest group frequently uses food-related coping strategies without perceiving food insecurity, relying on other financial buffers, and consists mostly of very young men, many of whom are self-employed with unstable incomes.Our results support a multidimensional assessment approach that better captures the nuances of food-related hardship in affluent societies, beyond prevalence. By applying this framework to the French context, the study contributes new evidence to a growing literature on food insecurity in high-income countries and underscores the relevance of comprehensive tools for both research and policy.

AI.tldr: 基于2024年法国全国代表性调查，研究发现法国成人食物不安全发生率高达16%，并采用多维测量方法识别出三种异质性群体，揭示了富裕国家中食物不安全问题的复杂性和多样性。
AI.research_question: 法国成年人口食物不安全的发生率有多高？食物不安全的表现形式是否具有异质性？采用多维测量方法能否捕捉到传统方法遗漏的细微差别？
AI.motivation: 新冠疫情、全球经济复苏和俄乌战争加剧了食物不安全问题，但许多国家（包括法国）缺乏充分可靠的测量工具，且食物不安全在富裕国家中常被低估。因此需要更新估计并开发更精细的测量方法。
AI.theoretical_framework: 食物不安全的多维测量框架，涵盖担忧、质性不足、行为应对策略等多个维度，结合24小时膳食回顾与多维问卷，采用复合评分和聚类分析识别异质性群体。
AI.method: 2024年法国全国代表性调查，包括24小时膳食回顾和多维食物不安全问卷。通过复合评分法测量多维食物不安全，并采用聚类分析识别不同群体特征。
AI.findings: 法国16%成人受食物不安全影响，高于常见报告值；识别出三个异质性群体：①最严重组：以年长、非在职女性为主，伴随经济脆弱性；②中等组：以年轻在职夫妻为主，存在质性不足但有储蓄能力；③最小组：以极年轻自雇男性为主，频繁使用应对策略但无明显感知。
AI.theory_contributions: 验证了多维测量框架在富裕国家（法国）的适用性，揭示了食物不安全在发达经济体中并非单一现象，而是具有显著的异质性和不同表现形态，扩展了食物不安全理论在高收入国家情境下的应用。
AI.practical_contributions: 为法国及类似高收入国家的政策制定提供了更准确的食物不安全数据（16%发生率），并展示了多维测量工具在识别不同风险群体和制定针对性干预策略中的实用价值。

reference: Duke Law School Public Law & Legal Theory Series No. 2026
title: Regulating Compliance in a World of Decentralized Finance
affiliations: Duke University School of Law and Duke Law School

detail.title: Regulating Compliance in a World of Decentralized Finance

publicationDetails.detailsText: Duke Law School Public Law & Legal Theory Series No. 2026
publicationDetails.journalName: Duke Law School Public Law & Legal Theory Research Paper Series

detail.abstract: Decentralized finance (DeFi) promises cheaper, faster and more accessible financial services by replacing traditional regulated intermediaries with software protocols and smart contracts. But removing those intermediaries also removes the practical chokepoints for implementing modern financial regulation: customer identification and screening, disclosure, recordkeeping, operational safeguards and incident reporting. This paper argues that the core compliance challenge in DeFi is therefore a governance problem: regulators should focus less on DeFi’s underlying computer code and more on the control points where compliance duties could realistically be assigned, supervised and enforced. Identifying those control points could be challenging, however, because DeFi responsibilities are dispersed across software developers, governance structures, parties that interface with investors and third-party service providers. To address that challenge, the paper proposes a layered regulatory strategy comprising four complementary approaches: identifying and regulating gateway intermediaries that facilitate access to DeFi services; prescribing the compliance obligations those intermediaries should assume; establishing targeted governance standards for smart contracts and the oracle and data inputs on which they depend; and applying shadow-banking-type safeguards to constrain spillover channels between DeFi and the traditional financial system. No single approach would be sufficient on its own; their combined effect would reconstruct, at workable control points, the most critical accountability and oversight functions that DeFi displaces. Properly designed and implemented, this strategy could help to preserve DeFi’s efficiency benefits while cost-effectively restoring regulatory protection and accountability.

AI.tldr: 本文论证DeFi的合规挑战本质上是一个治理问题：由于去中心化消除了传统中介这一监管抓手，监管应聚焦于可实际分配合规职责的控制节点。作者提出四层互补的监管策略：监管网关中介、规定其合规义务、建立智能合约治理标准、应用影子银行式防护措施，以在保持DeFi效率的同时重建问责机制。
AI.research_question: 在去中介化的DeFi体系中，应当如何识别和设计有效的合规控制节点，以在不破坏其效率优势的前提下恢复监管保护与问责机制？
AI.motivation: DeFi通过智能合约替代传统中介带来了效率提升，但也消除了监管实施的关键抓手（如客户识别、信息披露等）。现有监管框架难以直接应用于无中介的DeFi环境，亟需新的监管思路。
AI.theoretical_framework: 治理理论（合规挑战本质上是治理问题）；监管的"控制点"理论（识别可分配合规职责的节点）；分层监管框架（四层互补策略）
AI.method: 规范性分析/法学论证方法，通过逻辑推演和制度设计提出监管框架。
AI.findings: 1. DeFi的合规核心是治理问题而非代码问题；2. 控制点分散于开发者、治理结构、投资者接口方和第三方服务商；3. 单一监管手段不足，需四层策略协同：网关中介监管→合规义务设定→智能合约治理标准→影子银行式风险隔离；4. 组合策略可在可操作的控制点上重建被DeFi消解的问责与监督功能。
AI.theory_contributions: 将DeFi监管问题重新框定为治理问题，提出"控制点"分析框架，并构建了四层互补的分层监管理论模型，为去中介化环境下的金融监管提供了新的理论视角。
AI.practical_contributions: 为监管机构提供了可操作的DeFi监管策略蓝图，包括如何识别网关中介、设定合规义务、制定智能合约治理标准以及设计风险隔离机制，有助于在促进创新的同时防控金融风险。

title: Investor Specialization and Token Exit Success: The Impact of Crypto-native Venture Capital
affiliations: , Tsinghua University - Tsinghua University School of Economics and Management and Tsinghua University

detail.title: Investor Specialization and Token Exit Success: The Impact of Crypto-native Venture Capital
detail.abstract: Venture capital in the crypto market includes crypto-native funds (CFs) and traditional funds (TFs). We examine how they differ in shaping project outcomes. We find that CF-backed projects are more likely than TF-backed projects to conduct token offerings and achieve exchange listings. A 2SLS strategy and a structural two-sided matching model both yield results consistent with a treatment effect. Further evidence shows that CFs are more effective in facilitating the exit process than in contributing to project development. We interpret this as CFs partially substituting for absent investment banks in crypto by accumulating exchange-specific relational capital that may serve a certification function.

AI.tldr: 本文研究加密货币市场中加密原生基金（CFs）与传统基金（TFs）如何以不同方式影响项目成果。发现CF支持的项目更易进行代币发行和交易所上市，且这一效应具有因果性。CF主要在退出环节发挥作用，而非项目开发环节，其作用类似于部分替代缺席的投资银行，通过积累交易所特定的关系资本来发挥认证功能。
AI.research_question: 加密货币市场中，加密原生基金（CFs）与传统基金（TFs）在塑造项目成果方面有何不同？
AI.motivation: 加密货币市场中存在两类风险投资——加密原生基金和传统基金，但两者对项目成果的影响差异尚不清楚。此外，加密市场缺乏传统投资银行的退出服务（如承销和上市），不同的VC可能以不同方式填补这一空白。
AI.theoretical_framework: 关系资本理论、认证功能理论、替代性制度安排理论
AI.method: 实证分析：比较CF和TF支持的项目在代币发行和交易所上市上的差异；使用2SLS工具变量法处理内生性；构建结构化的双边匹配模型进一步验证因果效应。
AI.findings: （1）CF支持的项目比TF支持的项目更有可能进行代币发行和实现交易所上市；（2）2SLS和匹配模型结果支持这一差异的因果解释（处理效应）；（3）CF在促进退出过程（代币发行和上市）方面比在促进项目开发方面更有效；（4）CF通过积累与交易所的关系资本，部分替代了加密货币市场中缺失的投资银行功能，发挥认证作用。
AI.theory_contributions: 揭示了在制度真空环境中，不同类型的风险投资机构如何通过积累关系资本来替代传统中介功能（如投资银行），拓展了金融中介理论和风险投资理论在新兴市场（加密货币市场）中的应用。
AI.practical_contributions: 对加密货币创业者和投资者具有启示：选择加密原生基金有助于项目在代币发行和交易所上市等退出环节获得优势；对政策制定者而言，揭示了市场缺失传统中介时，替代性机制（关系资本）如何发挥作用。

title: Demographics, Investment, and Capital Deepening: How Aging Reshapes Production Structure

detail.title: Demographics, Investment, and Capital Deepening: How Aging Reshapes Production Structure
detail.abstract: This paper investigates how demographic change drives investment effort, capital deepening, and production structure across a panel of up to 175 countries from 1970 to 2024. Using the three-component demographic structure vector Z = (Z_1, Z_2, Z_3) from Higgins (1998), we test whether aging societies invest more intensively and how this relates to their trade and current account positions. We distinguish four automation proxies: investment-to-GDP (I/Y), the capital-output ratio (K/Y), capital per worker (K/L), and labor productivity. Demographics robustly predict I/Y (Z_1 = 34.6 , p < 0.01) but the capital-output ratio K/Y is statistically insignificant (Z_1 =-0.05 , NS), and capital per worker K/L is marginally negative in the full sample (Z_1 =-0.09 , p < 0.10), indicating that demographics drive investment effort rather than the accumulated capital intensity of the production structure. The I/Y effect is concentrated in non-OECD economies (Z_1 = 42.2 , p < 0.01); in the OECD, Z_1 is positive but insignificant (38.5 , NS). In the current account regression, I/Y acts as a suppressor variable: controlling for it reveals two opposing demographic channels-a surplus-generating investment channel and a deficit-generating consumption channel-that cancel in the baseline (-226% attenuation in the full sample,-113% in the OECD). K/Y shows partial mediation (57.5% full, with sign reversal in the OECD). Z × KAOPEN interactions on I/Y are statistically insignificant; the baseline controls are fiscal balance, lagged NFA, GDP growth, log GDP per capita, and the Z₁ × log GDP/cap interaction (which captures the income-conditional sign of the demographic effect). Within the eurozone, I/Y mediates 98% of the amplified demographic effect on the current account. Demographics are associated with trade openness (Z_1 = 95.1 , p < 0.05), but the demographic distance measure is statistically insignificant, limiting claims about demographic comparative advantage. Results are robust to 5-year lags, first differences, and exclusion of financial centers.

AI.tldr: 本文利用1970-2024年175个国家的面板数据，研究人口结构变化如何驱动投资努力、资本深化和生产结构。发现人口结构显著预测投资占GDP比重（I/Y），但对资本产出比（K/Y）影响不显著，表明人口结构驱动的是投资努力而非资本强度。该效应集中在非OECD国家，且投资在经常账户回归中起抑制变量作用，揭示出投资和消费两种相反的人口渠道。
AI.research_question: 人口结构变化如何影响投资努力、资本深化和生产结构？这些影响如何通过贸易和经常账户渠道传导？
AI.motivation: 人口老龄化对经济结构的影响日益重要，但现有研究对人口结构如何驱动投资努力（而非资本积累强度）以及其在国际收支中的传导机制认识不足。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于Higgins (1998)的三组分人口结构向量Z=(Z₁, Z₂, Z₃)，结合投资-储蓄恒等式、经常账户跨期模型和自动化代理变量框架。
AI.method: 面板回归分析，涵盖175个国家（1970-2024年），使用四种自动化代理变量（I/Y、K/Y、K/L、劳动生产率），控制财政余额、滞后净外国资产、GDP增长、人均GDP对数等变量，并进行子样本分析（OECD vs 非OECD）、中介效应分析和稳健性检验。
AI.findings: (1) 人口结构显著正向预测I/Y（Z₁=34.6, p<0.01），但K/Y不显著、K/L边际负向，说明驱动的是投资努力而非资本强度；(2) I/Y效应集中在非OECD国家；(3) I/Y在经常账户回归中起抑制变量作用，揭示投资（盈余）和消费（赤字）两种相反渠道；(4) 欧元区内I/Y中介了98%的人口结构放大效应；(5) 人口结构与贸易开放度相关，但人口距离指标不显著。
AI.theory_contributions: 区分了人口结构对"投资努力"与"资本强度"的不同影响，揭示了人口结构通过投资和消费双渠道影响经常账户的机制，为人口红利和老龄化经济影响提供了新的理论视角。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者理解人口老龄化对投资和国际收支的影响提供实证依据，提示非OECD国家面临更显著的人口-投资关联，以及欧元区内部人口结构效应的放大机制。

title: A Conceptual Systems Governance Framework for Autonomous Financial Execution: The Sovereign Payment Agent Model

detail.title: A Conceptual Systems Governance Framework for Autonomous Financial Execution: The Sovereign Payment Agent Model

declarations.declarationOfInterest: This paper reflects the author’s independent research and conceptual analysis. The author declares no financial or personal relationships that could have inappropriately influenced the work presented in this manuscript.
declarations.ethicsApproval: This study is conceptual in nature and does not involve human participants, personal data, clinical research, or experimental subjects. Accordingly, formal ethics approval was not required.
declarations.funderStatement: No external funding was received for this research.

detail.abstract:
The deployment of autonomous AI agents in financial infrastructure introduces governance challenges that existing regulatory and institutional frameworks were not designed to address. As AI-native payment systems become capable of initiating, routing, and settling financial transactions without human activation, traditional assumptions underlying payment oversight — including deterministic auditability, procedural policy enforcement, and human accountability at the point of execution — become increasingly insufficient.

This paper proposes the Sovereign Payment Agent (SPA) model, a conceptual systems governance framework intended to support the controlled deployment of autonomous payment agents within enterprise and regulated financial environments. The framework synthesizes principles from treasury mandate governance, payment authorization hierarchies, information security architecture, AI governance literature, and model risk management guidance to establish a structured governance envelope for autonomous execution.

The paper introduces four primary contributions: (1) a Governance Envelope architecture incorporating Policy-as-Code constraints and audit artifact generation; (2) a five-tier Agent Autonomy Classification (AAC) model enabling calibrated deployment of autonomous execution capabilities; (3) a structured audit artifact standard supporting explainability and regulatory examination; and (4) an adversarial risk architecture addressing prompt injection, signal manipulation, policy drift, and model extraction threats specific to AI-native payment systems.

This study adopts a conceptual systems-design methodology and does not present empirical validation or production implementation results. Rather, it aims to contribute a governance-oriented conceptual framework for future research, institutional experimentation, and regulatory engagement concerning autonomous financial execution.

AI.tldr: 本文提出主权支付代理（SPA）模型，一个针对自主AI代理在金融基础设施中部署的系统治理框架。该框架结合政策即代码、五级代理自主分类、结构化审计证据标准和对抗性风险架构，旨在解决现有监管框架无法应对的自主金融执行治理挑战。
AI.research_question: 如何在无需人工介入的自主AI支付代理部署中，建立有效的系统治理框架以弥补现有监管和制度框架的不足？
AI.motivation: 自主AI代理能够独立发起、路由和结算金融交易，这突破了传统支付监管所依赖的确定性可审计性、程序化政策执行和人工问责等基础假设，现有框架无法应对这些新型治理挑战。
AI.theoretical_framework: 综合了 treasury mandate governance（金库授权治理）、payment authorization hierarchies（支付授权层级）、information security architecture（信息安全架构）、AI governance literature（AI治理文献）以及 model risk management guidance（模型风险管理指南）等多领域理论。
AI.method: 概念性系统设计方法（conceptual systems-design methodology），未进行实证验证或生产实现。
AI.findings: 提出了四大核心贡献：（1）结合Policy-as-Code约束和审计证据生成的治理信封架构；（2）五级代理自主分类（AAC）模型；（3）支持可解释性和监管审查的结构化审计证据标准；（4）针对AI原生支付系统的对抗性风险架构，涵盖提示注入、信号操纵、政策漂移和模型提取等威胁。
AI.theory_contributions: 为自主金融执行领域提供了一个面向治理的概念性框架，整合了多个学科的理论原则，为后续学术研究和制度实验奠定了理论基础。
AI.practical_contributions: 为企业和受监管金融环境中自主支付代理的受控部署提供了可操作的系统治理架构，为监管机构参与和行业实验提供了参考框架。

title: Youth Resistance and Hybrid Governance in the Democratic Republic of Congo: Comparative Insights from Kamuena Nsapu, Mobondo, and the Force du Progrès

detail.title: Youth Resistance and Hybrid Governance in the Democratic Republic of Congo: Comparative Insights from Kamuena Nsapu, Mobondo, and the Force du Progrès
detail.abstract: Since 2016, the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC) has witnessed the rise of youth-led mobilizations that reveal profound transformations in political authority, security, and legitimacy. Drawing on comparative field research conducted between 2019 and 2024, this article examines three distinct yet emblematic cases — the Kamuena Nsapu insurgency in Kasaï, the Mobondo militias in Mai-Ndombe and adjacent provinces, and the Force du Progrès in Kinshasa — to understand how Congolese youth reinterpret order and citizenship in a context of state fragility. Using the conceptual lenses of hybrid governance, twilight institutions, and resistant citizenship, the article explores how these movements operate as mechanisms of contestation and, in some cases, of localized order production. The article does not flatten the substantive differences between an armed insurgency, an ethnically-mobilized militia, and a politically-affiliated urban youth structure: the analytical grid reveals not a single logic of youth resistance but a heterogeneous spectrum, ranging from insurrectional violence to controversial partisan mobilization, with very different normative implications. Drawing on the historical and ethnographic monograph of Mai-Ndombe coordinated by Jean Omasombo Tshonda for the Royal Museum for Central Africa (Tervuren), the article also shows that the Mobondo conflict cannot be understood without reference to longstanding structural tensions between customary and statutory authority over land and revenue, tensions whose violent expression in Yumbi in 2018 and in Kwamouth from 2022 onward was anticipated by Congolese scholarship. By taking these heterogeneities seriously, the article contributes to debates on African political orders beyond the dichotomy of state and society, while resisting any romanticization of violence or partisan instrumentalization.

AI.tldr: 本文通过2019-2024年间比较田野研究，分析刚果（金）三种青年动员案例（Kamuena Nsapu叛乱、Mobondo民兵、Force du Progrès），运用混合治理、暮光制度与抵抗性公民身份概念，揭示青年在脆弱国家背景下对秩序与公民身份的重塑，呈现出从叛乱暴力到党派动员的异质性光谱。
AI.research_question: 在国家脆弱背景下，刚果青年如何通过不同类型的动员活动重新诠释秩序与公民身份？这些动员活动之间的异质性如何体现？
AI.motivation: 自2016年以来，刚果（金）涌现出多起由青年主导的动员活动，深刻反映了政治权威、安全与合法性的根本性转变。已有研究未能充分解释这些动员在形态、逻辑和规范性内涵上的巨大差异，且往往将青年抵抗简化为单一逻辑。
AI.theoretical_framework: 混合治理（hybrid governance）、暮光制度（twilight institutions）、抵抗性公民身份（resistant citizenship）
AI.method: 2019-2024年间比较田野研究，结合Jean Omasombo Tshonda为皇家中非博物馆（Tervuren）协调编写的迈恩东贝历史与民族志专著。
AI.findings: 三种青年动员呈现异质性光谱：从Kamuena Nsapu的武装叛乱，到Mobondo的族群动员民兵，再到Force du Progrès的党派性城市青年结构。Mobondo冲突无法脱离习惯权威与法定权威在土地和收入上的长期结构性紧张来理解。这些运动的规范性内涵差异显著，不应被浪漫化或简单归为单一抵抗逻辑。
AI.theory_contributions: 超越国家与社会二元对立，为非洲政治秩序研究提供更细致的分析框架，强调将青年动员的异质性纳入理论考量。
AI.practical_contributions: 警示不应浪漫化暴力或党派工具化，为国际社会和发展机构理解刚果（金）青年动员的复杂现实提供分析基础，有助于制定更具情境敏感性的干预策略。

title: Nutritional Disparities in India: A Decomposition Analysis
affiliations: University of Delhi - Delhi School of Economics

detail.title: Nutritional Disparities in India: A Decomposition Analysis
detail.abstract: Ethnic and religious minority status is one of the structural determinants of child health inequality globally, yet the mechanisms through which group identity translates into nutritional disadvantage remain poorly understood in low and middle-income countries. This paper examines nutritional disparities among children under five across socio-religious groups in India-a country where nearly one in three stunted children in the world resides, and the inherited social hierarchies rooted in caste and religion remain among the most rigid. Applying Oaxaca-Blinder and Recentered Influence Function decomposition to anthropometric z-scores (height for age, weight for age, and weight for height), I decompose observed gaps between Muslim and Hindu children into endowment and coefficient effects across the full outcome distribution. Muslim children are poorly nourished relative to upper caste Hindus on account of disadvantages in wealth and maternal education, yet this gap closes and turns favorable towards Muslims as we move up the distribution. Against Scheduled Caste and Scheduled Tribe Hindus, Muslims hold a consistent nutritional advantage at the mean, though the endowment channel reverses at the top quartile. The structure of nutritional inequality thus shifts across the distribution, from resource-driven deprivation at the bottom to unobserved group-level attributes at the top. Boys in historically marginalized caste groups bear the heaviest nutritional burden, while the female health advantage is weakest among upper caste girls. The results reveal that aggregate progress in child nutrition conceals deep inequality across caste, religion, and gender.

AI.tldr: 本文利用Oaxaca-Blinder和再中心化影响函数分解方法，研究印度穆斯林与不同种姓印度教儿童在身高、体重等营养指标上的差异，发现营养不平等在分布的不同位置具有不同机制：低分位点主要源于资源和教育劣势，高分位点则更多归因于未观测的群体特征。同时，种姓、宗教和性别之间存在交叉性不平等。
AI.research_question: 在印度，穆斯林与印度教不同种姓群体之间5岁以下儿童营养差异的结构性机制是什么？这种不平等如何随营养分布的不同位置而变化？
AI.motivation: 族群与宗教少数群体身份是全球儿童健康不平等的结构性决定因素之一，但在中低收入国家，群体身份如何转化为营养劣势的机制尚不清晰。印度作为全球近三分之一发育迟缓儿童的所在地，其基于种姓和宗教的严格社会等级制度为研究这一问题提供了关键场景。
AI.theoretical_framework: 结构决定因素理论、社会分层与健康不平等理论、交叉性理论（种姓、宗教、性别交互作用）
AI.method: Oaxaca-Blinder分解方法、再中心化影响函数（Recentered Influence Function, RIF）分解方法，应用于人体测量学z分数（年龄别身高、年龄别体重、身高别体重）数据，分析整个结果分布上的营养差距。
AI.findings: 1) 穆斯林儿童相比高种姓印度教儿童营养较差，主要源于财富和母亲教育劣势；但随着营养分布上移，差距缩小甚至转为穆斯林占优。2) 与表列种姓和表列部落印度教儿童相比，穆斯林在均值上持续具有营养优势，但在上四分位点出现反转。3) 营养不平等的结构随分布变化：底部是资源驱动型剥夺，顶部是未观测的群体属性驱动。4) 历史上边缘化种姓群体的男孩营养负担最重；女性健康优势在上层种姓女孩中最弱。
AI.theory_contributions: 揭示了群体间营养不平等在不同分位点具有不同的结构性来源，突破了传统均值分析的局限；通过交叉性视角展示了种姓、宗教和性别如何共同塑造儿童营养不平等。
AI.practical_contributions: 指出单纯关注整体儿童营养改善会掩盖不同群体内部的深层不平等；政策制定需针对不同分位点采取差异化干预：底部需解决资源和教育问题，顶部需关注群体层面不可观测因素的影响。

title: The Global Credit Cycle in Corporate Bond Returns
affiliations: Federal Reserve Banks - Federal Reserve Bank of New York and Federal Reserve Banks - Federal Reserve Bank of New York

detail.title: The Global Credit Cycle in Corporate Bond Returns

publicationDetails.journalName: Federal Reserve Bank of New York Research Paper Series

detail.abstract:
The global corporate nonfinancial bond market is both a large investment asset class and a vital source of funding for nonfinancial firms. With $19 trillion outstanding at the end of 2024, a broad portfolio of corporate bonds would be expected to be well diversified. Yet, in 37 percent of months between 1998 and 2024, more than 80 percent of bonds in the ICE Global Bond Indices—a portfolio with over 10,000 constituents spanning diverse industries, credit ratings, and regions—moved in the same direction, suggesting a large degree of synchronization. In this post, we introduce the global credit factor, which proxies for the global price of risk in international corporate bond markets. The global credit factor creates a global credit cycle in bond risk premia and generates predictable comovement in bond prices.

To view post: https://libertystreeteconomics.newyorkfed.org/2026/05/the-global-credit-cycle-in-corporate-bond-returns/

AI.tldr: 本文发现全球公司债市场存在显著的价格同步性（37%的月份中超过80%的债券同向变动），并引入一个"全球信用因子"来解释这一现象。该因子代理了国际公司债市场的全球风险价格，创造了债券风险溢价的全球信用周期，并导致债券价格可预测的联动。
AI.research_question: 全球公司债市场的价格为何呈现出高度同步性？是否存在一个共同的全球信用因子能解释这种联动？
AI.motivation: 全球公司债市场规模庞大（2024年底达19万亿美元），理论上高度分散化应能降低同向变动，但实际数据显示37%的月份中超过80%的债券同向变动，这一矛盾现象需要理论解释。
AI.theoretical_framework: 全球信用因子（Global Credit Factor）——代理全球风险价格，形成债券风险溢价的全球信用周期。
AI.method: 基于1998-2024年ICE全球债券指数（超10,000只成分债券，覆盖多行业、信用评级和地区）的月度收益率数据进行实证分析。
AI.findings: （1）1998-2024年间37%的月份中，超过80%的全球公司债同向变动，存在显著的同步性；（2）全球信用因子能有效解释这种联动，创造了全球信用周期。
AI.theory_contributions: 首次提出并实证检验了"全球信用因子"概念，揭示了全球公司债市场存在一个共同的风险价格周期，为债券定价的联动性提供了新的理论解释框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 为全球债券投资者提供了风险分散的新视角——传统上认为全球公司债因行业、地区、评级分散可有效对冲风险，但实际存在显著的全球信用周期，投资者需重视这一系统性风险来源。

title: THE ABSENT FLOOR: The Dietary ACE, Nutritional Substrate Suppression, and the Population Attributable Cost of Healing Capacity Failure in High-ACE Alaska Native Communities

detail.title: THE ABSENT FLOOR: The Dietary ACE, Nutritional Substrate Suppression, and the Population Attributable Cost of Healing Capacity Failure in High-ACE Alaska Native Communities

declarations.declarationOfInterest: Patrick M. Anderson declares no financial conflicts of interest with respect to the research, authorship, or publication of this working paper. detail.abstract:
The state of Alaska and the federal government spend hundreds of millions of dollars annually on behavioral health treatment, substance use programs, criminal justice intervention, and child welfare services in Alaska Native communities. A significant proportion of those communities simultaneously receive federal commodity food assistance whose nutritional profile is the precise inverse of the traditional food system it displaced — a system whose omega-3, niacin, and anti-inflammatory density constituted the metabolic substrate within which healing capacity was developed and transmitted across generations.

This paper proposes that the forced substitution of a traditional omega-3-rich Alaska Native diet with an omega-6-dominant commodity food diet constitutes a distinct and previously untheorized eleventh category of Adverse Childhood Experience — the Dietary ACE — that directly degrades the molecular substrate of allostatic self-regulation and healing capacity independently of the ten ACE categories the Felitti instrument measures. The Dietary ACE is not a cultural loss metaphor. It is a measurable metabolic deficit with a specific molecular mechanism, a documentable population-level exposure history, and a falsifiable dose-response relationship to behavioral health, criminal justice, and child welfare outcomes.

The paper integrates three bodies of evidence: Hibbeln's cross-national epidemiology establishing omega-3 availability as a population-level predictor of psychiatric and violent outcomes; Barrett's body budget framework specifying the allostatic mechanism through which nutritional substrate determines healing capacity; and Palmer's metabolic theory of mental illness providing the cellular specification — mitochondrial impairment and BDNF suppression — through which nutritional deficiency prevents healing consolidation. Together they constitute a complete causal chain from commodity food displacement to healing capacity failure.

The paper applies the ACE Study's Population Attributable Risk methodology to produce the first PAR estimate for omega-3 and niacin deficiency on behavioral health, criminal justice, and child welfare outcomes in Alaska Native communities, with a preliminary fiscal calculation suggesting that $96 million or more in annual Alaska expenditures may be attributable to Dietary ACE-induced healing capacity suppression. A complementary analysis documents Alaska's living traditional food distribution networks — including the herring egg kinship distribution system — as active population-level neurological interventions operating through existing relational infrastructure, and proposes a village food sovereignty architecture using existing diesel waste heat infrastructure as a healing capacity floor.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种新的 Adverse Childhood Experience（ACE）类型——"膳食 ACE"，即阿拉斯加原住民社区从传统富含 Omega-3 的饮食被迫转向 Omega-6 主导的商品粮饮食，这种代谢缺陷独立于传统 ACE 十项指标，可通过分子机制（线粒体损伤、BDNF 抑制）直接削弱个体的自我调节与治愈能力，进而导致行为健康、刑事司法和儿童福利领域的负面结果。文章整合了三项理论证据链，并首次使用 ACE 研究的归因风险方法，估算出阿拉斯加每年约 9600 万美元的支出可归因于膳食 ACE 导致的治愈能力抑制。
AI.research_question: 传统饮食被商品粮饮食替代所导致的代谢缺陷是否能被概念化为一种独立的 Adverse Childhood Experience（膳食 ACE），并通过特定的分子机制影响阿拉斯加原住民社区的治愈能力与行为健康结果？
AI.motivation: 阿拉斯加州与联邦政府每年在阿拉斯加原住民社区的行为健康治疗、物质滥用项目、刑事司法干预和儿童福利服务上花费数亿美元，但与此同时这些社区正经历着传统饮食系统被营养结构完全相反的联邦商品粮饮食所取代。作者认为，这种饮食替代造成的代谢缺陷可能是一个被忽视的根本性致病因素，而其影响的规模与机制尚未被理论化。
AI.theoretical_framework:
1. **膳食 ACE 理论**：将传统 Omega-3 饮食向 Omega-6 商品粮饮食的强制替代概念化为第11类 Adverse Childhood Experience。
2. **Hibbeln 的跨国流行病学**：Omega-3 可用性作为精神与暴力结果的人群层面预测因子。
3. **Barrett 的身体预算框架**：营养底物如何决定异稳态调节机制与治愈能力。
4. **Palmer 的精神疾病代谢理论**：线粒体损伤与 BDNF 抑制是营养缺乏阻碍治愈巩固的细胞层面机制。
AI.method: 理论整合与文献综述，结合 ACE 研究的 Population Attributable Risk（PAR）方法论，对 Omega-3 和烟酸缺乏在阿拉斯加原住民社区的行为健康、刑事司法和儿童福利结果上进行首次归因风险估算，并辅以财政影响测算。
AI.findings:
1. 传统饮食向商品粮饮食的替代可被概念化为具有独立分子机制的膳食 ACE。
2. 整合三条证据链（Hibbeln、Barrett、Palmer）构成了从商品粮替代到治愈能力失败的完整因果链。
3. 初步 PAR 估算表明，阿拉斯加每年约 9600 万美元或更多的支出可能归因于膳食 ACE 导致的治愈能力抑制。
4. 阿拉斯加现存的传统食物分配网络（如鲱鱼卵亲属分配系统）可作为活跃的人群层面神经干预手段，通过现有关系基础设施运作。
5. 提出利用现有柴油废热基础设施的村庄食物主权架构作为治愈能力底线的解决方案。
AI.theory_contributions:
1. 首次提出"膳食 ACE"这一理论概念，将饮食代谢缺陷纳入 ACE 框架，扩展了 Adverse Childhood Experience 的理论边界。
2. 为非传染性疾病与心理健康问题提供了一个可测量的、具有分子机制的代谢性解释路径，超越了传统的社会文化隐喻。
3. 将三条独立的理论线索（Hibbeln、Barrett、Palmer）整合为一个完整的因果链，建立了营养-代谢-治愈能力之间的系统性理论联系。
AI.practical_contributions:
1. 首次使用 PAR 方法量化 Omega-3/烟酸缺乏对阿拉斯加原住民社区行为健康、刑事司法和儿童福利结果的人群归因风险，提供了政策制定所需的定量依据。
2. 揭示阿拉斯加每年约 9600 万美元支出可能与膳食 ACE 相关，为资源重新配置提供了财政论证。
3. 识别了现存传统食物分配网络（如鲱鱼卵系统）作为人群层面神经干预手段的潜力。
4. 提出了利用现有柴油废热基础设施的村庄食物主权架构，具有可直接落地的政策可行性。

title: AI Washing: How Firms Use Artificial Intelligence Narratives to Mask Offshoring, Recessionary Cost-Cutting, and Post-Pandemic Restructuring
affiliations: University of the Cumberlands

detail.title: AI Washing: How Firms Use Artificial Intelligence Narratives to Mask Offshoring, Recessionary Cost-Cutting, and Post-Pandemic Restructuring

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares no conflicts of interest.
declarations.ethicsApproval: This study relied on publicly available documentary sources. No human subjects research was conducted.
declarations.funderStatement: This research received no external funding.

detail.abstract: When firms attribute workforce reductions to artificial intelligence capabilities they do not possess, have not deployed, or that did not cause the decision, the resulting information asymmetry harms every stakeholder group that relies on corporate communications to allocate resources. This article argues that AI washing, the strategic practice of misattributing organizational restructuring to AI, operates as a narrative pattern structurally incentivized by three convergent forces: offshoring of white-collar positions, recessionary cost-cutting driven by tariffs and credit tightening, and correction of pandemic-era over-hiring. Drawing on institutional theory, signaling theory, and the greenwashing literature, the article develops a Triple Concealment Model identifying these forces and proposes signal quality inversion as a mechanism explaining why capital markets reward unverified AI claims. A structured comparative case analysis across six independent evidence categories provides the empirical foundation. The article offers a five-question diagnostic framework enabling boards, investors, and workforce leaders to distinguish genuine AI transformation from strategic narrative packaging. The analysis reveals that in the cases examined, the gap between AI narrative and AI capability is not random but structurally incentivized, generating a form of credibility debt that degrades the information environment needed for genuine future transformation.

AI.tldr: 本文提出"AI洗白"概念，指企业将裁员归因于并不存在的AI能力，并构建了"三重掩盖模型"揭示其背后的结构性激励——白领岗位离岸外包、关税与信贷紧缩驱动的成本削减、疫情过度招聘的纠正。通过跨六类证据的案例比较分析，提出"信号质量反转"机制解释资本市场为何奖励未经证实的AI声明，并开发了一个五问题诊断框架帮助区分真实AI转型与叙事包装。
AI.research_question: 企业为何以及如何将并未真实发生的AI能力作为组织重组的归因理由？资本市场为何奖励这种未经证实的AI声明？
AI.motivation: 当企业将裁员归因于其并不拥有、未部署或并非决策原因的AI能力时，产生的信息不对称损害了依赖企业沟通分配资源的每一类利益相关者。揭示这一现象背后深层的结构性激励因素至关重要。
AI.theoretical_framework: 制度理论、信号理论、绿色洗白文献、"三重掩盖模型"、信号质量反转机制
AI.method: 结构化比较案例分析法，跨越六类独立证据类别进行实证基础构建
AI.findings: 在考察的案例中，AI叙事与AI能力之间的差距并非随机，而是结构性激励的结果；这种差距产生了一种"可信度债务"，恶化了真正未来转型所需的信息环境。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出"AI洗白"概念，构建"三重掩盖模型"识别三大结构性力量，提出"信号质量反转"作为市场奖励未经验证AI声明的机制解释。
AI.practical_contributions: 提供五问题诊断框架，帮助董事会、投资者和劳动力领导者区分真实AI转型与战略性叙事包装，有助于改善企业沟通的信息质量。

title: Judicial Safeguards in Data and Digitalisation Policy of the EU

detail.title: Judicial Safeguards in Data and Digitalisation Policy of the EU

declarations.declarationOfInterest: Independent
declarations.funderStatement: Non

detail.abstract: This study examines the judicial safeguards embedded in the EU’s data and digitalisation policy framework, with particular emphasis on the interpretative and review functions of the Court of Justice of the European Union. It analyses how principles such as proportionality, necessity, effective judicial protection, and the essence of fundamental rights are operationalised in the Court’s case law to constrain legislative and administrative action in the digital sphere. The research further assesses the interaction between primary EU law, including the Charter of Fundamental Rights, and secondary instruments such as the General Data Protection Regulation in establishing enforceable standards for data processing, surveillance, and digital governance. It concludes that EU judicial safeguards function as a constitutional control mechanism, ensuring that digitalisation policies remain within the bounds of fundamental rights, while also highlighting tensions between security objectives, regulatory discretion, and the intensity of judicial review.

AI.tldr: 本文研究欧盟数据与数字化政策框架中的司法保障机制，重点分析欧盟法院如何通过比例原则、必要性、有效司法保护等原则约束数字领域的立法与行政行动，并评估基本权利宪章与GDPR等法律工具在数据治理中的执行标准。结论认为欧盟司法保障充当宪法控制机制，确保数字化政策不逾越基本权利边界。
AI.research_question: 欧盟数据与数字化政策框架中的司法保障机制如何运作？欧盟法院的解释和审查功能如何在数字领域约束立法与行政行动？
AI.motivation: 在数字化快速发展的背景下，如何确保数据治理政策不侵犯基本权利是一个关键问题。欧盟法院作为宪法控制机制的角色及其审查标准需要系统分析。
AI.theoretical_framework: 比例原则、必要性原则、有效司法保护原则、基本权利本质原则；欧盟基本权利宪章、GDPR等次级法律工具。
AI.method: 案例分析法：通过分析欧盟法院判例法中如何操作化上述原则。
AI.findings: 欧盟司法保障机制作为宪法控制机制，确保数字化政策在基本权利框架内运行。安全目标、监管裁量权与司法审查强度之间存在持续张力。
AI.theory_contributions: 系统阐述了欧盟法院在数字治理中如何通过比例原则等宪法原则行使司法审查功能，为理解数字权利保护提供了司法视角的理论框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者和监管机构提供了如何在数字化进程中平衡安全目标与基本权利保护的具体司法标准参考。

title: The Agentic Law Firm: Competence, Supervision, Confidentiality, and Conflicts Across Six Levels of AI Autonomy
affiliations: ,  and

detail.title: The Agentic Law Firm: Competence, Supervision, Confidentiality, and Conflicts Across Six Levels of AI Autonomy
detail.abstract:
In March 2026, an Orange County Superior Court sanctioned an attorney whose AI system autonomously generated and filed a motion containing fabricated citations without the attorney’s review. The AI did not hallucinate a single case in a research query. It drafted a pleading, selected authorities, assembled arguments, signed the attorney’s name to the filing, and submitted it to the court. The attorney learned of the fabrications when opposing counsel raised them. This is not a hallucination problem. It is a supervision problem. And it is not a problem the Model Rules of Professional Conduct were designed to address.

Existing scholarship on artificial intelligence (AI) in legal practice treats AI tools as nonlawyers under Model Rule 5.3, supervised under the same framework applied to paralegals, contract attorneys, and other human assistants. American Bar Association (ABA) Formal Opinion 512 adopts this uniform treatment. That framework absorbed the typewriter, word processing, electronic research, and even retrieval-augmented generative AI. But agentic AI systematically inverts four assumptions embedded in the supervision doctrine: that nonlawyer assistance operates at human speed under continuous attorney direction, within observable scope, with ex-ante conflict identification. When those assumptions fail, the doctrine’s gap-filling mechanisms fail with them.

This Article proposes a framework that calibrates Model Rules compliance to AI autonomy level through two analytical axes. First, a six-level autonomy spectrum (Level 0 through Level 5) adapted from the Society of Automotive Engineers J3016 taxonomy and the emerging AI governance consensus of DeepMind’s Levels of AGI and the Cloud Security Alliance’s Agentic Trust Framework, calibrated to the doctrinal task of Model Rules compliance. Second, a dual-vector framework that distinguishes substantive legal practice (Vector A: competence, communication, candor, conflicts) from firm operations (Vector B: confidentiality infrastructure, trust accounting, marketing). The two vectors carry different ceilings: Vector A permits autonomy through Level 2 with limited Level 3 deployment for non-judgment components; Vector B permits autonomy through Level 4 under bounded-autopilot architecture.

The framework produces five categorical bright lines the Rules assign to named attorneys by text and that no level of AI autonomy can cross: rendering legal advice under Rule 2.1; Rule 11 and Rule 26(g) certification; privilege calls under Rule 1.6; substantive communication judgment under Rule 1.4(b); and Rule 1.7 and 1.9 conflict clearance. The Article identifies a substance-touch rule for mixed-vector communications: any communication that transmits, summarizes, or characterizes substantive legal analysis is Vector A regardless of the channel through which it is delivered. The Article identifies a combinatorial compounding problem that produces the Level 5 categorical impossibility for substantive practice and that limits Level 4 deployment to operationally bounded tasks. The Article identifies six architectural boundaries that define bounded autopilot operation.

The prediction is eighteen months: at least one state bar will adopt autonomy-level calibration in a formal opinion, and at least one reported sanctions decision will cite the bright-line framework. If either condition fails to occur within the window, the framework is falsified.

AI.tldr: 本文指出，AI自主生成并提交含有虚假引用的诉状，本质上不是AI"幻觉"问题，而是律师监督失职问题，且现行《职业行为示范规则》的监督框架（将所有AI工具视为非律师人员，适用Model Rule 5.3）无法应对代理型AI（agentic AI）带来的系统性挑战。作者提出一个双层框架：一是将AI自主性分为0-5级（借鉴SAE J3016自动驾驶分级）；二是区分"实质性法律实践"（Vector A）与"律所运营"（Vector B），并划定五条不可逾越的红线（如提供法律意见、Rule 11认证等），预测18个月内将有州律师协会采纳该分级框架。
AI.research_question: 现行律师职业行为规范（尤其是Model Rule 5.3的监督框架）能否有效规制代理型AI（agentic AI）在律所中的使用？如果不能，应当构建怎样的合规框架？
AI.motivation: 2026年3月加州法院制裁了一位律师，其使用的AI系统在没有律师审查的情况下自动生成并提交了含有虚假引证的诉状。这并非AI"幻觉"（因为AI并非在研究查询中产生虚假案例），而是AI在起草、选择法律依据、签名并提交文件的全流程中缺乏律师监督。现有学术和ABA意见将所有AI工具统一视作"非律师人员"适用Model Rule 5.3，但代理型AI系统性地颠覆了监督规则中的四个基本假设（人类速度、持续指导、可观察范围、事前冲突识别），因此亟需新框架。
AI.theoretical_framework: 1. SAE J3016自动驾驶分级（Level 0-5）的灵感，用于定义AI自主性层级；2. DeepMind的AGI层级与云安全联盟（CSA）的代理信任框架作为AI治理共识基础；3. 双向量框架：Vector A（实质性法律实践：能力、沟通、坦诚、利益冲突）与Vector B（律所运营：保密基础设施、信托会计、市场营销）。
AI.method: 规范性法律分析（doctrinal legal analysis），结合AI技术层级分类与律师职业伦理规则的解释论，提出分级合规框架，并以可证伪的预测（18个月内州律师协会采纳或制裁判决引用）作为框架验证机制。
AI.findings: 1. 代理型AI颠覆了监督规则的四个基本假设（人类速度、持续指导、可观察范围、事前冲突识别），导致现有规则的填补机制失效。2. Vector A最高允许Level 2自主性，仅限非判断性组件的有限Level 3部署；Vector B最高允许Level 4自主性（在受控自动驾驶架构下）。3. 五条不可逾越的红线：提供法律意见（Rule 2.1）、Rule 11/26(g)认证、特权判断（Rule 1.6）、实质性沟通判断（Rule 1.4(b)）、利益冲突清除（Rule 1.7/1.9）。4. 混合向量通信的"实质触碰规则"：任何传输、总结或描述实质性法律分析的通信均归入Vector A。5. Level 5在实质性法律实践中在范畴上不可能（组合复合问题），Level 4仅限于运营性边界任务。6. 识别了六种界定受控自动驾驶架构的架构边界。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 首次系统论证了代理型AI对律师监督规则（Model Rule 5.3）四个基础假设的整体性颠覆，而非渐进式挑战。2. 提出了将AI自主性分级（Level 0-5）与律师伦理规则合规相结合的理论框架，超越了现有将AI简单类比为非律师人员的做法。3. 提出了"实质触碰规则"（substance-touch rule）和"组合复合问题"（combinatorial compounding problem）等新概念，丰富了AI与法律伦理交叉领域的理论工具箱。4. 以可证伪的预测作为理论验证机制，增强了学术严谨性。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为律师事务所在代理型AI时代提供了明确的合规操作指南（两个向量、五个层级、五条红线）。2. 为州律师协会和ABA制定AI相关伦理意见提供了可操作的分级标准（借鉴SAE J3016，法律界熟悉的技术类比）。3. 为法院在制裁AI相关违规行为时提供了判定责任的"明线规则"框架。4. 预测18个月内的政策采纳和司法引用，具有实践可验证性。5. 帮助律师识别哪些AI任务可以委派、哪些绝对不能委派，降低执业风险。

title: Dynamic Influencer Identity
affiliations: University of Southern California, Marshall School of Business

detail.title: Dynamic Influencer Identity
detail.abstract: Consumers form impressions of influencers not from a single message, but from sequences of signals encountered over time.  How does the variation across this history shape consumer response?  A multimethod investigation, combining text embeddings on nearly 20,000 sponsored posts from 940 influencers with preregistered controlled experiments, reveals an inverted Ushaped relationship between identity breadth and engagement: moderate breadth outperforms both narrow and highly diffuse identities.  Taking a dynamic view, new content performs best when it deviates moderately from prior posts, with shifts into related product categories outperforming both repetition and moves across distant categories.  Moderate variation works because it balances coherence with new information, sustaining interest while preserving perceived authenticity.  Further, the effects depend on influencer lifecycle and post goals.  Together, these findings reconceptualize identity as a dynamic, cumulative inference and demonstrate how automated text analysis can be used to study identity dynamics.

AI.tldr: 通过对940名网红近20,000条赞助帖文的文本嵌入分析及预注册实验，发现身份广度与参与度呈倒U型关系：适度差异化表现最佳。新内容与过往帖文保持适度偏差（尤其是向相关品类偏移）能平衡一致性与新信息，维持兴趣并保持真实性，且效果受网红生命周期和帖子目标调节。
AI.research_question: 消费者如何基于网红随时间传递的信号序列形成印象？身份信号的历史变化如何影响消费者参与度？
AI.motivation: 消费者对网红的印象并非来自单条信息，而是来自随时间积累的信号序列。现有研究多关注单一帖文或静态身份，忽视了身份信号的动态变化对消费者响应的影响。
AI.theoretical_framework: 身份动态推断理论、身份广度、信号一致性—新奇性权衡
AI.method: 多方法研究：①对940名网红近20,000条赞助帖文进行文本嵌入分析（自然语言处理）；②预注册受控实验
AI.findings: ①身份广度与参与度呈倒U型关系，中等广度表现最佳；②新内容与历史帖文适度偏差时效果最好，向相关品类偏移优于重复或跨远距离品类；③适度变异性通过平衡一致性与新信息，维系兴趣并保持感知真实性；④效应受网红生命周期和帖子目标调节。
AI.theory_contributions: 将身份重新概念化为动态的、累积的推断过程，揭示了身份信号序列变化对消费者响应的非线性影响机制。
AI.practical_contributions: 为网红和品牌方提供内容策略指导：适度差异化而非完全一致或频繁跨界，能更有效提升受众参与度；需根据网红发展阶段和帖子目标调整差异化程度。

title: Deal Dashboard™ A Structured Pre-Commitment Instrument for Negotiation Preparation and Offer Assessment: How Systematic Best Practices Can Transform Deal Outcomes the Way They Transformed Aviation, Medicine, Baseball, and Other High-Stakes Fields
affiliations: NYU Stern School of Business

detail.title: Deal Dashboard™ A Structured Pre-Commitment Instrument for Negotiation Preparation and Offer Assessment: How Systematic Best Practices Can Transform Deal Outcomes the Way They Transformed Aviation, Medicine, Baseball, and Other High-Stakes Fields

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares no conflicts of interest with respect to the research, authorship, or publication of this paper. The Deal Dashboard™ is an instrument developed by the author in connection with his teaching and consulting practice. The author has a commercial interest in the adoption of the Deal Dashboard™ by practitioners and organizations. This interest is disclosed here in the interest of transparency. The paper presents evidence and arguments in support of the instrument's value; readers should weigh that evidence with this disclosure in mind.The author received no external funding for this research. No data were collected from human subjects. The case analyses presented are based entirely on publicly available sources, which are cited in the references.Note on placementSSRN typically asks for this in the submission form. Some authors also include it as a final page of the
declarations.ethicsApproval: This research did not involve human subjects, clinical trials, animal experimentation, or the collection of personal data. All analyses are based on publicly available sources, published case records, court judgments, regulatory findings, and practitioner interviews conducted in a professional context. No ethics approval was required.
declarations.funderStatement: This research received no external funding. The work was conducted independently by the author in connection with his teaching and research activities at NYU Stern School of Business and Columbia University School of International and Public Affairs (SIPA).

detail.abstract: This paper introduces the Deal Dashboard™, a structured pre-commitment instrument designed to help deal teams, boards, and their advisors assess offers systematically before accepting them. Drawing on research in behavioral decision science, organizational behavior, aviation safety, surgical medicine, professional baseball, emergency medicine, intelligence analysis, and corporate law, it argues that contemporary dealmaking suffers from precisely the same gap between prevailing practice and demonstrable best practice that once afflicted commercial aviation, surgery, and professional baseball-and that structured instruments can close that gap with comparable results. A central organizing concept introduced here is the framework pivot: the phenomenon, observed across multiple high-stakes fields, in which a domain reaches an inflection point where the adoption of structured best-practice instruments produces dramatic, measurable improvements in outcomes-not by replacing expertise, experience, or intuition, but by ensuring they are applied systematically at critical decision moments. Aviation, surgery, baseball, emergency medicine, intelligence analysis, and nursing have each undergone a framework pivot. Dealmaking has not. This paper argues that it is overdue, and that the instruments to enable it already exist. The paper proceeds in four parts. Part I documents the scale of deal failure across M&A, joint ventures, infrastructure projects, ERP implementations, and digital transformations, and identifies the cognitive and structural causes. A steelman analysis of optimistic M&A research is presented, and both the optimistic and pessimistic cases are shown to point toward the same conclusion: systematic process discipline, not expertise alone, is the operative variable distinguishing successful from unsuccessful deal outcomes. Part II reviews how framework pivots have transformed performance in other high-stakes fields, with particular attention to the role of Crew Resource Management in aviation, the surgical safety checklist, analytics-based decision-making in professional baseball, Advanced Trauma Life Support in emergency medicine, Structured Analytic Techniques in intelligence analysis, and early warning scoring systems in nursing. Part III presents the Deal Dashboard™ overview, field evidence, and case reconstructions. Part IV analyzes the fiduciary and legal dimensions of deal failure. Part V describes the Deal Dashboard™ architecture, explaining how each design feature addresses a specific cognitive, structural, or legal vulnerability identified in the preceding analysis.

AI.tldr: 本文提出Deal Dashboard™这一结构化预承诺工具，旨在帮助交易团队在决策前系统评估交易方案。论文借鉴航空、外科、棒球、急救医学、情报分析、公司法等多个领域的研究，指出当代交易实践与最佳实践之间存在巨大差距，而结构化工具可以弥合这一差距。核心概念是"框架转折点"——各领域在采纳结构化最佳实践工具后，结果会产生显著改善。作者认为交易领域尚未经历这种转折，但已有成熟工具可借鉴。
AI.research_question: 如何通过结构化预承诺工具系统性地改善交易决策质量，弥合交易实践中普遍存在的最佳实践差距？
AI.motivation: 交易失败率在并购、合资、基础设施项目、ERP实施和数字化转型等领域持续高企，根源在于认知偏差和结构性缺陷。作者观察到航空、外科、棒球等高风领域曾面临类似问题，通过引入结构化工具实现了显著改善，但交易领域尚未经历这一转型。
AI.theoretical_framework: 框架转折点（Framework Pivot）理论，借鉴行为决策科学、组织行为学、机组资源管理（CRM）、外科安全清单、循证决策、高级创伤生命支持（ATLS）、结构化分析技术（SAT）、早期预警评分系统等多个领域的理论。
AI.method: 跨领域比较分析，文献综合，案例重建，以及对Deal Dashboard™架构的设计分析与法律维度分析。
AI.findings: 乐观和悲观的并购研究均指向同一结论：系统性的流程纪律（而非单纯的专业知识）是区分交易成败的操作性变量。航空、外科、棒球、急救医学、情报分析和护理等领域均已通过框架转折点实现绩效跃升，但交易领域尚未经历这一转变。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出"框架转折点"这一核心组织概念，将多个高风领域的转型经验统一为可推广的理论框架；将行为决策科学与交易结构设计系统性地整合。
AI.practical_contributions: 提供Deal Dashboard™这一可直接应用的结构化预承诺工具，涵盖认知、结构和法律层面的系统性解决方案，并分析了采用结构化工具在信托责任和法律合规方面的意义。

title: Quantifying Spirituality as a Moderator of Food Security in Climate-Vulnerable Communities in the Gulf of Guinea

detail.title: Quantifying Spirituality as a Moderator of Food Security in Climate-Vulnerable Communities in the Gulf of Guinea
detail.abstract: Dominant frameworks for understanding climate adaptation in the Global South have long privileged material, infrastructural, and institutional variables, systematically neglecting the socially embedded systems of meaning through which vulnerable communities actually navigate ecological uncertainty. Spirituality, despite its deep embeddedness within the communal fabric of West and Central African life, has remained at the analytical margins of climate-food security scholarship, acknowledged descriptively, operationalized rarely. Drawing on the Afrobarometer Round 9 Survey (2021-2023; N = 11,847) merged with Notre Dame Global Adaptation Initiative vulnerability scores across nine Gulf of Guinea nations, this study quantifies spirituality as a moderating variable in the relationship between climate vulnerability and household food insecurity. Hierarchical moderated regression analysis confirms that climate vulnerability exerts a large positive effect on food insecurity (β = .31, p < .001), and that spirituality significantly attenuates this relationship (β =-.09, p < .001). Crucially, communal spiritual embeddedness, operationalized as institutional trust in religious leaders, produces a moderating effect more than twice as powerful as individual devotional practice (β =-.14 versus β =-.06), with the difference statistically significant on bootstrap comparison. These findings reposition communally organized spirituality as a measurable component of adaptive capacity, advancing an empirically grounded argument that climate resilience in the Gulf of Guinea is as much a function of social meaning as it is of material resource.

AI.tldr: 本研究利用Afrobarometer调查数据（11,847份样本）和ND-GAIN脆弱性评分，发现灵性（spirituality）显著削弱了气候脆弱性与家庭粮食不安全之间的正向关系，且社群性灵性嵌入（制度性信任宗教领袖）的调节效应是个体灵性实践的两倍多。
AI.research_question: 在几内亚湾国家中，灵性（spirituality）如何调节气候脆弱性与家庭粮食不安全之间的关系？
AI.motivation: 现有气候适应框架主要关注物质、基础设施和制度变量，忽略了弱势社区赖以应对生态不确定性的社会意义系统。灵性在撒哈拉以南非洲生活中根深蒂固，却长期处于气候-粮食安全研究的分析边缘。
AI.theoretical_framework: 将灵性重新定位为适应能力（adaptive capacity）的可量化组成部分，区分个体灵性实践与社群灵性嵌入两个维度。
AI.method: 数据来源：Afrobarometer第9轮调查（2021-2023）与ND-GAIN脆弱性评分，涵盖9个几内亚湾国家，样本量11,847。采用分层调节回归分析（Hierarchical moderated regression）。
AI.findings: （1）气候脆弱性对粮食不安全有显著正向影响（β=.31, p<.001）；（2）灵性显著削弱了该关系（β=-.09, p<.001）；（3）社群灵性嵌入（对宗教领袖的制度信任）的调节效应（β=-.14）是个体灵性实践（β=-.06）的两倍多，且差异显著。
AI.theory_contributions: 从理论上将社群性灵性嵌入定位为适应能力的可量化组成部分，证明气候韧性不仅是物质资源的函数，也是社会意义的函数。
AI.practical_contributions: 为气候适应政策和粮食安全干预提供了新思路：应重视并利用社群层面的灵性资源——特别是宗教领袖的制度性信任网络——作为增强气候韧性的非传统杠杆。

title: Integrated Service, Integrated Screening: A Mixed-Methods Study of a Village Doctor-Led Model for Lung Cancer Screening in Rural China
affiliations: Nanjing Medical University, Nanjing Medical University, Nanjing Medical University, Nanjing Medical University - Division of Cardiology, Nanjing Medical University and Nanjing Medical University

detail.title: Integrated Service, Integrated Screening: A Mixed-Methods Study of a Village Doctor-Led Model for Lung Cancer Screening in Rural China

declarations.declarationOfInterest: We declare no competing interests.
declarations.ethicsApproval: This study was approved by the institutional review board of Nanjing Medical University Ethics Committee. Informed consent was obtained from all individual participants included in the study.
declarations.funderStatement: This study is funded by the National Health Commission’s “Noncommunicable Chronic Diseases-National Science and Technology Major Project” (2024ZD0524401).

detail.abstract:
Background: Low-dose computed tomography (LDCT) reduces lung cancer mortality, but real-world uptake remains low. This study evaluated a village doctor-led LDCT screening program in rural China to identify implementation determinants and stakeholder preferences for future scale-up.

Methods: An exploratory sequential mixed-methods study was conducted. Semi-structured interviews with healthcare providers and older adults were analyzed using thematic analysis and mapped to the Consolidated Framework for Implementation Research. Best–Worst Scaling surveys assessed stakeholder preferences. Qualitative and quantitative findings were integrated to identify optimization strategies.

Findings: A total of 42 participants completed interviews and 506 completed surveys. Facilitators included integration into routine practice, village doctor leadership, government and collective-economy subsidies, and flexible LDCT options. Barriers included increased workload, limited screening awareness, existing medical expenses, insufficient promotion, and low trust in township hospitals. Healthcare providers prioritized limited screening awareness (β=2.32, 95% CI: 2.20, 2.44) and low trust in township hospitals (β=1.97, 95% CI: 1.85, 2.09), while older adults prioritized collective-economy subsidies (β=4.73, 95% CI: 4.22, 5.24) and flexible LDCT options (β=4.22, 95% CI: 3.73, 4.71). Four optimization areas were identified: workflow improvement, strengthened financial support, tailored communication and service options, and individualized education and trust-building.

Interpretation: Optimizing LDCT upgrading in rural primary healthcare requires alignment with both stakeholder preferences and local implementation context. Future scale-up should prioritize individualized education, sustainable financial support, workflow optimization, and village doctor-led model strategies.

AI.tldr: 本研究评估了中国农村村医主导的低剂量CT（LDCT）肺癌筛查项目，通过混合方法识别实施决定因素与利益相关者偏好，发现优化需兼顾工作流程、财务支持、沟通服务和信任建设四方面。
AI.research_question: 在中国农村地区，村医主导的LDCT肺癌筛查项目的实施决定因素是什么？不同利益相关者（医疗服务提供者与老年人）的偏好如何？未来推广的优化策略有哪些？
AI.motivation: LDCT能降低肺癌死亡率，但在现实世界中（尤其是中国农村）的筛查 uptake 仍然很低。需要系统性地评估村医主导模式下的实施障碍与促进因素，为政策推广提供证据。
AI.theoretical_framework: 实施研究综合框架（CFIR）；最佳-最差缩放（Best–Worst Scaling）偏好测量方法。
AI.method: 探索性序列混合方法：先进行半结构化访谈（42人），主题分析并映射到CFIR框架；再实施最佳-最差缩放调查（506份），最后整合定性与定量结果识别优化策略。
AI.findings: 促进因素包括日常整合、村医领导、政府和集体经济补贴、灵活LDCT选项；障碍包括工作量大、筛查意识低、医疗费用负担、推广不足、对乡镇医院信任低。医疗服务提供者最关注筛查意识低（β=2.32）和信任低（β=1.97）；老年人最关注集体经济补贴（β=4.73）和灵活LDCT选项（β=4.22）。四个优化方向：工作流程改进、强化财务支持、定制化沟通与服务、个性化教育与信任建设。
AI.theory_contributions: 将CFIR框架应用于中国农村肺癌筛查情境，验证了该框架在不同文化背景下的适用性；通过最佳-最差缩放量化了不同利益相关者的偏好权重，补充了实施科学中的优先序研究方法。
AI.practical_contributions: 为中国农村LDCT筛查推广提供了实证依据：建议优先推进个性化教育、可持续财务支持、工作流程优化和村医主导模式；明确了不同群体的差异化需求，有助于制定精准实施策略。

title: Neurocognitive and Evolutionary Architecture of Visual Perceptual Completion: Mechanisms of Sensory Interpolation and Object Synthesis

detail.title: Neurocognitive and Evolutionary Architecture of Visual Perceptual Completion: Mechanisms of Sensory Interpolation and Object Synthesis

declarations.declarationOfInterest: Just about the thought that popped into my mind, and so I researched it.
declarations.funderStatement: This research received no external funding.

detail.abstract: The human visual system constantly encounters fragmented sensory inputs due to environmental occlusions and anatomical deficits like the blind spot. Despite this, perception remains phenomenologically continuous. This paper comprehensively reviews the neurocognitive, developmental, and evolutionary architectures underlying visual perceptual completion-the brain's capacity to synthesize complete object representations from partial ("half-seen") stimuli. We trace the historical foundations of Gestalt psychology to modern neurophysiological discoveries, distinguishing between modal and amodal completion mechanisms. 1 Evidence demonstrates that while early visual cortices (V1/V2) utilize structurally driven isomorphic interpolation, the lateral occipital complex (LOC) and inferotemporal (IT) cortex govern knowledge-driven, symbolic completion. 2 Furthermore, this review examines the extreme manifestation of top-down priors through "one-shot perceptual learning," detailing recent ultra-high-field fMRI and intracranial EEG findings that localize these instantaneous priors to the high-level visual cortex. Framed within the Bayesian predictive coding hypothesis and evolutionary error management theory, we argue that visual completion is not merely a neural error, but a critical, metabolically expensive adaptation driven by the ecological arms race of predator-prey dynamics and camouflage.

AI.tldr: 本文综述了视觉知觉完形的神经认知、发育和演化机制，论证了视觉完形不是神经错误，而是由捕食者-猎物动态和伪装驱动的生态军备竞赛中进化而来的关键适应性功能。
AI.research_question: 视觉系统如何在面对碎片化感觉输入（如环境遮挡、生理盲点）时仍能产生连续的知觉体验？其神经机制、发育基础和演化意义是什么？
AI.motivation: 尽管视觉输入常常是碎片化的（如环境遮挡、盲点），但人的知觉体验却是连续的。这种"视觉完形"现象的神经基础、认知机制和演化意义尚未得到系统整合，本文旨在填补这一空白。
AI.theoretical_framework: 格式塔心理学、模态完形与非模态完形机制、贝叶斯预测编码假说、演化误差管理理论
AI.method: 文献综述方法，整合历史格式塔心理学起源与现代神经生理学发现，包括超高场强fMRI和颅内脑电图（iEEG）研究证据。
AI.findings: 1. 早期视觉皮层（V1/V2）通过结构驱动的同构插值进行完形；2. 外侧枕叶复合体（LOC）和颞下皮层（IT）负责知识驱动的符号性完形；3. "一次性知觉学习"中，瞬时先验知识定位于高级视觉皮层；4. 视觉完形是代谢代价高昂但关键的适应性机制。
AI.theory_contributions: 将视觉完形重新定义为一种演化适应性机制而非神经系统的"错误"，整合了预测编码框架与演化误差管理理论，为理解完形现象提供了跨层次的理论解释。
AI.practical_contributions: 对视觉障碍的临床理解、人工智能视觉系统的设计（特别是遮挡场景下的物体识别）以及人机交互界面设计具有指导意义。

title: User Acceptance of Edutainment Mobile Applications: Advancing an Experiential Design-Engagement Model (EDEM)
affiliations: University of Malta and University of Bath - Department of Psychology

detail.title: User Acceptance of Edutainment Mobile Applications: Advancing an Experiential Design-Engagement Model (EDEM)
detail.abstract: Mobile users are increasingly engaging with edutainment gaming apps in formal and informal contexts. They are drawn to them for their educational and entertainment aspects. In this light, this study validates the Theory of Planned Behavior's key measures and integrates them with game narratives and game aesthetics constructs to better understand the extent to which psychological and gaming design factors are predicting the individuals' intentions to play with these learning technologies. The data were gathered through a survey questionnaire from one hundred eighty-six (n = 186) respondents, who were higher education students in a Southern European university. The quantitative findings analyzed through partial least squares (PLS) revealed that the gamers appreciate the edutainment platforms' audiovisual effects as well as their storylines and narratives. The results reported that mobile users enjoyed playing with entertaining learning apps. Respondents indicated that they were willing to continue their gameplay in the future. In conclusion, this contribution raises awareness on the important synergies between gaming design elements and behavioral dimensions driving the users' engagement with edutainment apps. It puts forward a robust theoretical framework that is empirically-grounded.

AI.tldr: 本研究基于计划行为理论，结合游戏叙事和游戏美学构念，验证了心理因素和游戏设计因素如何预测用户对教育娱乐游戏APP的使用意图。通过对186名大学生的问卷调查和PLS分析，发现用户重视平台的视听效果和故事情节，并愿意继续使用。
AI.research_question: 心理因素（计划行为理论）和游戏设计因素（游戏叙事与游戏美学）如何共同预测用户对教育娱乐游戏APP的使用意图？
AI.motivation: 移动用户越来越多地在正式和非正式情境中使用教育娱乐游戏APP，但目前对心理因素与游戏设计元素如何协同驱动用户参与的理解仍不充分。
AI.theoretical_framework: 计划行为理论（Theory of Planned Behavior），以及游戏叙事（Game Narratives）和游戏美学（Game Aesthetics）构念。
AI.method: 问卷调查法，样本为南欧某高校186名大学生，数据分析采用偏最小二乘法（PLS）。
AI.findings: 1）用户重视教育娱乐平台的视听效果和故事叙事；2）移动用户喜欢使用娱乐性学习APP；3）受访者表示愿意在未来继续使用。
AI.theory_contributions: 将计划行为理论与游戏设计元素（叙事和美学）整合，构建并实证检验了一个包含心理与设计双重因素的综合性理论框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 为教育娱乐APP开发者和管理者提供了关于游戏设计元素（如视听效果、故事线）与用户行为之间协同关系的重要启示，有助于优化用户参与策略。

title: Drawn In, Pushed Back: Dual-Route Consumer Responses to AI Virtual Streamers in Live-Streaming E-Commerce

detail.title: Drawn In, Pushed Back: Dual-Route Consumer Responses to AI Virtual Streamers in Live-Streaming E-Commerce
detail.abstract: In live-streaming e-commerce (LSC), the same AI virtual streamers (AVS) can make consumers feel attended to and willing to buy, while they may also evoke feelings of being monitored, treated unfairly, or subjected to excessive persuasion. This research explains this tension by developing a dual-route account of consumer response to AVS. We argue that perceived responsiveness is linked to a relational–approach route in which consumers infer social presence, empathy, and warmth, which in turn is associated with higher purchase intention.
