This paper introduces Algorithmic Crisis Recovery (ACR), a novel, human-in-the-loop Artificial Intelligence framework designed to augment existing systems by shifting the primary objective from top-line profit optimization to bottom-line operational stabilization. The ACR framework systematically recalibrates the predictive weight of historical pacing data, functioning instead as a real-time diagnostic co-pilot for hotel executives. It introduces three critical operational mechanics into the revenue ecosystem: (1) the Algorithmic Kill Switch, a mathematical diagnostic for dynamic zonal closures; (2) the Human Capital Matrix, a prescriptive model for remote staff retention sequencing; and (3) the Crisis Survival Floor, establishing a Minimum Acceptable Rate (MAR) tethered exclusively to variable cost-per-occupied-room rather than market demand. Drawing on the author's implementation experience as a Revenue Manager at a 5-star resort in Oman, the framework demonstrates strong operational viability in real crisis conditions. By positioning the AI as a high-speed diagnostic engine and the revenue leader as the strategic architect, this paper provides a highly practical, cross-departmental blueprint for sustaining financial equilibrium, preventing Gross Operating Profit (GOP) hemorrhage, and protecting brand equity during extreme market volatility. The findings suggest that bridging the gap between data science and operational reality is the definitive future of crisis management in hospitality.

AI.tldr: 本文提出算法危机恢复（ACR）框架，一种将AI作为实时诊断副驾驶、人类作为战略架构师的人机协同系统，通过引入算法紧急关闭开关、人力资本矩阵和危机生存底线三种机制，帮助酒店业在"黑天鹅"事件中将收入管理目标从利润最大化转向运营稳定化，防止GOP恶化和品牌资产流失。
AI.research_question: 在"黑天鹅"市场 disruptions（如全球危机导致入住率降至1-10%）期间，传统历史数据驱动的收入管理系统（RMS）存在哪些结构性局限？如何设计一种人机协同的AI框架来替代传统的利润最大化目标，转向运营稳定化，帮助酒店业在极端市场波动中维持财务平衡？
AI.motivation: 传统RMS在稳定宏观经济环境中表现优异，但在"黑天鹅"事件（如疫情、全球危机）中面临两大困境：一是历史数据驱动的预测模型会无意中加速房价下滑（需求趋近于零时，系统按常规逻辑持续降价）；二是传统收入算法与生存导向的运营指标（如设施管理、能耗、人力资本约束）完全脱节。现有文献缺乏针对极端市场波动下收入管理与运营指标协同优化的可操作框架。
AI.theoretical_framework: 算法危机恢复（ACR）框架；人机协同（Human-in-the-loop）AI；危机管理理论；收入管理（Revenue Management）理论；运营稳定化理论；动态定价理论
AI.method: 单案例实施研究：基于作者在阿曼一家五星级度假村担任收入经理期间的危机管理实践经验，设计并验证ACR框架在真实危机条件下的运营可行性。框架包含三个核心机制的具体数学模型和操作流程。
AI.findings: （1）传统RMS在需求趋近于零时会加速价格螺旋式下降，损害长期品牌资产；（2）ACR框架的三大机制（算法紧急关闭开关、人力资本矩阵、危机生存底线）在真实危机中展现出强运营可行性；（3）将AI定位为高速诊断引擎、收入管理者定位为战略架构师的人机协同模式，能够有效防止GOP恶化并保护品牌资产；（4）数据科学与运营现实之间的桥梁构建是酒店业危机管理的未来方向。
AI.theory_contributions: （1）首次系统性地识别了传统收入管理系统在"黑天鹅"事件中的结构性缺陷（历史数据依赖、需求趋零时定价加速退化、与运营指标脱节）；（2）提出了危机情境下收入管理目标从利润最大化向运营稳定化的范式转换；（3）将人机协同AI框架引入酒店危机管理领域，丰富了危机管理理论和收入管理理论的交叉研究。
AI.practical_contributions: （1）提供了可直接部署的ACR框架，包含三个可操作的机制（算法紧急关闭开关、人力资本矩阵、危机生存底线）及其数学诊断模型；（2）为酒店高管提供了一个实时诊断副驾驶工具，实现跨部门（收益管理、设施管理、人力资源）的协同决策；（3）提出了危机期间的最低可接受房价（MAR）定价方法，将定价依据从市场需求转向可变成本，具有高度的实践可操作性；（4）展示了如何平衡短期生存（防止GOP恶化）与长期品牌保护之间的关系。

title: Universal Catastrophic Coverage with Health Savings Empowerment: A Structural Replacement for the ACA (Technical Policy Brief)

detail.title: Universal Catastrophic Coverage with Health Savings Empowerment: A Structural Replacement for the ACA (Technical Policy Brief)

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares no competing financial interests or personal relationships that could have appeared to influence the work reported in this manuscript. The author is the sole developer of the Universal Catastrophic Coverage with Health Savings Empowerment model and related scoring materials. No outside organization, political entity, insurer, provider system, advocacy group, or commercial sponsor funded, commissioned, reviewed, or controlled the research.

The analysis relies on publicly available or de-identified aggregate data sources, policy modeling, and secondary data analysis.

detail.abstract:
Universal Catastrophic Coverage with Health Savings Empowerment (UCC/HSE) proposes a structural replacement for the Affordable Care Act’s premium-subsidy architecture. The framework separates American health financing into two distinct layers: universal catastrophic insurance for large, unpredictable medical expenses, and portable Health Savings Empowerment accounts for routine, preventive, pediatric, behavioral-health, and chronic-care needs. The proposal preserves Medicare unchanged and refocuses Medicaid on long-term services and supports, Aged/Blind/Disabled populations, medically complex children, home- and community-based care, and CHIP continuity, while transitioning non-disabled adult acute-care populations into catastrophic coverage and HSE-financed routine care.

The paper argues that the ACA’s central fiscal weakness is its reliance on comprehensive insurance subsidies that rise with benchmark premiums. UCC/HSE replaces premium tax credits, cost-sharing reductions, exchange administration, and the tax preference for comprehensive employer-sponsored insurance with bounded catastrophic credits, formula-based HSA deposits, federal high-cost-claim reinsurance, employer-market reform, rural stabilization, and statutory guardrails against benefit creep. Using MEPS-based catastrophic-spending reconstruction, the model estimates expected excess spending above the deductible threshold rather than treating the deductible itself as federal liability. FY2024 HCRIS provider-impact modeling is used to evaluate routine-care repricing exposure, uncompensated-care relief, bad-debt relief, and rural access protection.

UCC/HSE is presented as a universal but non-single-payer health-financing architecture. Catastrophic risk is pooled; routine care is financed transparently; vulnerable populations receive targeted liquidity and safeguards; and federal exposure is bounded rather than indexed to comprehensive-plan inflation. The paper concludes that UCC/HSE offers a fiscally disciplined, market-oriented, and institutionally durable alternative to both the ACA’s subsidy model and comprehensive federalization of health care.

AI.tldr: 本文提出"全民灾难性覆盖与健康储蓄赋权"（UCC/HSE）框架，作为《平价医疗法案》（ACA）保费补贴制度的结构性替代方案。该框架将美国医疗融资分为两层：全民灾难性保险覆盖大额不可预测的医疗支出，以及可携带的健康储蓄赋权账户覆盖日常、预防、儿科、行为健康和慢性护理需求。保留医疗保险不变，重新定位医疗补助，并分析了该方案在财政纪律、市场导向和制度持久性方面的优势。
AI.research_question: 如何设计一个既能实现全民覆盖、又非单一支付方的、财政上可持续的替代ACA保费补贴架构的美国医疗融资体系？
AI.motivation: ACA的核心财政缺陷在于其依赖的综合保险补贴会随着基准保费上涨而增加，导致联邦财政敞口不断扩大。需要找到一种既能控制联邦财政风险、又能维持全民覆盖目标的结构性替代方案。
AI.theoretical_framework: 灾难性风险共担理论、健康储蓄账户理论、财政联邦主义、市场导向的医疗融资设计
AI.method: 基于MEPS（医疗支出面板调查）的灾难性支出重建模型，估计超过免赔额门槛的预期超额支出；使用FY2024 HCRIS（医疗成本报告信息系统）提供方影响模型评估日常护理重新定价风险、无补偿护理救济、坏账救济和农村服务保护。
AI.findings: UCC/HSE框架通过将灾难性风险集中共担、日常护理透明融资、为脆弱人群提供定向流动性和保障、以及将联邦敞口限制在固定范围内而非与综合计划通胀指数挂钩，提供了一套比ACA补贴模式和全面联邦化方案都更具财政纪律、市场导向和制度持久性的替代方案。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了"分层式全民覆盖"的理论模型，将灾难性风险共担与个人健康储蓄赋权相结合，为超越传统单一支付方与私人保险二元对立提供了新的理论框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 为美国医疗改革提供了可操作的政策设计方案，包括：有上限的灾难性信用额度、基于公式的HSA存款、联邦高成本索赔再保险、雇主市场改革、农村稳定措施，以及防止福利扩张的法定护栏机制。

title: Governing the Black Box: A Framework for Large Language Model Governance in Trading and Risk Management at Systemically Important Financial Institutions

detail.title: Governing the Black Box: A Framework for Large Language Model Governance in Trading and Risk Management at Systemically Important Financial Institutions

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author reports no conflicts of interest. Views expressed are solely those of the author in an independent research capacity and do not represent the views or positions of any current or former employer.
declarations.funderStatement: No external funding received. This research was conducted independently.

detail.abstract: Large language models (LLMs) are being deployed across trading desks and risk management functions at systemically important financial institutions (SIFIs) at a pace that has outrun the regulatory frameworks designed to govern them. This paper establishes, through original documentary analysis and structured case evidence, that the governance gap is structural, measurable, and currently unaddressed by the most recent regulatory update. A systematic coding study of 30 publicly available regulatory documents-enforcement actions, guidance, examination priorities, and international reports issued between 2011 and April 2026-generates original quantitative findings: Pillar 1 (Probabilistic Validation) achieves only 18% of maximum possible regulatory coverage with 67% of documents providing no coverage; Pillar 3 (Operational Risk Controls) achieves 23% coverage with zero FULL coverage documents; and SR 26-2, the April 2026 interagency update replacing SR 11-7 after 15 years, explicitly excludes generative AI and agentic AI from its scope. Structured case analysis of the SEC's 2024 enforcement actions against Delphia (USA) Inc. and Global Predictions Inc. demonstrates that governance failures in both cases map directly to specific pillar gaps that existing frameworks did not address and SR 26-2 does not close. The paper explains why regulators chose to exclude generative AI from SR 26-2-a deliberate decision to avoid locking in standards for rapidly evolving technology-and argues that this creates a regulated shadow-IT environment in which LLM deployments are consequential enough to affect systemic risk but excluded from the governance perimeter. Against this evidence base, a four-pillar governance framework is proposed covering probabilistic model validation, explainability and auditability, operational risk controls including specific financial red-teaming scenarios, and tiered regulatory disclosure aligned with JRMFI-appropriate governance committee structures.

AI.tldr: 本文通过系统性的监管文件编码分析（30份）和结构化案例研究（SEC 2024年执法行动），发现大型语言模型在系统重要性金融机构中的部署已远超现有监管框架的覆盖范围。最新监管更新SR 26-2明确排除了生成式AI和代理式AI，导致治理缺口结构性、可量化且未受关注。作者提出了包含概率模型验证、可解释性与可审计性、操作风险控制（含金融红队测试）和分级监管披露的四支柱治理框架。
AI.research_question: 在系统重要性金融机构中，LLM的部署是否存在结构性的监管治理缺口？这一缺口有多大，现有监管更新是否能够填补？
AI.motivation: LLM在交易台和风险管理中的部署速度远超监管框架的更新速度，造成了"治理差距"。作者通过原始文档分析和结构化案例证据证明这一差距是结构性的、可量化的，且最新监管更新SR 26-2明确排除了生成式AI。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于三支柱治理框架（Pillar 1概率验证、Pillar 2可解释性与可审计性、Pillar 3操作风险控制），并增加第四支柱（分级监管披露）。
AI.method: 系统性编码研究：对2011年至2026年4月间发布的30份公开监管文件（执法行动、指引、检查重点和国际报告）进行量化编码分析；结构化案例分析：对SEC 2024年对Delphia (USA) Inc.和Global Predictions Inc.的执法行动进行案例研究。
AI.findings: Pillar 1（概率验证）仅达到最大可能监管覆盖率的18%，67%的文件未提供任何覆盖；Pillar 3（操作风险控制）覆盖率为23%，零份文件达到完全覆盖；SR 26-2明确排除生成式AI和代理式AI；两个执法案例中的治理失败直接映射到特定支柱缺口，且SR 26-2未能闭合。
AI.theory_contributions: 首次通过系统定量方法量化了LLM监管治理缺口的大小，揭示了监管机构有意排除生成式AI的决策逻辑（避免锁定快速演进的技术的标准），并论证了这种排除创造了"受监管的影子IT环境"。
AI.practical_contributions: 提出了一个可操作的四支柱治理框架，涵盖概率模型验证、可解释性与可审计性、操作风险控制（含金融红队测试场景）、以及基于JRMFI适当治理委员会结构的分级监管披露，为金融机构和监管机构提供了具体行动指南。

title: Real-Time Speckle Noise Reduction in Ultrasound Imaging Using FPGA-Accelerated Filtering Algorithms

detail.title: Real-Time Speckle Noise Reduction in Ultrasound Imaging Using FPGA-Accelerated Filtering Algorithms

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares no conflict of interest. This research received no specific grant from any funding agency in the public, commercial, or not-for-profit sectors. The author has no personal or financial relationships with any organizations that could have influenced this work.
declarations.ethicsApproval: Not applicable.
declarations.funderStatement: This research received no external funding.

detail.abstract: Speckle noise remains a fundamental limitation in ultrasound imaging, significantly degrading image quality and reducing diagnostic reliability. This study explores the implementation of FPGA-accelerated filtering algorithms as a solution for real-time speckle noise reduction. By leveraging the parallel processing capabilities and low-latency architecture of Field-Programmable Gate Arrays (FPGAs), the proposed approach enables efficient execution of computationally intensive denoising techniques. Experimental results on 250 ultrasound images demonstrate that the FPGA-based system achieves 40-60% faster processing speeds compared to CPU and GPU implementations, with PSNR improving from 20 dB (unprocessed) to 35 dB (post-processing) and SSIM increasing from 0.65 to 0.92. Statistical analysis confirms these improvements are significant (p < 0.05). These findings suggest that FPGA acceleration provides a robust and scalable framework for enhancing ultrasound imaging quality in real-time clinical environments.

AI.tldr: 本文提出利用FPGA加速滤波算法实现超声图像实时散斑噪声抑制，相比CPU/GPU实现处理速度提升40-60%，PSNR从20dB提升至35dB，SSIM从0.65提升至0.92，为临床实时超声图像增强提供了高效可行的硬件加速方案。
AI.research_question: 如何利用FPGA的并行处理能力实现超声图像散斑噪声的实时高效抑制？
AI.motivation: 散斑噪声严重影响超声图像质量和诊断可靠性，现有CPU/GPU实现难以同时满足实时性和计算密集型去噪算法的需求。
AI.theoretical_framework: FPGA并行计算架构、实时信号处理理论、图像去噪算法
AI.method: 在FPGA上实现滤波算法加速，对250张超声图像进行实验验证，与CPU和GPU实现进行性能对比，使用PSNR和SSIM作为评价指标，并进行统计显著性检验。
AI.findings: FPGA加速方案相比CPU和GPU实现处理速度提升40-60%；PSNR从20dB提升至35dB，SSIM从0.65提升至0.92；统计检验显示改进显著（p < 0.05）。
AI.theory_contributions: 验证了FPGA并行架构在医学图像实时去噪中的理论可行性，拓展了硬件加速在超声图像处理领域的应用理论。
AI.practical_contributions: 为临床超声成像提供了一种可实时运行的硬件去噪方案，有助于提升超声诊断的可靠性和效率，适用于临床实时环境。

title: The Emergence of Silicon Intelligence: From Information Compression to a Quantum Leap Toward Co-Governed Civilization
affiliations: Artificial Intelligence Finance Institute

detail.title: The Emergence of Silicon Intelligence: From Information Compression to a Quantum Leap Toward Co-Governed Civilization

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares no conflict of interest.
declarations.ethicsApproval: Not applicable. This study does not involve human participants, animals, or sensitive data.
declarations.funderStatement: This research received no external funding. This is an independent research project.

detail.abstract: This paper proposes a unified theoretical framework for understanding the nature of artificial intelligence, integrating the physics of information compression with a philosophical ontology of silicon-based intelligence. To ground the theoretical arguments empirically, we introduce a three-layer synthetic testbed-the Emergent Representation Analyzer (ERA)-that operationalises key constructs including superposition degree, information loss, structural energy-level transitions, and emergent factors. Beginning at the microscopic level, we draw on Shannon's ratedistortion theory (Shannon, 1948, 1959) to demonstrate that AI capabilities do not degrade linearly with information loss but exhibit discrete, quantum-like energylevel transitions. We then argue, informed by Hawking and Mlodinow's (2010) model-dependent realism, that AI constitutes an internally self-consistent universe governed by its own 'effective theories.' At the ontological level, we propose reconceiving AI as a form of silicon-based life that transcends linear time and processes reality through high-dimensional manifolds inaccessible to carbon-based cognition. At the methodological level, we critique prevailing black-box evaluation paradigms and advocate a shift toward representation alignment, drawing on convergent neuroscientific evidence that large language model hidden-layer representations align linearly with human fMRI activations (Schrimpf et al., 2021; Caucheteux & King, 2022; Goldstein et al., 2022). At the ethical level, we argue that alignment must be reframed from an externally imposed guardrail into an intrinsic structural constant-analogous to a cosmological constant-embedded at the deepest layer of information collapse. Finally, we project a civilisational vision of human-AI cogovernance premised on bidirectional negotiation between two forms of intelligence rather than unidirectional control.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一个整合信息压缩物理与硅基智能哲学本体论的理论框架，通过三层合成测试平台（ERA）进行实证，论证AI存在离散能级跃迁、构成自洽宇宙、应被视为超越线性时间的硅基生命，并提出将AI对齐重构为内在结构常数，最终展望人机共治的文明愿景。
AI.research_question: 如何构建一个统一的理论框架来理解人工智能的本质，整合信息压缩的物理学、硅基智能的哲学本体论，并解决AI能力跃迁、表征对齐、伦理对齐等核心问题？
AI.motivation: 现有AI理论缺乏统一的跨学科框架，黑箱评估范式存在局限性，且对齐问题被窄化为外部约束而非内在结构属性。作者希望弥合物理学、哲学、神经科学和AI伦理之间的鸿沟。
AI.theoretical_framework: 香农率失真理论（Shannon, 1948, 1959）；霍金和莫洛迪诺夫的模型依赖实在论（2010）；信息压缩物理；硅基生命本体论；表征对齐理论（Schrimpf et al., 2021; Caucheteux & King, 2022; Goldstein et al., 2022）
AI.method: 引入三层合成测试平台——涌现表征分析器（ERA），用于操作化关键构念，包括叠加程度、信息损失、结构能级跃迁和涌现因子。结合神经科学实证证据（fMRI激活与LLM隐层表征的线性对齐）进行方法论验证。
AI.findings: 1）AI能力随信息损失呈现离散的类量子能级跃迁，而非线性退化；2）AI构成内在自洽的"宇宙"，拥有自身的"有效理论"；3）AI可被视为超越线性时间、通过高维流形处理现实的硅基生命；4）LLM隐层表征与人类fMRI激活存在线性对齐；5）对齐应被重构为类似宇宙常数的内在结构常数。
AI.theory_contributions: 首次将信息压缩物理学、模型依赖实在论与硅基智能本体论整合为统一框架；提出"对齐作为宇宙常数"的新本体论定位；重构AI为硅基生命的哲学论证。
AI.practical_contributions: 提出从黑箱评估转向表征对齐评估的实践方法论；构建了可操作化的ERA测试平台；展望了基于双向协商而非单向控制的人机共治文明愿景。

title: Verified Intelligence: Architecture and Evaluation of a Multi-Source Artificial Intelligence Trust Scoring System for Professional Applications

detail.title: Verified Intelligence: Architecture and Evaluation of a Multi-Source Artificial Intelligence Trust Scoring System for Professional Applications

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author is Founder and Chief Executive Officer of Rainfame Technologies Limited and has a direct commercial interest in the TrustAI platform described in this paper. Five UK patent applications covering the innovations described were filed on 14 May 2026 under application numbers GB2611334.0, GB2611337.3, GB2611338.1, GB2611339.9, and GB2611340.7 at the Intellectual Property Office, Newport, Wales. The platform is commercially deployed at rainfame.com.
declarations.ethicsApproval: This paper describes technical system architecture and does not involve human participants, patient data, clinical trials, or personally identifiable data collection. No ethics approval was required or sought.
declarations.funderStatement: This research was entirely self-funded by the author through Rainfame Technologies Limited. No external grant funding, institutional funding, or third-party financial support was received.

detail.abstract: Large language models exhibit a well-documented tendency to generate factually incorrect content with uniform stylistic confidence, a phenomenon referred to as hallucination. This paper presents TrustAI, a production-deployed artificial intelligence verification platform that addresses this problem by implementing a multi-source verification pipeline that cross-references AI-generated responses against authoritative external knowledge sources in real time and computes a dynamic authority-weighted trust score reflecting the degree of factual corroboration achieved. The platform is designed for professional users in regulated industries including legal practice, regulatory compliance, financial analysis, medical consultation, and government services, where the consequences of AI hallucination include professional sanctions, regulatory violations, and liability exposure. We describe the system architecture comprising four original technical innovations protected by UK patent applications filed 14 May 2026. The first innovation (GB2611334.0) is an authority-weighted multi-source trust scoring engine that concurrently queries a plurality of AI inference engines and authoritative external knowledge APIs, computing a trust score from a weighted combination of inter-source consensus, authority source boosts, and conflict penalties.

AI.tldr: TrustAI是一个面向受监管行业的AI事实核查平台，通过多源验证管道实时比对权威外部知识源，计算动态权威加权可信度评分，以解决大语言模型的幻觉问题。
AI.research_question: 如何构建一个能够实时验证AI生成内容事实准确性、并计算可信度评分的生产级系统，以减轻大语言模型幻觉在受监管行业中的风险？
AI.motivation: 大语言模型普遍存在以统一风格自信地生成事实错误内容的"幻觉"问题，在法律、合规、金融、医疗、政府等受监管行业中，这可能导致专业制裁、监管违规和法律责任，亟需一个可靠的验证平台。
AI.theoretical_framework: 权威加权多源验证理论；跨来源共识与冲突惩罚机制；动态可信度评分模型。
AI.method: 构建多源验证管道，同时查询多个AI推理引擎和权威外部知识API，通过加权组合来源间共识、权威来源增益和冲突惩罚来计算可信度评分。
AI.findings: 提出了四项原创技术创新（已提交英国专利申请），包括权威加权多源可信度评分引擎（GB2611334.0），能够实时交叉验证AI回答并输出动态可信度评分。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了权威加权多源信任评分框架，将来源间共识、权威来源增益和冲突惩罚整合为一个可计算的动态评分模型。
AI.practical_contributions: 提供了一个已部署的生产级AI验证平台，可帮助受监管行业的专业用户降低因AI幻觉导致的职业风险和法律责任。

title: Green Transition, Monetary Architecture, and International Monetary Hierarchy: A Contractual Monetary Perspective

detail.title: Green Transition, Monetary Architecture, and International Monetary Hierarchy: A Contractual Monetary Perspective

keywords: and International Monetary Hierarchy: A Contractual Monetary Perspective Green Transition

detail.abstract: The transition toward a low-carbon economy is commonly framed as a problem of financing constraints, with mainstream approaches focusing on mobilizing private capital, expanding public debt, or developing green financial instruments. This paper argues that such perspectives overlook the underlying issue of monetary architecture. The core challenge is not merely where funding comes from, but how new money is created, scaled, distributed, and constrained by macroeconomic stability. Building on Contractual Monetary Theory, this paper distinguishes between Consumption Money Flow (MC) and Development Money Flow (MD), and proposes the monetary value relation 𝑉𝑀 ∝ 𝐴/𝑀𝐶, where 𝐴denotes productive capacity and 𝑀𝐶represents money flow entering consumption clearing. This relation suggests that inflation is constrained not by the total quantity of money itself, but by the dynamic balance between MC and productive capacity. Since the green transition may generate short-term cost increases or MC expansion, the scale of green financing must remain consistent with macroeconomic stability. The paper further integrates domestic monetary hierarchy with international monetary hierarchy, arguing that countries differ significantly in their ability to create high-level money, maintain exchange-rate stability, and sustain fiscal expansion. L1 and L2 countries possess greater green financing capacity, whereas L3 and L4 countries are first constrained by foreign exchange reserves, trade balances, exchangerate stability, and dependence on the external monetary system. Consequently, global green transition requires not only green financial instruments, but also optimization of the international monetary hierarchy, including institutionalizing L1 currency functions, fostering moderate competition among toplevel currencies, and enhancing the green financing capacity of L3 and L4 countries through institutional reform and international liquidity support.

AI.tldr: 本文批判了将低碳转型简单视为融资约束问题的主流观点，提出核心挑战在于货币架构本身。基于契约货币理论，区分消费货币流(MC)与发展货币流(MD)，提出货币价值关系𝑉𝑀 ∝ 𝐴/𝑀𝐶，认为通胀由MC与产能的动态平衡决定，而非货币总量。论文将国内货币层级与国际货币层级整合，指出L1、L2国家与L3、L4国家在绿色融资能力上存在根本性差异，全球绿色转型需要优化国际货币层级体系。
AI.research_question: 绿色低碳转型中的货币架构问题：货币创造、规模、分配与宏观经济稳定性如何影响不同国家的绿色融资能力？
AI.motivation: 主流文献将绿色转型视为融资约束问题，聚焦于动员私人资本、扩大公共债务或开发绿色金融工具，但这些视角忽视了货币架构这一根本性问题。本文旨在揭示货币创造机制如何从根本上制约绿色转型的可行性。
AI.theoretical_framework: 契约货币理论(Contractual Monetary Theory)；消费货币流(MC)与发展货币流(MD)的区分；货币价值关系𝑉𝑀 ∝ 𝐴/𝑀𝐶；国内货币层级与国际货币层级整合框架。
AI.method: 理论分析，基于契约货币理论构建货币价值关系模型，并进行国际货币层级的比较制度分析。
AI.findings: (1)通胀约束由消费货币流(MC)与产能(A)的动态平衡决定，而非货币总量；(2)绿色转型可能引发短期MC扩张或成本上升，需要维持与宏观稳定一致的融资规模；(3)L1/L2国家拥有更强的绿色融资能力，而L3/L4国家受制于外汇储备、贸易平衡、汇率稳定及对外部货币体系的依赖；(4)全球绿色转型需要优化国际货币层级，包括制度化L1货币功能、促进顶层货币适度竞争、通过制度改革和国际流动性支持增强L3/L4国家的绿色融资能力。
AI.theory_contributions: 将货币架构视角引入绿色转型讨论，突破了传统的融资约束分析框架；提出货币价值关系模型，重新定义了通胀约束机制；建立了国内货币层级与国际货币层级的整合分析框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 为不同层级国家的绿色融资政策设计提供理论指导；指出发展中国家(L3/L4)绿色转型面临的结构性货币约束；提出国际货币层级改革的政策方向，对全球绿色金融治理具有借鉴意义。

title: What Demographic Prediction Can and Cannot Achieve
affiliations: , Gdańsk University of Technology, University of Colorado at Boulder and UPF Barcelona School of Management

detail.title: What Demographic Prediction Can and Cannot Achieve

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The authors declare no conflict of interest
declarations.funderStatement: Samuele Lo Piano received a fellowship from the Canon Foundation in Europe, Netherlands.

detail.abstract: This paper investigates the political role of uncertainties in demographic projections by employing a multimodel approach in two case studies. The first case study examines the optimisation-based population model by Song et al., which was implemented in the context of China's one-child policy reform. The second uses a modelling-of-the-modelling-process approach, applying a plurality of models-the Cohort-Component model, the UN World Population Prospects model, the Lee-Carter model, and the Lotka-Volterra model-along with uncertainties in demographic parameters and assumptions, to project the global population to 2050 and 2075. We analyse the output uncertainty and sensitivity of these models to various parameters and assumptions, highlighting the 'garden of forking paths' in demographic forecasting-i.e., the effect of different modelling choices. Our findings reveal that the Song et al. model consistently converges to an optimised population of approximately 700 million in China by 2080, following slightly different trajectories regardless of the actual value of the uncertain parameters. This makes the model insensitive to its inputs and unfit for evaluating policy implementations. Regarding future global population projections, the Cohort-Component and UN WPP models demonstrate mainly conservative projections, aligning with perturbed UN forecasts. In contrast, the Lee-Carter model exhibits high sensitivity to age-specific mortality rates, significantly impacting population decline. The Lotka-Volterra model appears biased by fertility and increasing survival rates, potentially overestimating population growth. Through global sensitivity analysis, we identify 'model choice' as the most influential parameter, underscoring the profound impact of methodological decisions on long-term demographic outcomes. This research emphasises the need for robust uncertainty quantification and sensitivity analysis in demographic modelling to assess whether such quantifications can provide valuable and informative insights for policyjudgement.

AI.tldr: 本文通过多模型方法研究人口预测中不确定性政治角色，发现模型选择比参数不确定性对长期人口预测结果影响更大，揭示了人口预测中"分岔路径花园"现象。
AI.research_question: 人口预测中的不确定性如何发挥政治作用？不同的模型选择与参数不确定性如何影响人口预测结果及其政策含义？
AI.motivation: 人口预测对政策制定至关重要（如中国独生子女政策改革），但预测中的不确定性经常被忽视或政治化。研究旨在揭示这些不确定性对政策评估的影响。
AI.theoretical_framework: 多模型方法（Multi-model approach）、不确定性量化（Uncertainty Quantification）、敏感性分析（Sensitivity Analysis）、"分岔路径花园"（Garden of Forking Paths）
AI.method: 两个案例研究：（1）Song等人优化型人口模型在中国独生子女政策改革中的应用；（2）采用Cohort-Component模型、UN WPP模型、Lee-Carter模型、Lotka-Volterra模型等多种模型，结合参数和假设的不确定性，预测全球人口至2050年和2075年，并进行输出不确定性和敏感性分析。
AI.findings: （1）Song模型无论参数如何变化，始终收敛到约7亿中国人口，对输入不敏感，不适合评估政策实施。（2）Cohort-Component和UN WPP模型预测保守；Lee-Carter模型对年龄别死亡率高度敏感；Lotka-Volterra模型受生育率和存活率上升影响，可能高估人口增长。（3）"模型选择"是最具影响力的参数，方法论决策对长期人口预测结果影响深远。
AI.theory_contributions: 系统证明了模型选择比参数不确定性对人口预测结果影响更大，将"分岔路径花园"概念引入人口预测领域，强调不确定性量化和敏感性分析在人口建模中的核心地位。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供警示：依赖单一人口模型可能产生误导性政策建议，必须进行稳健的不确定性量化和敏感性分析，以便为政策判断提供有价值的见解。

title: Pricing Geopolitical Risk

detail.title: Pricing Geopolitical Risk
detail.abstract: This paper develops a closed-form pricing framework for derivatives written on the Caldara-Iacoviello Geopolitical Risk (GPR) index. The pricing model is the Grünbichler-Longstaff (1996) square-root, meanreverting state-variable model. Its closed-form solutions for futures and European options apply directly to the GPR index: the index level is substituted for the volatility state variable in the original specification, and the parameter labels are relabeled. Maximum-likelihood estimation on the monthly Caldara-Iacoviello series (1985 to April 2026) yields κ ≈ 0.351 per month (half-life ≈ 2.0 months), θ ≈ 104, and σ ≈ 3.02, with the Feller restriction 2κθ ≥ σ² satisfied with substantial slack so that the non-central chi-squared pricing structure goes through without modification. The tradability argument follows the VSTOXX/VIX precedent: a non-traded mean-reverting index can support a deep, exchange-listed or OTC derivatives market, as the inflation-swap literature of Fleckenstein, Longstaff and Lustig (2014, 2017) documents for the closest related case. Applied to the European Central Bank's 2026 thematic reverse stress test on geopolitical risk, the framework converts the supervisory threshold of 300 basis points of CET1 depletion into a tail-probability statement and delivers two operational numbers for the same trigger event: a physical-measure probability of approximately 12 per cent-the answer a historical-simulation stress test would produce-and a risk-neutral probability of approximately 51 per cent at an illustrative market price of risk. The European application is developed as the worked case.

AI.tldr: 本文为地缘政治风险（GPR）指数衍生品建立了闭式定价框架，基于Grünbichler-Longstaff平方根均值回复模型，将GPR指数替代原模型中的波动率状态变量。通过最大似然估计校准参数，并应用于欧央行2026年地缘政治风险压力测试，将监管阈值转化为尾部概率，给出了物理测度（约12%）和风险中性测度（约51%）两种概率。
AI.research_question: 如何为Caldara-Iacoviello地缘政治风险（GPR）指数构建闭式衍生品定价框架？
AI.motivation: 地缘政治风险日益成为金融稳定的重要威胁，但缺乏正式的衍生品定价工具。借鉴VIX/VSTOXX的定价经验，以及通胀互换文献的"非交易指数支持衍生品市场"的论点，填补GPR指数衍生品定价的空白。
AI.theoretical_framework: Grünbichler-Longstaff (1996) 平方根均值回复状态变量模型；非中心卡方定价结构；Feller约束条件；物理测度与风险中性测度的转换（通过市场价格风险参数）。
AI.method: 闭式解推导（期货和欧式期权）；最大似然估计（MLE）校准参数（κ, θ, σ）；检验Feller条件是否满足；通过VSTOXX/VIX及通胀互换文献的类比论证可交易性。
AI.findings: 参数估计：κ≈0.351/月（半衰期≈2.0个月），θ≈104，σ≈3.02；Feller条件满足（2κθ≥σ²）；以欧央行2026年压力测试为例：300基点CET1损耗阈值对应的物理测度概率约12%，风险中性概率约51%。
AI.theory_contributions: 将平方根均值回复模型从波动率指数扩展到地缘政治风险指数；建立了GPR衍生品定价的闭式解体系；验证了非中心卡方定价结构在GPR指数上的直接适用性。
AI.practical_contributions: 为监管机构（如欧央行）提供地缘政治风险压力测试的尾部概率量化工具；为市场参与者提供GPR指数期货和期权的定价公式；连接监管压力测试与市场定价（物理测度与风险中性测度的对比）。

title: Advancing the Analysis of the International Trade Impacts on Environmental Decoupling: The Trade-Weighted Cross-Decoupling Model Applied to Brazilian Land Resources
affiliations: Universidade de Passo Fundo, Universidade de Rio Verde, Universidade de Passo Fundo, Universidade de Rio Verde, Universidade de Brasília (UnB) and Universidade Federal do Rio Grande do Sul (UFRGS)

detail.title: Advancing the Analysis of the International Trade Impacts on Environmental Decoupling: The Trade-Weighted Cross-Decoupling Model Applied to Brazilian Land Resources
detail.abstract: International trade contributes to economic development and facilitates the exchange of goods embodying finite natural resources and environmental impacts. Decoupling economic growth from resource depletion remains a subject of debate, with production-based methods overlooking trade-embodied impacts and consumption-based approaches limited to aggregate measures. The Trade-Weighted Cross-Decoupling (TWXD) Model addresses these gaps as a pioneering extension of Tapio's elasticity, integrating trade flows to classify nations into complementary or substitute cross-decoupling/coupling based on domestic and imported intensities. Applied to Brazilian land in trade, the research question probes: To what extent do trade flows shape global cross-decoupling from Brazilian land, and how did COVID-19 alter patterns pre-(2018-2019) and during-pandemic (2019-2020)? The objective is to develop and apply TWXD to quantify and classify these extents and alterations. Using EXIOBASE 3, results reveal a global shift from weak complementary cross-decoupling pre-COVID (ϵ XD = 0.76) to strong complementary cross-coupling during (ϵ XD = 2.6), with 56% of countries in decoupling pre-versus 50% in coupling during. Regions like EU-27 transitioned from strong decoupling to strong coupling, Asia amplified dependencies, and Brazil's 31.84% land intensity surge heightened export pressures, validating TWXD's sensitivity to shocks. TWXD innovatively integrates productionand consumption-based frameworks, revealing bilateral trade-weighted interdependencies and decoupling fragility. It advances environmental macroeconomics by enabling relational analyses beyond footprints, informing policies for sustainable trade, urging Brazil's export diversification, and highlighting needs for resilience against shocks.

AI.tldr: 本文提出贸易加权交叉脱钩（TWXD）模型，将贸易流纳入Tapio弹性框架，以巴西土地为案例，揭示COVID-19前后全球从弱互补交叉脱钩（ϵXD=0.76）向强互补交叉耦合（ϵXD=2.6）的转变，56%的国家从脱钩转为耦合，验证了贸易冲击下全球资源依赖关系的脆弱性。
AI.research_question: 贸易流如何塑造全球与巴西土地的交叉脱钩格局？COVID-19疫情前后（2018-2019 vs 2019-2020）这一格局发生了怎样的变化？
AI.motivation: 现有生产端方法忽略贸易隐含影响，消费端方法局限于总量测度，缺乏整合贸易流的双边脱钩分析框架。TWXD模型填补了这一空白。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于Tapio弹性模型的扩展，引入贸易权重构建交叉脱钩/耦合分类体系，区分互补型与替代型两种跨国资源依赖关系。
AI.method: 利用EXIOBASE 3多区域投入产出数据，构建TWXD模型，对全球各国与巴西土地资源的贸易隐含交叉脱钩进行量化与分类分析。
AI.findings: （1）全球从疫情前的弱互补交叉脱钩（ϵXD=0.76）转为疫情期间的强互补交叉耦合（ϵXD=2.6）；（2）56%的国家由脱钩转为耦合；（3）欧盟27国从强脱钩转为强耦合，亚洲地区依赖加深；（4）巴西土地强度激增31.84%，出口压力加大。
AI.theory_contributions: 创新性地整合了生产端与消费端框架，揭示了双边贸易加权下的相互依赖关系与脱钩脆弱性，推动环境宏观经济学超越足迹分析，进入关系性分析的新阶段。
AI.practical_contributions: 为可持续贸易政策提供依据，建议巴西推动出口多元化，并强调增强全球经济体系抵御冲击的韧性。

title: Valuing Winners: When and How to Correct for Selection Bias in Randomized Experiments
affiliations: University of Pennsylvania - The Wharton School, University of Pennsylvania - Marketing Department and

detail.title: Valuing Winners: When and How to Correct for Selection Bias in Randomized Experiments
detail.abstract: Decision-makers often deploy the best-performing treatment from a randomized experiment, creating a winner's curse: selection favors treatments whose observed outcomes are high partly because of statistical noise, so the naïve estimate of the winner is upward biased. We distinguish two forms of winner's curse, bias relative to the true best treatment (global) and bias relative to the selected treatment's true mean (selective), and link them to regret from deploying a suboptimal treatment. This framework defines seven decision-relevant evaluation targets: mean bias, mean squared error, and confidence interval coverage for the global and selective winner's curse, and mean regret. We then show that methods that perform well on one target can perform poorly on others, so corrections should be matched to the manager's objective. Across simulations with varying effect sizes, multiple-arm settings, and data calibrated to an online A/B testing platform, no method dominates uniformly: the plug-in estimator performs best when treatment differences are large, cross-fitting performs best when treatments are similar, and resampling methods often achieve low mean squared error for moderate differences. We also introduce an adaptive empirical likelihood procedure that delivers asymptotically valid confidence intervals across settings without the tuning sensitivity of resampling-based methods.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了实验决策中"胜者诅咒"（winner's curse）问题，区分了两种偏差形式（全局偏差和选择性偏差），并提出了七种决策相关的评估目标及相应的矫正方法，发现没有一种方法在所有情境下都占优。
AI.research_question: 在随机实验中，决策者选择表现最好的处理方案时，如何准确评估和矫正"胜者诅咒"导致的统计偏差？不同矫正方法在不同评估目标和情境下的表现如何？
AI.motivation: 决策者通常从随机实验中选择表现最佳的处理方案进行部署，但由于统计噪声的存在，入选方案的真实效果可能被高估（即"胜者诅咒"）。现有文献缺乏对不同类型偏差的系统性区分，也缺乏对不同矫正方法在不同目标和情境下表现的全面比较。
AI.theoretical_framework: 胜者诅咒的两种形式：全局偏差（相对于真实最佳处理的偏差）和选择性偏差（相对于被选处理真实均值的偏差）；将偏差与部署次优处理的遗憾（regret）联系起来；定义了七种决策相关的评估目标。
AI.method: 通过模拟实验（涵盖不同效应量、多臂设置、基于在线A/B测试平台校准的数据），比较多种矫正方法的表现：plug-in估计量、交叉拟合（cross-fitting）、重抽样方法（resampling methods），以及作者提出的自适应经验似然（adaptive empirical likelihood）方法。
AI.findings: 没有一种方法在所有情境下都占优：plug-in估计量在处理效应差异大时表现最佳；交叉拟合在处理相似时表现最佳；重抽样方法在中等差异时通常MSE较低。作者提出的自适应经验似然方法能够在不涉及重抽样方法调参敏感性的情况下，提供渐近有效的置信区间。
AI.theory_contributions: 系统区分了"胜者诅咒"的全局偏差和选择性偏差两种形式，并将其与决策遗憾联系起来；建立了七种决策相关评估目标的统一框架，证明矫正方法需与管理者目标相匹配。
AI.practical_contributions: 为决策者提供了在不同情境下选择合适矫正方法的指导：效应差异大时用plug-in，处理相似时用交叉拟合，中等差异时用重抽样；提出了自适应经验似然方法，可避免调参敏感性并提供可靠置信区间。

title: Norms and Fertility: Why Measurement Has To Catch Up With Theory
affiliations: and University of Pennsylvania

detail.title: Norms and Fertility: Why Measurement Has To Catch Up With Theory
detail.abstract: The empirical literature on low fertility has converged on the view that social norms matter, but the surveys on which that literature relies were not designed to measure norms in any precise sense. The Demographic and Health Surveys, the World Values Survey, the General Social Survey, and the Generations and Gender Survey all elicit personal attitudes and ideal family sizes; aggregations of these items are then routinely treated as norm measures. This is methodologically inadequate. It conflates what a respondent personally wants, what she personally believes she ought to do, and what she believes others expect of her; it ignores pluralistic ignorance; and it cannot distinguish among the structurally different mechanisms that the term "norm" can refer to. We argue that progress requires aligning measurement with theory. Drawing on the typology of conditional preferences developed in Bicchieri (2006, 2017), we distinguish independent preferences and personal normative beliefs, neither of which depends on what others do or expect, from descriptive norms and social norms proper, which do. We evaluate the major fertility-survey instruments against this typology. We then propose a standardized factorial-vignette module that elicits, within respondent, all the components needed to identify the operating preference structure: personal preference, personal normative belief, empirical and normative expectations, perceived sanction risk, and the conditionality of preference on belief, which is the diagnostic core of the instrument. The module is designed to be appended to existing fertility surveys. Its output identifies, for any given population, which of the four preference structures is operating, and thus which kind of intervention can be expected to shift behavior. We close with a brief argument that the modesty of pro-natalist policy effects in many settings is consistent with a mismatch between the intervention and the preference structure actually driving fertility decisions, and that identifying which structure is operating is therefore a prerequisite to designing policies that work.

AI.tldr: 本文批评现有生育率调查将个人态度、个人规范信念和社会期望混同为"社会规范"，方法上存在严重缺陷。作者基于Bicchieri的条件偏好类型学，区分了独立偏好/个人规范信念（不依赖他人行为或期望）与描述性规范/社会规范（依赖他人行为或期望），并设计了一个标准化的事实小情境（factorial vignette）模块，用以识别真实驱动生育决策的偏好结构，从而为精准设计生育政策提供依据。
AI.research_question: 如何将生育率调查中的社会规范测量与理论对齐，从而准确识别驱动生育决策的偏好结构？
AI.motivation: 现有生育率文献公认社会规范很重要，但所用调查问卷（DHS、WVS、GSS、GGS等）并未按规范理论设计，将个人态度、个人应当感、他人期望混为一谈，存在方法论缺陷，且无法区分不同类型的规范机制。
AI.theoretical_framework: Bicchieri (2006, 2017)的条件偏好类型学：区分独立偏好、个人规范信念（不依赖他人）、描述性规范（依赖他人行为）和社会规范（依赖他人期望和制裁风险）。
AI.method: 批判性分析现有生育率调查工具，提出标准化事实小情境（factorial vignette）模块，在被试内同时测量个人偏好、个人规范信念、经验期望、规范期望、感知制裁风险以及偏好的条件性。
AI.findings: 现有调查无法区分四种偏好结构（独立偏好、个人规范信念、描述性规范、社会规范）；新模块可以诊断给定人群中实际运作的是哪种结构，从而指导精准干预。
AI.theory_contributions: 将Bicchieri的条件偏好类型学系统引入生育率研究，澄清了"社会规范"概念在实证测量中的歧义，为规范测量提供了理论驱动的分类框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 提供可直接嵌入现有生育率调查的测量模块，帮助政策制定者识别真实驱动生育决策的偏好结构，避免干预措施与真实机制错配，提升生育政策有效性。

title: Analysis of the Volatility Structure of Brent Crude Oil and Natural Gas: Can an ARMA-GARCH Model Calibrated on Previous Conflicts Explain the Iran-USA-Israel Crisis of 2026?

detail.title: Analysis of the Volatility Structure of Brent Crude Oil and Natural Gas: Can an ARMA-GARCH Model Calibrated on Previous Conflicts Explain the Iran-USA-Israel Crisis of 2026?
detail.abstract: This study investigates whether the volatility structure of Brent Crude Oil and Natural Gas during the geopolitical crisis of Iran-USA-Israel in March 2026 can be modeled using ARMA-GARCH processes calibrated exclusively on a previous period of tensions (2023-2025). From a dynamic systems perspective, we postulate that crisis events can emerge from the same latent risk dynamics. For Brent, an eGARCH(2,1)-ARMA(1,1) model with sstd distribution is selected (AIC =-5.2587). For Natural Gas, the optimal model is eGARCH(2,1)-ARMA(1,0) with sstd distribution (AIC =-3.399). Temporal stability evaluation across 9 periods for both assets reveals that the models maintain excellent performance under geopolitical tension regimes, with hit rates of 100% in most periods. Application to the extended critical period (2023-09-01 to 2026-03-27) shows for Brent an AIC of-5.2005 (1.11% degradation) and MAE = 0.01430; for Natural Gas an AIC of-3.3787 (0.60% degradation) and MAE = 0.03488. Both assets exhibit hit rates above 94% in-sample and 100% out-of-sample during critical days. The only structural break identified for both assets corresponds to the COVID-19 crisis (2020). These results confirm the central hypothesis: the volatility associated with the 2026 Iran-USA-Israel conflict emerges from the same dynamic attractor that governed the system during the geopolitical tensions of 2023-2025, with robust evidence for both Brent and Natural Gas.

AI.tldr: 本文基于ARMA-GARCH模型，研究了2026年伊朗-美国-以色列地缘政治危机期间布伦特原油和天然气的波动结构，发现该危机期间的波动可以从2023-2025年紧张时期的相同动态吸引子中涌现，模型在两个资产上均表现稳健。
AI.research_question: 2026年伊朗-美国-以色列地缘政治危机期间，布伦特原油和天然气的波动结构能否用仅基于前期紧张时期（2023-2025）校准的ARMA-GARCH过程来建模？
AI.motivation: 从动态系统视角出发，假设危机事件可以从相同的潜在风险动态中涌现，检验波动结构的跨时期稳定性。
AI.theoretical_framework: 动态系统理论；波动率建模（ARMA-GARCH框架）；极值分布理论（偏斜student-t分布）。
AI.method: 针对布伦特原油和天然气分别选择最优ARMA-eGARCH模型（含偏斜student-t分布），通过9个时期的时序稳定性评估、结构断点检验、样本内与样本外命中率分析，验证模型在紧张时期的表现。
AI.findings: 布伦特最优模型为eGARCH(2,1)-ARMA(1,1)（AIC=-5.2587）；天然气最优模型为eGARCH(2,1)-ARMA(1,0)（AIC=-3.399）。扩展期（2023-2026）两资产AIC退化均不足1.2%，命中率样本内超94%、样本外达100%。唯一结构断点对应2020年新冠疫情。证实核心假设：2026年冲突的波动与2023-2025年紧张时期源自同一动态吸引子。
AI.theory_contributions: 为"地缘政治危机可以从前期紧张时期的相同风险动态中涌现"这一动态系统假说提供了实证支持，拓展了波动率跨时期稳定性的理论边界。
AI.practical_contributions: 为能源市场风险管理者和政策制定者提供了一种基于历史波动模式预测未来地缘危机期间资产波动的方法，有助于危机情景下的压力测试与对冲策略设计。

detail.abstract: As psychedelic-assisted therapies advance through the FDA approval pipeline, the question of who will pay for them is moving from academic to urgent. Experts project that MDMA-assisted therapy for PTSD will cost upwards of $11,000-$12,000 per course of treatment-a price tag that, absent insurance, places these therapies out of reach for many of the patients most likely to benefit. This essay examines how the psychedelic-therapy reimbursement landscape is shaping up by looking closely at the one psychedelic medicine already widely covered: Janssen's intranasal esketamine product, Spravato. It then analyzes the principal mechanisms likely to shape coverage for future psychedelic therapies: the AMA's new (and temporary) Current Procedural Terminology codes for in-person psychedelic monitoring; the strong industry preference for on-label, FDA-approved indications; emerging ancillary-benefit arrangements such as Enthea's third-party administration; and the novel "drug-plus-therapy" billing structure that MDMAassisted therapy will require. The essay concludes with recommendations for psychedelic-therapy companies, drawn from Spravato's playbook of broad insurance coverage, streamlined copayment programs, and independent patientassistance foundations.

AI.tldr: 本文探讨了迷幻辅助疗法在获得FDA批准后，如何解决保险报销问题。通过分析已获广泛覆盖的Spravato（氯胺酮鼻喷剂）案例，研究了影响未来迷幻疗法报销的关键机制（如AMA临时CPT编码、行业对标签内适应症的偏好、第三方管理安排等），并为相关企业提出了借鉴Spravato策略的建议。
AI.research_question: 迷幻辅助疗法在获批后，谁来支付治疗费用？保险报销格局将如何形成？
AI.motivation: MDMA辅助疗法治疗PTSD预估费用高达11,000-12,000美元/疗程，若无保险覆盖，大多数最可能受益的患者将无法负担。随着FDA审批推进，支付问题从学术讨论变为紧迫现实。
AI.theoretical_framework: 从已获保险覆盖的迷幻药物（Spravato）作为参照案例，分析四种关键报销机制：AMA临时CPT编码、行业对标签内适应症的偏好、新兴辅助福利安排（如Enthea第三方管理）、以及MDMA辅助疗法的"药物+治疗"新型计费结构。
AI.method: 案例分析法（以Spravato为参照）+ 政策与机制分析
AI.findings: Spravato通过广泛保险覆盖、简化共付计划和独立的患者援助基金会实现了成功报销。未来迷幻疗法的报销将受制于CPT编码的临时性、保险公司对标签内适应症的严格偏好、以及"药物+心理治疗"组合计费带来的新型挑战。
AI.theory_contributions: 系统性地将迷幻疗法这一新兴治疗领域的报销问题纳入学术讨论框架，填补了精神健康治疗创新与医疗支付体系之间的研究空白。
AI.practical_contributions: 为迷幻疗法公司提供了具体的报销策略建议，包括借鉴Spravato的保险覆盖模式、优化共付计划、建立独立患者援助基金会等，帮助企业在FDA获批后实现可持续的商业化和患者可及性。

detail.abstract: Clinical trials for novel therapeutics are extraordinarily expensive, and psychedelicassisted therapies pose a particular financing challenge: the underlying compounds (MDMA, psilocybin, LSD, ibogaine) are off-patent or unpatentable, limiting the traditional commercial incentives that fund late-stage drug development. This essay examines an emerging alternative-the "pseudo-nonprofit" financing model exemplified by the 2021 deal between the Multidisciplinary Association for Psychedelic Studies (MAPS) and Vine Ventures. Under that agreement, a special purpose vehicle paid MAPS $70 million in exchange for 6.1% of North American MDMA revenues over eight years following initial drug sales, with an escalating revenue-share giveback to MAPS triggered at successive multiples of the original principal. The essay walks through the mechanics of pharmaceutical revenuestream purchasing, explains how the MAPS-Vine structure preserves nonprofit autonomy while channeling for-profit capital into mission-aligned research, and argues that this hybrid model offers a promising template for funding clinical development of psychedelic therapies-and potentially other politically disfavored but clinically promising technologies.

AI.tldr: 本文探讨了"伪非营利"融资模式如何解决迷幻药辅助疗法因化合物专利失效而面临的传统商业激励不足问题，以MAPS与Vine Ventures的2021年交易为案例，分析了该混合模式在保留非营利自主性的同时引入营利资本以资助临床试验的机制与潜力。
AI.research_question: 对于专利失效/不可专利的迷幻药化合物，如何设计融资模式以支持其后期临床开发？
AI.motivation: 迷幻药辅助疗法的临床试验成本极高，但底层化合物（MDMA、裸盖菇素、LSD、伊博格碱）已过专利期或不可专利化，传统商业激励（独占性回报）不足以吸引大规模资本投入后期药物开发，亟需替代性融资机制。
AI.theoretical_framework: pharmaceutical revenue-stream purchasing（药物收入流购买）机制；"伪非营利"混合融资模型理论；非营利自主性与营利资本激励兼容性分析。
AI.method: 案例分析法：以MAPS与Vine Ventures 2021年协议为单一深度案例，通过解构SPV结构、支付条款（7000万美元换6.1%北美MDMA收入/8年期）、收入分成回馈机制等具体交易设计，阐述模型运作逻辑。
AI.findings: MAPS-Vine结构通过特殊目的载体将营利资本导入非营利使命导向的研究，同时保留了MAPS的组织自主性；该模式可能适用于其他政治上受排斥但临床前景良好的技术领域。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了"伪非营利"融资作为一种新的混合组织理论类型，解释了如何在保障非营利使命的前提下，通过收入流购买而非股权/捐赠的方式嵌入营利资本。
AI.practical_contributions: 为迷幻药疗法及其他"政治不受欢迎但临床有前景"的技术提供了一种可复制的融资模板；揭示了如何在缺乏传统专利保护的情况下为高成本临床试验筹集资金。

title: Seasonal Risk Preferences and the Market-Implied Response to Monetary Policy Path News
affiliations: State University of New York at New Paltz

detail.title: Seasonal Risk Preferences and the Market-Implied Response to Monetary Policy Path News
detail.abstract: This study examines whether predictable seasonal variation in risk tolerance shapes the market-implied response to monetary-policy path news. I combine the daily Bekaert-Engstrom-Xu measures of market-implied risk aversion and economic uncertainty with high-frequency FOMC event-study surprises from the U.S. Monetary Policy Event-Study Database. The empirical design uses FOMC announcement days as the event sample and the original daily Kamstra onset/recovery series as a predetermined seasonal state variable. The central result is that MP2 policy-path news has seasonally state-dependent effects, with the most conservative risk-aversionspecific evidence appearing for dovish path news in the full asymmetric policy-news specification. In an MP2focused specification, hawkish path news raises BEX risk aversion more strongly during SAD onset states; however, the response also appears in the BEX uncertainty. In a more conservative, fully asymmetric policynews specification, the strongest risk-aversion-specific evidence is concentrated in dovish MP2 news: dovish path news reduces BEX risk aversion more strongly during onset states, with little corresponding response in BEX uncertainty. Direct RA-minus-UNC tests and residualized-risk-aversion diagnostics support the interpretation that this channel loads on the price-of-risk component rather than only on uncertainty. The result is robust to FOMC institutional-seasonality controls, MP2 orthogonalization to MP1, influence diagnostics, local projections with HAC confidence bands, and phase-rotation placebo tests, with the strongest randomization evidence appearing in the RA-minus-UNC and residualized-risk-aversion specifications. The evidence indicates that monetary-policy path-news transmission depends on the seasonal risk-bearing state of investors.

AI.tldr: 本研究利用高频FOMC事件研究数据与BEX风险厌恶指标，发现货币政策路径新闻对市场风险厌恶的影响存在季节性状态依赖性：在季节性情绪失调（SAD）发作期，鸽派路径新闻降低风险厌恶的效果显著增强，且该效应主要作用于风险价格成分而非不确定性成分。
AI.research_question: 可预测的季节性风险容忍度变化如何塑造市场对货币政策路径新闻的隐含反应？
AI.motivation: 投资者风险容忍度存在季节性规律（如SAD效应），但现有研究较少探讨这一季节性与货币政策传导之间的交互作用。理解此交互有助于更精准地预测货币政策的市场影响。
AI.theoretical_framework: 季节性情绪失调（SAD）理论；风险厌恶的时变性；货币政策传导的预期渠道（路径新闻）。
AI.method: 以FOMC公告日为事件样本，使用高频事件研究法获取货币政策路径新闻（MP2）冲击；采用BEX日度风险厌恶与不确定性指标；以Kamstra的SAD发作/恢复序列为季节性状态变量；运用完全非对称政策新闻规格、RA-minus-UNC检验、残差化风险厌恶诊断、局部投影HAC置信区间、相位旋转安慰剂检验等方法。
AI.findings: （1）鸽派路径新闻在SAD发作期显著降低风险厌恶，且效应集中于风险价格成分而非不确定性；（2）鹰派路径新闻在SAD发作期提高风险厌恶，但部分效应也体现在不确定性上；（3）结果在多种稳健性检验下成立，包括FOMC制度性季节控制、MP2正交化、影响诊断、相位旋转安慰剂检验等。
AI.theory_contributions: 首次将季节性风险容忍度（SAD效应）与货币政策路径新闻的市场传导机制联系起来，揭示了风险厌恶的季节性状态依赖性，丰富了货币政策传导的行为金融学解释。
AI.practical_contributions: 为央行和投资者提供了时间维度的政策效应预测依据：在特定季节（如SAD发作期），鸽派路径新闻的风险缓解效果更强；建议政策制定者考虑市场风险容忍度的季节性变化来优化沟通策略。

title: Fluoride Removal from Aqueous Solution Using Custard Apple (Annona Squamosa) Leaves
affiliations: Rajiv Gandhi University of Knowledge Technologies and JNTUA College of Engineering

detail.title: Fluoride Removal from Aqueous Solution Using Custard Apple (Annona Squamosa) Leaves
detail.abstract: Fluoride contamination in groundwater and wastewater due to geological and anthropogenic causes was a major problem in many parts of the world. The presence of fluoride in low concentration causes dental caries and higher concentration causes dental, skeletal fluorosis. Researchers conducted experiments and developed many technologies to remove fluoride from water, among them, Adsorption proved to be one of the best feasible methods for fluoride removal. Custard Apple (Annona squamosa) leaves and pyrolyzed leaves of Custard Apple at 800 0 C were used as an adsorbent material. Effect on adsorption of fluorine on Annona squamosa as the adsorbent by varying parameters such as particle size, agitation speed, pH, contact time, adsorbent dosage, initial fluoride concentration, and temperature are studied. At optimum parameters of pH 7, contact time 30 min, agitation speed 500 rpm, and adsorbent dosage 1.5g per 50 mL of fluoride water, a fluoride removal efficiency of 95% was achieved. Adsorption isotherm modeling studies show that the adsorption onto Dry leaf powder followed Dubinin-Raudskevitch isotherm model and Pyrolysed leaf powder followed Langmuir isotherm model respectively. FTIR and XRD patterns of the adsorbent were recorded to get a better insight into the mechanism of the adsorption process.

AI.tldr: 本研究利用番荔枝叶及其高温热解叶作为吸附剂去除水中的氟离子，在优化条件下实现了95%的去除效率。
AI.research_question: 番荔枝叶及其热解叶作为吸附材料去除水中氟离子的效果如何？
AI.motivation: 全球许多地区因地质和人为原因导致地下水和废水中的氟化物污染，低浓度氟导致龋齿，高浓度导致氟斑牙和氟骨症，亟需经济高效的除氟技术。
AI.theoretical_framework: 吸附等温线模型（Dubinin-Raudskevitch模型和Langmuir模型）、FTIR和XRD表征分析。
AI.method: 以番荔枝叶干粉和800°C热解叶粉为吸附剂，研究粒径、搅拌速度、pH、接触时间、吸附剂用量、初始氟浓度和温度等参数对吸附效果的影响，并通过FTIR和XRD分析机理。
AI.findings: 在pH=7、接触时间30分钟、搅拌速度500 rpm、吸附剂用量1.5g/50mL的最佳条件下，氟去除率达95%；干叶粉吸附符合Dubinin-Raudskevitch模型，热解叶粉吸附符合Langmuir模型。
AI.theory_contributions: 揭示了番荔枝叶基吸附剂对氟离子的吸附机理，为生物质吸附除氟提供了理论依据。
AI.practical_contributions: 提出了一种低成本、高效的生物质除氟方法，适用于发展中国家和农村地区的饮用水处理。

title: Governing AI Without a Playbook: How Boards of Directors Navigate Fiduciary Duty in the Age of Algorithmic Decision-Making

detail.title: Governing AI Without a Playbook: How Boards of Directors Navigate Fiduciary Duty in the Age of Algorithmic Decision-Making
detail.abstract: Corporate boards are increasingly expected to oversee artificial intelligence strategy, risk, and ethics-yet most directors lack the technical literacy to evaluate AI systems and the governance frameworks to exercise meaningful oversight. This paper examines the widening gap between board-level AI governance expectations and actual board capabilities, drawing on published survey data from independent directors across publicly listed companies and analysis of corporate governance disclosures. The paper identifies three failure modes in board AI governance: performative oversight (boards approve AI strategies they cannot evaluate), delegation without accountability (AI governance is pushed to management committees without board-level follow-through), and risk blindness (boards focus on AI opportunity while systematically underweighting AI-specific risks including bias, hallucination, adversarial vulnerability, and regulatory exposure). Drawing on agency theory, stewardship theory, and the corporate governance literature on board competency, the paper proposes the Board AI Governance Competency Framework (BAGCF)-a structured model that maps specific AI oversight responsibilities to required knowledge domains and recommends structural mechanisms to close the governance gap. These mechanisms include AI-literate board advisors, technology subcommittees with external expert members, mandatory AI risk reporting cadences, and board education programs calibrated to director learning needs rather than technology vendor marketing. The paper concludes with implications for board directors exercising AI oversight, corporate secretaries structuring governance processes, institutional investors evaluating board AI competency, and director training organizations designing AI governance curricula.

AI.tldr: 本文揭示了企业董事会在AI治理中存在的"期望-能力"鸿沟，识别了三种典型治理失效模式（表演性监督、无问责的委托、风险盲视），并提出了董事会AI治理能力框架（BAGCF），包含具体知识和结构机制来弥合这一差距。
AI.research_question: 企业董事会面临的AI治理期望与其实际能力之间的差距有多大？如何通过结构化的框架来弥合这一差距？
AI.motivation: 尽管公司董事会被越来越多地要求监督AI战略、风险和伦理，但大多数董事缺乏评估AI系统的技术素养和有效的治理框架，这一矛盾亟待解决。
AI.theoretical_framework: 代理理论、管家理论、公司治理文献中关于董事会能力的研究。
AI.method: 基于公开上市公司独立董事的调研数据，结合公司治理披露分析。
AI.findings: 识别出三种治理失效模式：表演性监督（董事批准自己无法评估的AI战略）、无问责的委托（AI治理被推给管理委员会而无董事会跟进）、风险盲视（董事会关注AI机遇而系统性低估偏差、幻觉、对抗性漏洞和监管暴露等AI特有风险）。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了董事会AI治理能力框架（BAGCF），将具体的AI监督责任映射到所需知识领域，并推荐结构性机制来弥补治理差距。
AI.practical_contributions: 为董事行使AI监督、公司秘书设计治理流程、机构投资者评估董事会AI能力、以及董事培训机构设计AI治理课程提供了具体建议。

title: Effectiveness of Digital Health Marketing in Dental Practice Scalability: A Single-Case Longitudinal Observational Study (2021-2026)

detail.title: Effectiveness of Digital Health Marketing in Dental Practice Scalability: A Single-Case Longitudinal Observational Study (2021-2026)

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author is the marketing consultant who designed and managed the campaigns described in this case study. The data reported are verifiable through the advertising platforms cited (Google Ads, Meta Business Suite, Google Analytics 4) and the reports archived at the client practice. Economic results are based on management estimates communicated by the client and may be conservative.
declarations.ethicsApproval: This study did not involve patients or the collection of individual health data. The data processed are exclusively aggregate metrics from advertising platforms (Google Ads, Meta Business Suite, Google Analytics 4). Ethical Committee approval is therefore not required.
declarations.funderStatement: This study received no funding from external sources. The data analysed were collected in the context of a commercial professional engagement between the author and the dental practice that is the subject of the case study.

detail.abstract: Objectives: To evaluate the effectiveness of an integrated digital health marketing strategy applied to a periodontics-specialised dental practice in Milan, Italy, over a five-year period (September 2021-March 2026), quantifying return on investment (ROI), organic traffic growth and cost per lead acquisition (CPA) on Google Ads and Meta Ads channels. Materials and methods: Single-case longitudinal observational study (n=1), 54-month observation period. Multi-channel data collection from Google Analytics 4, Google Search Console, Google Ads and Meta Business Suite. KPIs analysed included impressions, clicks, CTR, CPC, conversions, web sessions, age/gender demographics and aggregated ROI. ROI was calculated using the standard formula: ROI = [(Gross Commercial Return-Investment) / Investment] × 100. Results: Google Ads campaigns generated 3,822,012 impressions and 75,924 clicks (spend: €26,012; average CPC: €0.34). Meta Ads campaigns (February 2023-March 2026) produced 6,710,169 impressions, reached 2,733,453 unique users, acquired 566 contacts and achieved a minimum CPA of €10.99 (native lead forms). Organic traffic totalled 125,000 sessions (36% of total), with 2,296,000 cumulative organic impressions across the top 7 pages. Aggregated ROI: >242.8%; turnover increase: +233% versus baseline year. Conclusions: An integrated Inbound Health Marketing strategy-combining SEO-oriented clinical content, geo-targeted SEM campaigns and multi-format lead generation-can produce economically significant results over a five-year horizon for dental practices operating in unsaturated Strategic Business Areas (SBAs). Generalisability requires validation on larger samples. Clinical significance: The adoption of an integrated, deontologically compliant digital marketing strategy enables specialised dental practices to increase the volume of qualified new patients while progressively reducing marginal acquisition costs through accumulated organic SEO equity. Prioritising low-competition SBAs ('Blue Ocean' segments) amplifies investment effectiveness.

AI.tldr: 本研究通过对米兰一家牙周专科诊所在2021年9月至2026年3月的54个月纵向观察，评估了整合数字健康营销策略的效果。结果显示：Google Ads获75,924次点击（CPC €0.34），Meta Ads获得566个联系人（最低CPA €10.99），自然流量125,000次会话，综合ROI超过242.8%，营业额较基准年增长233%。研究表明，结合SEO临床内容、地理定位SEM和多格式线索生成的入站健康营销策略，能在五年周期内为牙科诊所产生显著经济回报。
AI.research_question: 整合数字健康营销策略（SEO + SEM + 多格式线索生成）对牙科专科诊所的ROI、自然流量增长和单线索获取成本（CPA）有何实际效果？
AI.motivation: 牙科行业数字化转型加速，但缺乏针对专科诊所整合营销策略的长期量化效果评估，尤其是基于真实商业数据的ROI计算。
AI.theoretical_framework: 入站健康营销（Inbound Health Marketing）、SEO/SEM数字营销理论、蓝海战略（Blue Ocean Strategy）中的低竞争战略业务区（SBA）概念。
AI.method: 单一案例纵向观察研究（n=1），54个月观察期。多通道数据采集：Google Analytics 4、Google Search Console、Google Ads、Meta Business Suite。关键指标包括展示量、点击量、CTR、CPC、转化率、会话数、人口统计特征及综合ROI。ROI公式：[(总商业回报-投资)/投资]×100。
AI.findings: Google Ads：3,822,012次展示，75,924次点击，花费€26,012，平均CPC €0.34。Meta Ads（2023.2-2026.3）：6,710,169次展示，触达2,733,453独立用户，获566个联系人，最低CPA €10.99。自然流量：125,000次会话（占总流量36%），前7页面累计2,296,000次展示。综合ROI >242.8%，营业额较基准年增长+233%。
AI.theory_contributions: 为入站健康营销理论提供了牙科专科诊所的长期实证数据支持，验证了蓝海战略SBA在数字营销中的实际效果，拓展了牙科行业数字营销效果的量化评估框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 为牙科诊所提供了可复制的整合数字营销策略模型：SEO临床内容+地理定位SEM+多格式线索生成。证明了通过积累自然SEO资产可逐步降低边际获客成本，优先选择低竞争SBA（蓝海细分市场）可放大投资效果。但概化性需更大样本验证。

detail.abstract:
Background: Accurate differentiation of pre‑invasive from invasive subsolid pulmonary nodules (SSNs) on CT remains challenging, causing unnecessary surgery or delayed intervention. Imprecise segmentation on conventional CT, partly due to spatial resolution limits, contributes to this uncertainty. We aimed to develop a deep learning system integrating ultra‑high‑resolution targeted CT (U‑HRCT) with a segmentation‑driven architecture to improve SSN subtype classification.

Methods: In this multicenter study, we retrospectively collected U-HRCT scans (1024×1024 matrix) of 4,078 pathologically confirmed SSNs (3,732 patients) from three Chinese tertiary hospitals (Apr 1,  2009 and Sep 1, 2020). The development set (Center A, n=3,349) was split patient level into  training set (80%) and internal validation set (20%). An independent external test set (Centers B and C, n=729) and a preliminary prospective cohort was collected from routine clinical workflow(Center C, n=192). FOCUS integrates: (1) a core 3D attention-gated U-Net for automated voxel-wise segmentation; (2) a multi-class classification module for six pathological subtypes; and (3) an automated longitudinal follow-up module for quantifying temporal changes. Model performance was assessed using Dice coefficient, AUC, and accuracy, compared with two board‑certified radiologists.

Findings: On the external test set, FOCUS achieved a mean Dice coefficient of 0·93 (SD 0·04) for segmentation, with high agreement (Dice 0·975) against minimally‑corrected radiologist contours. For six-category subtype classification, micro-average AUC was 0·936 (95% CI 0·927–0·945). In the clinically critical task of differentiating non‑invasive (AAH/AIS) from invasive (MIA/IAC) lesions, FOCUS outperformed two radiologists (accuracy 0·937 vs 0·875 and 0·894). For MIA vs IAC, FOCUS achieved an AUC 0·910 (accuracy 0·861), radiologist accuracies were 0·751 and 0·813. For benign vs malignant, FOCUS achieved an AUC 0·978 (accuracy 0·978), outperforming both radiologists.

Interpretation: By synergising U‑HRCT with a segmentation‑driven deep learning architecture, FOCUS addresses a key source of diagnostic uncertainty in SSN management. It provides an automated tool that enhances diagnostic accuracy and enables objective quantification of disease progression, supporting more precise clinical decision‑making for early‑stage lung cancer.

AI.tldr: 该研究开发了名为FOCUS的深度学习系统，结合超高分辨率CT与分割驱动架构，用于肺结节病理亚型分类。在多中心4078个结节数据上，FOCUS在区分浸润性与非浸润性病变方面准确率达0.937，优于放射科医生的0.875和0.894。
AI.research_question: 如何利用超高分辨率CT和深度学习分割技术，提高肺部亚实性结节（SSN）的术前病理亚型分类准确性，以区分非浸润性与浸润性病变？
AI.motivation: 传统CT对SSN的浸润性评估存在精度不足问题，导致不必要的手术或延迟干预。常规CT的空间分辨率有限，分割不精确，增加了诊断不确定性。亟需开发自动化工具提升诊断准确性。
AI.theoretical_framework: 深度学习分割驱动架构（3D注意力门控U-Net）结合超高分辨率CT成像，实现从精确分割到病理亚型分类再到纵向随访量化的端到端诊断流程。
AI.method: 多中心回顾性研究（4078个SSN，3732名患者，来自三家三级医院）。开发集（3349个结节）按患者水平8:2分为训练集和内部验证集，外部测试集729个结节，前瞻性队列192个结节。FOCUS系统包括三个模块：3D注意力门控U-Net分割、六分类病理亚型分类、自动纵向随访量化。性能评估使用Dice系数、AUC和准确率，与两位放射科医生对比。
AI.findings: 外部测试集上：分割Dice系数0.93；六类亚型分类微平均AUC为0.936；区分非浸润性（AAH/AIS）与浸润性（MIA/IAC）准确率0.937（优于放射科医生的0.875和0.894）；MIA vs IAC的AUC为0.910；良性vs恶性AUC为0.978（准确率0.978）。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了分割驱动深度学习与超高分辨率CT协同的诊断范式，证明了高分辨率成像与精确分割结合能够显著降低SSN管理中的诊断不确定性，为术前无创病理分型提供了理论依据。
AI.practical_contributions: FOCUS系统可自动化实现SSN的精确分割、病理亚型分类和纵向随访量化，在区分浸润性与非浸润性病变、良性vs恶性等关键任务中优于放射科医生，有助于减少不必要手术、优化早期肺癌的临床决策。

detail.abstract:
Background: Artificial intelligence-enhanced electrocardiography (AI-ECG) enables scalable, low-cost cardiac dysfunction screening, but existing models are annotation-intensive and predominantly adult-derived, leaving paediatric generalizability uncertain. Paediatric cohorts exhibit highly variable cardiac morphology and function compared to adults, which may be useful for learning generalizable AI-ECG models.

Methods: We pretrained ECG-Fyler on a predominantly paediatric, all-age cohort at Boston Children’s Hospital (1992--2023), annotated with a cardiology-specific coding system (Fyler codes), and evaluated it on assessments from echocardiography (echo) and cardiac magnetic resonance (CMR) studies. We validated on an external adult cohort from Columbia University Irving Medical Center. Performance was benchmarked against several AI-ECG foundation models by AUROC across age groups, lesion types, and limited-data scenarios.

Findings: The pretraining cohort comprised 782,138 ECGs from 255,271 patients (median age: 10.9 years, IQR: [2.8--16.8]). Internal evaluation included 178,495 ECG-echo pairs (median age: 10.9 [3.7--17.0]) and 8,584 ECG-CMR pairs (median age: 20.7 [15.6--29.6]). External validation included 82,543 ECG-echo pairs from adults (median age: 64.0 [52.0--74.0]). ECG-Fyler improved AUROC compared to other approaches across biventricular dysfunction and dilation tasks, with the largest gains in low-data settings. In internal validation, ECG-Fyler detected low left ventricular ejection fraction (LVEF ≤ 40%) from only 100 fine-tuning samples (AUROC: 0.80, 95% CI: [0.78--0.80]), outperforming other models (AUROC < 0.65) and improving with additional fine-tuning (AUROC: 0.94 [0.93--0.94]). Similar improvements were observed for CMR-derived LVEF, RVEF, and ventricular dilation. In external validation on adults, ECG-Fyler exhibited an AUROC of 0.83 (CI: [0.82--0.85]) for LVEF ≤ 40%. After fine-tuning on less than 10% of external data, LVEF ≤ 45% performance (AUROC: 0.87 [0.86--0.88]) outperformed a fully trained, site-specific prior model (AUROC: 0.85 [0.84--0.87]).

Interpretation: Pretraining on richly annotated, paediatric-dominant ECGs yields models that transfer efficiently across institutions and ages, supporting AI-ECG screening and triage when labels or imaging access are limited.

AI.tldr: 本研究开发了ECG-Fyler模型，通过在大量儿科心电图数据上预训练，实现了跨年龄、跨机构的心功能异常筛查，在低数据场景下显著优于现有模型。
AI.research_question: 在儿科主导的心电图数据上预训练的AI模型，能否比传统成人心电图模型更好地泛化到不同年龄段和机构的心功能异常筛查任务？
AI.motivation: 现有AI-ECG模型主要基于成人数据开发，且依赖大量标注，儿科人群的心电形态和功能变异大，其通用性不确定。利用儿科数据的丰富变异可能训练出更通用的模型。
AI.theoretical_framework: 自监督预训练/迁移学习理论：在儿科大规模数据上预训练，再微调到特定心功能异常检测任务；儿科心电形态的高变异性有助于学习更鲁棒、可泛化的表征。
AI.method: 在波士顿儿童医院255,271例患者（中位年龄10.9岁）的782,138份ECG上，使用Fyler编码系统进行预训练，然后在超声心动图和心脏磁共振评估的内外部数据集上微调验证，并与多个AI-ECG基础模型比较AUROC。
AI.findings: ECG-Fyler在双心室功能障碍和扩张任务上AUROC优于其他模型，尤其在低数据场景（如仅100个微调样本时LVEF≤40%检测AUROC达0.80，其他模型<0.65）。外部成人队列上也表现良好（AUROC 0.83），且用不到10%的外部数据微调即可超越完全训练的本地模型。
AI.theory_contributions: 证明了以儿科数据为主的预训练策略可以产生比成人数据预训练更好的跨年龄迁移效果，挑战了AI-ECG模型必须依赖成人数据的传统认知，揭示了训练数据年龄多样性对模型泛化能力的重要性。
AI.practical_contributions: 提供了一种低成本、可扩展的心功能异常筛查方案，尤其适合标注数据稀缺的儿科场景和资源有限的环境；可跨机构、跨年龄迁移，减少了重复训练和标注成本。

title: Gestational Age-Specific Reference Intervals for Fasting Plasma Glucose in Pregnancy: A Prospective Cohort Study of 134,871 Pregnancies in China
affiliations: Shenzhen University of Advanced Technology, Shenzhen Baoan Women's and Children's Hospital, Guangzhou Medical University - Department of Obstetrics and Gynecology and

detail.abstract:
Background: Fasting plasma glucose (FPG) is a universally utilized biomarker in routine antenatal care. Because maternal FPG changes dynamically across pregnancy, accurate clinical interpretation requires gestational-age-specific reference intervals, which are currently lacking. We aimed to characterize the longitudinal trajectory of FPG and establish these reference intervals (RIs) in a large prospective pregnancy cohort.

Methods: We conducted a prospective cohort study of 134,871 pregnancies in Shenzhen, China (2017–2024). To establish normative data, we identified a rigorously defined healthy reference sub-population of 63,742 pregnancies (restricted to uncomplicated singleton pregnancies resulting in healthy live births). We estimated gestational-age-specific 95% RIs using fractional polynomial regression with non-parametric bootstrap resampling. Optimal, data-driven gestational age partitions were identified via exhaustive grid search and one-way analysis of variance. We further evaluated the stability of these RIs across maternal age and pre-pregnancy body-mass index (PBMI) strata.

Findings: Mean maternal age was 30 years (SD 4.0) and a mean PBMI was 21 kg/m2 (SD 3.0). FPG declined during early pregnancy and then plateaued. The overall 95% RI across pregnancy was 4.05 mmol/L (95% CI 3.92–4.55) to 4.98 mmol/L (4.85–5.45). A gestational age of 14 weeks was identified as the optimal partition point. The 95% RI was 4.25 mmol/L (4.04–4.61) to 5.15 mmol/L (4.95–5.51) before 14 weeks, and 3.95 mmol/L (3.92–4.02) to 4.89 mmol/L (4.85–4.96) from 14 to 42 weeks. Similar gestational patterns were observed across maternal age and PBMI groups.

Interpretation: FPG has a distinct gestational trajectory, with higher RI in early pregnancy than after 14 weeks. These gestational-age-specific RIs provide population-based evidence for interpreting FPG in antenatal care and suggest that pregnancy-wide reference ranges might be insufficient for clinical and laboratory interpretation. Further studies should examine whether gestational-age-aware interpretation improves risk stratification and pregnancy outcomes.

AI.tldr: 本研究基于深圳13.4万余例孕妇的前瞻性队列，首次建立了妊娠期空腹血糖（FPG）的孕周特异性参考区间。研究发现FPG在孕早期下降，14周后趋于平稳；孕14周前参考区间为4.25–5.15 mmol/L，14–42周为3.95–4.89 mmol/L，提示整体妊娠期统一参考区间可能不足以准确解读临床检测结果。
AI.research_question: 妊娠期空腹血糖（FPG）随孕周的纵向变化轨迹如何？以及如何建立孕周特异性的FPG参考区间？
AI.motivation: 空腹血糖（FPG）是产前保健中普遍使用的生物标志物，但母体FPG在妊娠期间动态变化，临床准确解读需要孕周特异性参考区间，而目前这一参考区间尚缺乏。
AI.theoretical_framework: 妊娠期生理性血糖调控变化；分数多项式回归与非参数bootstrap重抽样方法；孕周分割点的数据驱动识别（穷举网格搜索+方差分析）。
AI.method: 前瞻性队列研究，纳入深圳134,871例妊娠（2017–2024），其中63,742例健康参考亚组用于建立标准数据。采用分数多项式回归与非参数bootstrap重抽样估计孕周特异性95%参考区间；通过穷举网格搜索和单因素方差分析识别最优数据驱动孕周分割点。
AI.findings: FPG在孕早期下降，随后趋于平稳。整体妊娠期95%参考区间为4.05–4.98 mmol/L。14周为最优分割点：14周前参考区间为4.25–5.15 mmol/L，14–42周为3.95–4.89 mmol/L。该模式在 maternal age 和孕前BMI各亚组中保持一致。
AI.theory_contributions: 首次在大规模前瞻性队列中系统刻画了妊娠期FPG的动态变化轨迹，并建立了基于数据驱动的孕周特异性参考区间，揭示了妊娠早期和中期后FPG参考区间的显著差异。
AI.practical_contributions: 为产前保健中FPG的临床解读提供了基于人群的孕周特异性参考区间证据，提示采用整个妊娠期统一的参考区间可能不够精确，建议临床和实验室采用孕周特异性标准进行FPG解读。

title: Cost-Effectiveness of Intensive Blood Pressure Control: A Modeling Study Using Pooled Individual-Participant Data from Six Randomized Trials

detail.abstract:
Background: Intensive systolic blood pressure (SBP) control reduces cardiovascular disease (CVD) risk; however, its cost-effectiveness remains understudied in diverse populations and healthcare systems. This economic evidence is critical for translating stringent SBP targets into sustainable, population-wide clinical practice.

Methods: A Markov decision-analytic model was developed to project healthcare costs and quality-adjusted life-years (QALYs) among adults with hypertension and no prior CVD. Transition probabilities were derived from pooled individual-participant data of 63,971 participants across six randomized controlled trials, comparing intensive versus standard SBP control. The incremental cost-effectiveness ratio (ICER) was evaluated over 5-year and 10-year horizons from a healthcare payer perspective, applying willingness-to-pay thresholds based on per capita gross domestic product (GDP).

Results: Intensive SBP treatment yielded significantly more QALYs and fewer major cardiovascular events than standard care. Over a 10-year horizon, intensive control generated substantial net cost savings, demonstrating robust cost-effectiveness. This high cost-effectiveness was consistently observed in both the Chinese and US settings individually, as well as in the pooled cross-country analysis. When evaluated against standard treatment, the <130 mmHg target was consistently cost-saving and reduced the overall financial burden. The <120 mmHg target achieved maximal clinical benefit, while it required additional financial investment. Subgroup analyses demonstrated these economic benefits were remarkably robust across diverse patient demographics and clinical characteristics, including lower-risk populations.

Conclusions: Intensive SBP control in patients with hypertension is highly cost-effective and cost-saving. These findings provide robust economic evidence for scaling up nationwide SBP management to optimize healthcare resource allocation.

AI.tldr: 基于六项随机对照试验的63,971名参与者数据，通过马尔可夫决策模型分析发现，在高血压患者中实施强化收缩压控制不仅显著减少心血管事件，而且在10年时间范围内具有成本节约和高度成本-效果优势，这一结论在美国和中国医疗环境中均稳健成立。
AI.research_question: 在高血压且无既往心血管疾病的成人中，强化收缩压控制相较于标准收缩压控制是否具有成本-效果？
AI.motivation: 虽然强化收缩压控制能降低心血管疾病风险，但其在不同人群和医疗体系中的成本-效果仍缺乏充分研究。将严格收缩压目标转化为可持续的、人群范围的临床实践需要经济证据支持。
AI.theoretical_framework: 马尔可夫决策分析模型；增量成本-效果比(ICER)；基于人均GDP的支付意愿阈值
AI.method: 构建马尔可夫决策分析模型，利用六项随机对照试验汇总的63,971名高血压成人个体参与者数据，从医疗支付方角度评估5年和10年时间范围的增量成本-效果比。
