detail.abstract:
Background: Non-compressive myelopathy can lead to severe disability and death. The diagnosis is often complex and resource-intensive, with regional variation in causes. Data on the epidemiology and etiology of non-compressive myelopathy in Africa remains limited. 

Methods: Using consecutive sampling, we performed a cross-sectional analysis within an established cohort of adult patients hospitalized in medical wards, all of whom exhibited clinical signs and symptoms consistent with non-compressive myelopathy at two tertiary hospitals in Kampala, Uganda. Consent was obtained from admitted patients over the age of eighteen who presented with clinical signs and symptoms of non-compressive myelopathy. Participants underwent spine magnetic resonance imaging (MRI) to rule out extradural spinal cord lesions. Serum and cerebrospinal fluid (CSF) aquaporin-4 (AQP4) and myelin oligodendrocyte glycoprotein (MOG) antibody testing and CSF metagenomic next-generation sequencing (mNGS) were performed. Tissue biopsies and serum vitamin B12 levels were carried out at the discretion of the clinician. Descriptive statistics were used to summarize the diagnostic results and participant characteristics. 

Findings: Among 420 participants screened, 144 were enrolled and included in this analysis. Seventy-nine (55%) were male, the median age was 33 years (IQR 25-44), and 38 (26%) were people living with HIV. Intradural abnormalities were identified on spinal MRI in 79 (55%) participants. An etiologic diagnosis was established in 45 (32%) participants, including neuromyelitis optica spectrum disorder (NMOSD, n=10), myelin oligodendrocyte glycoprotein antibody-associated disease (MOGAD, n=7), Schistosoma mansoni (n=8), cytomegalovirus (n=1), varicella zoster virus (n=1), vitamin B12 myelopathy (n=8), infiltrating spinal cord tumor (n=8), and arteriovenous malformation (n=2).

 Interpretation: This study identified a wide range of etiologies for non-compressive myelopathy in Uganda, including autoimmune myelopathies (NMOSD and MOGAD) and infectious myelopathies. These findings highlight the importance of expanding access to both autoimmune and infectious diagnostic testing in Africa.

AI.tldr: 本研究在乌干达两家三级医院对144名非压迫性脊髓病患者进行了横断面分析，发现55%的MRI显示椎管内异常，32%的患者确定了病因，包括视神经脊髓炎谱系疾病(NMOSD)、MOG抗体相关疾病(MOGAD)、曼氏血吸虫感染、维生素B12缺乏性脊髓病和脊髓肿瘤等。研究强调在非洲扩大自身免疫性和感染性诊断检测的重要性。
AI.research_question: 乌干达非压迫性脊髓病的流行病学特征和病因分布是什么？
AI.motivation: 非压迫性脊髓病可导致严重残疾和死亡，诊断复杂且资源密集，而非洲地区关于该病的流行病学和病因学数据十分有限。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于非压迫性脊髓病的病因分类框架，涵盖自身免疫性（如NMOSD、MOGAD）、感染性（如血吸虫、巨细胞病毒）、营养性（如维生素B12缺乏）和肿瘤性等病因类别。
AI.method: 在乌干达坎帕拉两家三级医院的住院患者中进行横断面分析，采用连续抽样。对疑似非压迫性脊髓病患者进行脊柱MRI排除硬膜外病变，并进行血清和脑脊液AQP4/MOG抗体检测、脑脊液宏基因组二代测序(mNGS)，以及临床医生酌情进行的组织活检和维生素B12检测。
AI.findings: 共筛查420名参与者，纳入144名。55%为男性，中位年龄33岁，26%为HIV感染者。55%的参与者脊柱MRI显示椎管内异常。32%的患者确定了病因，包括NMOSD(10例)、MOGAD(7例)、曼氏血吸虫(8例)、巨细胞病毒(1例)、水痘-带状疱疹病毒(1例)、维生素B12缺乏性脊髓病(8例)、浸润性脊髓肿瘤(8例)和动静脉畸形(2例)。
AI.theory_contributions: 首次系统性地揭示了东非地区非压迫性脊髓病的病因谱系，证实了自身免疫性脊髓病（NMOSD和MOGAD）在非洲地区的存在和重要性，丰富了全球非压迫性脊髓病的病因学知识。
AI.practical_contributions: 研究结果提示非洲地区应同时扩大自身免疫性和感染性诊断检测的可及性，为乌干达及类似地区的临床诊断路径和医疗资源配置提供了循证依据。

title: Automation, Learning, and Career Dynamics
affiliations: Columbia University, Federal Reserve Banks - Federal Reserve Bank of Atlanta, University of Texas at Austin and University of Chicago - Booth School of Business

detail.title: Automation, Learning, and Career Dynamics

publicationDetails.journalName: Federal Reserve Bank of Atlanta Research Paper Series

detail.abstract: We study how an automating technology affects career dynamics, human capital, and welfare in an economy where workers acquire skill through the tasks they perform. In a continuous-time general equilibrium model, learning-by-doing is determined jointly with the share of tasks automated, the frontier of tasks managers maintain, and the worker-to-manager career transition. Economies with high learning capacity admit pairs of stationary equilibria strictly ranked by the aggregate learning rate. Cheaper technology has opposite effects across the two: in the high-learning equilibrium, it raises welfare through the learning channel itself; in the low-learning equilibrium, it tips the economy into a human-capital trap. The planner's first-best combines a tax on automation profits with a subsidy on frontier maintenance expenditures at a common rate.

AI.tldr: 本文构建连续时间一般均衡模型，研究自动化技术如何通过干中学影响职业动态、人力资本积累和社会福利。研究发现，高学习能力经济存在两个稳态均衡，廉价自动化在高学习均衡中促进福利，在低学习均衡中导致人力资本陷阱。最优政策是等比例征收自动化利润税并补贴前沿维持支出。
AI.research_question: 自动化技术如何通过任务中的干中学效应影响工人的职业动态、人力资本积累和社会福利？
AI.motivation: 自动化技术正在深刻改变劳动市场，但现有研究较少关注工人通过执行任务积累技能（干中学）这一关键机制。本文旨在揭示自动化、干中学与职业晋升（工人向管理者转变）之间的内生互动关系。
AI.theoretical_framework: 连续时间一般均衡模型，包含：干中学（learning-by-doing）、自动化任务份额、管理者维持的任务前沿（frontier of tasks）、工人向管理者的职业转换（career transition）。
AI.method: 理论建模（连续时间一般均衡模型），通过数学推导求解稳态均衡并进行比较静态分析。
AI.findings: （1）高学习能力的经济体存在两个稳态均衡，按总学习率严格排序；（2）自动化技术成本下降在两个均衡中效应相反：高学习均衡中通过学习渠道提升福利，低学习均衡中使经济陷入人力资本陷阱；（3）社会最优（first-best）政策是对自动化利润征税同时对前沿维持支出给予等比例补贴。
AI.theory_contributions: 首次将干中学与自动化、职业晋升内生化于同一框架，揭示了自动化技术可能导致的"人力资本陷阱"这一非线性效应，拓展了技能偏向型技术进步和人力资本积累的理论。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供了应对自动化的政策工具建议：不能单纯降低自动化成本，而应通过税收和补贴的组合政策引导经济走向高学习均衡。

title: Online food delivery applications: Are they a valid alternative to traditional market surveys for food price data collection?
affiliations: affiliation not provided to SSRN, affiliation not provided to SSRN, Independent, RWI - Leibniz Institute for Economic Research, Independent, Independent, Independent, Independent and Makerere University

detail.title: Online food delivery applications: Are they a valid alternative to traditional market surveys for food price data collection?
detail.abstract: Background: Changes in the global food system are affecting the availability and affordability of healthy and unhealthy foods. The lack of timely retail food price data poses a barrier to the design and evaluation of fiscal policies aiming to improve diet quality. Aim: The aim of this study was to determine whether prices collected from food delivery applications (FDAs) are a valid alternative to traditional resource-intensive market surveys. Methods: Secret shopper-style market surveys of online via FDAs (ONL) and in real life (IRL) food vendors were conducted in Kampala, Uganda every 2 weeks from September 2023 to March 2024. Prices were collected for 35 food items representing healthy and unhealthy food groups (n=5,708). ONL and IRL food prices were compared using ordinary least squares (OLS) regression. Findings: The validity of the FDA method varied by food item. Across the three OLS models explored, IRL to ONL price differences were consistently not significant for twenty of the 35 food items, covering 22 of 26 food groups used by the Diet Quality Questionnaire (DQQ) indicator and eight of ten food groups used by the Minimum Dietary Diversity for Women (MDD-W) indicator. Conclusion: For a diverse basket of foods, food price data collection using FDAs may be a valid alternative to more resource-intensive traditional market surveys in Kampala, Uganda. The study provides evidence for the use of a readily accessible source of food price data by program designers and evaluators and a template for similar research to be conducted in other contexts.

AI.tldr: 本研究验证了通过外卖应用（FDAs）收集食品价格数据在乌干达坎帕拉的有效性，发现该方法对多种食品类别而言，可替代传统的市场调研，为膳食政策和项目评估提供了便捷、低成本的数据来源。
AI.research_question: 外卖应用（FDAs）收集的食品价格是否能作为传统市场调查的有效替代方案？
AI.motivation: 全球食品体系变化影响健康食品的可及性和可负担性，但缺乏及时的零售食品价格数据阻碍了以改善膳食质量为目的的财政政策设计与评估。因此需要寻求低成本、高效的数据收集方法。
AI.theoretical_framework: 膳食质量评估指标（DQQ和MDD-W）框架；食品价格数据收集方法比较。
AI.method: 在乌干达坎帕拉，每两周通过秘密购物者方式同时收集在线外卖平台（ONL）和线下实体店（IRL）的食品价格，涵盖35种食品（n=5,708），使用普通最小二乘法（OLS）回归比较两组价格差异。
AI.findings: FDA方法的有效性因食品而异。在三种OLS模型中，35种食品中有20种（覆盖DQQ的22/26个食品组和MDD-W的8/10个食品组）的线上与线下价格差异不显著。
AI.theory_contributions: 为食品价格数据收集方法提供了效度证据，拓展了膳食质量评估研究中数据来源的可能性，验证了FDA作为低成本替代方案的可行性。
AI.practical_contributions: 为项目设计者和评估者提供了一种易于获取的食品价格数据来源，降低了数据收集成本；为在其他地区开展类似研究提供了可复制的模板，有助于推动基于证据的财税政策制定。

title: Endogenous Task Bundling, Skills and Automation
affiliations: University of Toronto - Rotman School of Management

detail.title: Endogenous Task Bundling, Skills and Automation
detail.abstract:
Empirical measures of AI's wage effect typically hold fixed the bundle of activities a worker is paid for at its pre-AI shape. We argue that this assumption hides much of the action. When automation breaks a job apart, firms decide how to recombine the surviving activities; whether they rebundle them into one broad role or split them into specialist roles changes which surviving skills the labour market actually rewards. A skill that played no role in the pre-AI wage can become the dominant component of the post-AI wage, while a skill that anchored the pre-AI wage can disappear from the schedule. We develop an assignment model in which the priced human bundle is endogenous, and we use it to show that a fixed-bundle wage regression can mis-sign the effect of AI exposure. In general, the omitted-redesign bias has no unconditional sign: it is the residual covariance between exposure and role-specific redesign terms. Under explicit sufficient conditions, exposure-correlated unbundling loads specialist comparative-advantage premia onto the exposure coefficient, while exposure-correlated rebundling loads a different, often opposite, omitted term. The sign must therefore be measured from local post-AI partition changes rather than assumed from exposure alone.

Institutional subscribers to the NBER working paper series, and residents of developing countries may download this paper without additional charge at www.nber.org.

AI.tldr: 本文指出，传统方法衡量AI对工资的影响时，错误地假设工人的任务组合固定不变。实际上，AI打破原有工作后，企业会重新组合剩余任务（合并为宽泛岗位或拆分为专业岗位），这从根本上改变了哪些技能获得市场回报。作者构建了一个内生化任务组合的分配模型，证明固定任务组合的工资回归会错误估计AI的影响方向，且偏差方向无法仅从AI暴露程度推断，而需依赖本地化的岗位重组实际数据。
AI.research_question: 当AI自动化导致工作任务被分解后，企业重新组合剩余任务的不同方式（合并与拆分）如何改变劳动力市场对不同技能的定价，以及忽视这一过程会如何导致对AI工资效应的估计偏差？
AI.motivation: 现有实证研究在衡量AI对工资的影响时，通常假设工人被支付报酬的任务组合（activity bundle）在AI冲击前后保持不变。本文认为这一假设忽略了关键机制：当AI打破原有工作结构后，企业如何重新组合剩余活动——是合并为一个宽泛岗位，还是拆分为多个专业岗位——会决定哪些幸存技能获得回报，从而根本性地改变工资结构。
AI.theoretical_framework: 本文构建了一个内生的任务组合分配模型（assignment model），其中工人的任务组合（priced human bundle）不再是外生给定的，而是企业基于AI冲击后重组决策的内生结果。模型区分了"拆分"（unbundling）和"合并"（rebundling）两种重组方式，并分析了它们如何将不同的比较优势溢价（comparative-advantage premia）引入工资方程。
AI.method: 理论建模与偏误分析。作者构建了内生化任务组合的分配模型，推导了固定任务组合工资回归（fixed-bundle wage regression）中遗漏变量偏误（omitted-redesign bias）的数学表达式，并识别了决定偏误符号和大小的充分条件。
AI.findings: （1）固定任务组合的工资回归会系统性错误估计AI暴露对工资的影响，这一偏误被称为"遗漏重组偏误"（omitted-redesign bias）。（2）该偏误没有无条件的方向：它是AI暴露程度与岗位重组特定项之间的残差协方差。（3）在特定充分条件下，与AI暴露相关的拆分（unbundling）会将专业分工的比较优势溢价加载到AI暴露系数上，而与AI暴露相关的合并（rebundling）则加载方向不同、往往相反的遗漏项。（4）因此，AI工资效应的符号不能仅从AI暴露程度推断，而必须基于本地化（local）的岗位重组实际变化来衡量。
AI.theory_contributions: （1）首次系统论证了任务组合的内生性对估计AI工资效应的重要性，挑战了已有文献中普遍采用的固定任务组合假设。（2）提出了"遗漏重组偏误"（omitted-redesign bias）的概念，并给出了其数学表达式和符号条件。（3）将劳动力市场对AI的调整从"技能替代"层面推进到"任务重组"层面，为理解AI如何通过改变工作组织方式影响工资结构提供了新的理论视角。
AI.practical_contributions: （1）对政策制定者：警示仅基于AI暴露程度（exposure）来预测工资影响的政策分析可能产生误导，呼吁关注AI带来的岗位结构重组（拆分vs合并）对工资分配的实际影响。（2）对研究者：指出了现有实证方法的偏误来源，建议未来研究应收集和分析AI冲击后企业实际的任务重组数据，而非仅依赖暴露度量。（3）对企业和工人：揭示了AI时代技能回报的变化不仅取决于技能本身，还取决于企业如何围绕AI重组工作任务。同一技能在不同重组模式下可能有截然不同的市场回报。

title: Are Gender Norms Shaped by Who Earns More?
affiliations: Technische Universität München (TUM), Kreditanstalt für Wiederaufbau (KFW), Technische Universität München (TUM), Ifo Institute and Technische Universität München (TUM)

detail.title: Are Gender Norms Shaped by Who Earns More?
detail.abstract: Gender norms about parental labor supply are central to explaining persistent gender inequalities in the labor market, yet their causal determinants remain poorly understood. We examine whether people’s gender attitudes are driven by mothers’ and fathers’ earnings, which may shape views about the efficient allocation of paid work and care. In a large-scale representative vignette experiment in Germany (N > 10,000), we randomly vary pre-childbirth earnings and measure whether respondents recommend that the mother (father) stay home with the child while the father (mother) works full-time. Without specifying earnings, 90% recommend that the mother stay home. This share remains high when we specify that the mother earns less (93%). When she earns more, the share drops sharply to 47%, yet nearly half of respondents still recommend that the mother stay home. This asymmetric response rejects a purely income-based explanation of gender norms. Thus, economic circumstances shape gender attitudes, but deeply rooted norms persist even when they conflict with financial incentives.

AI.tldr: 通过德国大规模实验发现，人们对母亲居家照料的偏好受收入水平影响，但存在严重的非对称性——即使母亲收入更高，仍有近半数人建议其居家，表明性别规范不能仅用经济因素解释。
AI.research_question: 父母的收入水平如何影响人们对性别角色的态度？即经济激励能否改变人们对母亲应居家育儿、父亲应全职工作的性别规范？
AI.motivation: 劳动力市场的性别不平等持续存在，性别规范被认为是核心原因之一，但其因果决定因素尚不明确。理解性别态度的形成机制对于制定促进性别平等的政策至关重要。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于收入效率假说（谁收入高谁应专职工作）与性别规范假说（女性应承担照料责任）之间的竞争性解释。
AI.method: 在德国开展大规模代表性场景实验（N > 10,000），随机改变父母产前收入水平，测量受访者是否建议母亲（父亲）居家育儿而父亲（母亲）全职工作。
AI.findings: 1) 不指定收入时，90%建议母亲居家；2) 母亲收入较低时，比例升至93%；3) 母亲收入较高时，比例骤降至47%，但仍有近半数建议母亲居家。这种非对称反应拒绝了纯粹基于收入的解释。
AI.theory_contributions: 揭示了经济因素与深层性别规范之间的互动机制：经济激励可以削弱但无法消除性别规范，证明了性别规范具有超越理性经济计算的独立影响力。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供启示：单纯通过调整经济激励（如提高女性工资）不足以完全改变性别角色分工，需要同时针对深层文化规范进行干预。

title: The Euro as an Optimum Currency Area? A Reappraisal
affiliations: and

detail.title: The Euro as an Optimum Currency Area? A Reappraisal
detail.abstract: This paper reassesses whether the euro area satisfies the criteria of an optimum currency area. It contrasts early hopes of convergence with subsequent developments marked by persistent heterogeneity across member states. Differences in economic structures, fiscal policies, and financial cycles have produced asymmetries that a single monetary policy cannot offset. Labor mobility and fiscal integration remain limited, shifting adjustment burdens onto prices, wages, and financial flows. Credit expansion and later retrenchment amplified divergence, culminating in the sovereign debt crisis. Since then, cohesion has relied heavily on unconventional monetary policies and fiscal support mechanisms, with notable effects on inflation dynamics, growth performance, and income distribution. The analysis concludes that the euro area has not evolved toward optimality and faces rising risks unless institutional reforms or structural changes are undertaken.

AI.tldr: 本文重新评估了欧元区是否满足最优货币区标准，指出成员国间持续存在的异质性、有限的劳动力流动和财政一体化，以及信贷周期分化等因素，导致欧元区并未趋向最优货币区，面临日益上升的风险。
AI.research_question: 欧元区是否满足最优货币区（OCA）的标准？
AI.motivation: 早期对欧元区趋同的希望与现实中的持续异质性之间存在落差，需要重新审视欧元区作为货币联盟的运行状况。
AI.theoretical_framework: 最优货币区（Optimum Currency Area, OCA）理论
AI.method: 定性分析与文献综述，结合欧元区历史发展数据进行评估
AI.findings: 1. 成员国经济结构、财政政策和金融周期的差异导致不对称冲击；2. 劳动力流动和财政一体化不足，调整压力转移到价格、工资和金融流动上；3. 信贷扩张与收缩加剧了分化，最终引发主权债务危机；4. 后期依赖非常规货币政策和财政支持机制维持凝聚力，但影响了通胀、增长和收入分配。
AI.theory_contributions: 对OCA理论在欧元区的适用性进行了重新检验，指出了单一货币政策无法抵消结构性异质性的理论局限。
AI.practical_contributions: 为欧元区未来的制度性改革（如财政一体化、结构性改革）提供了实证依据和政策启示。
